zh: 那位業務員不但謙虛而且誠實，你有需要的話可以請他協助。
py: nà wèi yè wù yuán bù dàn qiān xū ér qiě chéng shí ， nǐ yǒu xū yào de huà kě yǐ qǐng tā xié zhù 。
en: He's not only modest but honest. You can ask him if you need him.

zh: 他在我們公司負責的業務是交通意外保險。
py: tā zài wǒ men gōng sī fù zé de yè wù shì jiāo tōng yì wài bǎo xiǎn 。
en: He's in charge of traffic accident insurance in our company.

zh: 我是家中第二個兒子，大哥比我大三歲，平常相處得還不錯。
py: wǒ shì jiā zhōng dì èr gè ér zi ， dà gē bǐ wǒ dà sān suì ， píng cháng xiāng chù dé hái bù cuò 。
en: I'm the second son of my family. I'm three years older than I am. I usually get along well.

zh: 到新公司報到以前，應先把個人的態度及觀念調整好。
py: dào xīn gōng sī bào dào yǐ qián ， yīng xiān bǎ gè rén de tài dù jí guān niàn diào zhěng hǎo 。
en: Before the new company returns, it should adjust its personal attitudes and perceptions.

zh: 今明兩天的天氣可能從晴天轉雨天，出門前記得帶傘。
py: jīn míng liǎng tiān de tiān qì kě néng cóng qíng tiān zhuǎn yǔ tiān ， chū mén qián jì dé dài sǎn 。
en: Tomorrow or tomorrow, the weather may turn from the sun to the rain, with an umbrella before leaving the house.

zh: 這臺洗衣機不轉了，請你拿去修理一下。
py: zhè tái xǐ yī jī bù zhuǎn le ， qǐng nǐ ná qù xiū lǐ yī xià 。
en: This washing machine won't change. Please take it and fix it.

zh: 每個國家打招呼的方式都不太一樣。
py: měi gè guó jiā dǎ zhāo hū de fāng shì dōu bù tài yī yàng 。
en: The way each country greets each other is not the same.

zh: 哇！這家小吃店的臭豆腐好辣、好臭哇！怎麼有客人受的了這種味道哇？
py: wa ！ zhè jiā xiǎo chī diàn de chòu dòu fǔ hǎo là 、 hǎo chòu wa ！ zěn me yǒu kè rén shòu de le zhè zhǒng wèi dào wa ？
en: Wow, the stench of this snack shop is so hot, it stinks! Why does it smell like this?

zh: 隔壁家的小子相當懂事，附近的鄰居們都很喜歡他。
py: gé bì jiā de xiǎo zi xiāng dāng dǒng shì ， fù jìn de lín jū men dōu hěn xǐ huān tā 。
en: The kids in the next house are very good at it, and the neighbors around here love him.

zh: 要想擁有好身材，除了注意營養，還得多運動。
py: yào xiǎng yōng yǒu hǎo shēn cái ， chú le zhù yì yíng yǎng ， hái dé duō yùn dòng 。
en: In order to have a good body, there's much more to do than care for nutrition.

zh: 臺北當地的夜市有很多好吃的宵夜，改天我帶你去嘗嘗。
py: tái běi dāng dì de yè shì yǒu hěn duō hǎo chī de xiāo yè ， gǎi tiān wǒ dài nǐ qù cháng cháng 。
en: There's a lot of good snacks in Taipei's local night market, and I'll take you there sometime.

zh: 那家義大利餐廳太貴了，除非打折，要不然我不會去。
py: nà jiā yì dà lì cān tīng tài guì le ， chú fēi dǎ zhé ， yào bù rán wǒ bù huì qù 。
en: The Italian restaurant is too expensive for me to go unless there's a discount.

zh: 在國外遇見好久沒聯絡的好友，是一件很開心的事情。
py: zài guó wài yù jiàn hǎo jiǔ méi lián luò de hǎo yǒu ， shì yī jiàn hěn kāi xīn de shì qíng 。
en: It's a pleasure to meet a friend who hasn't been in touch for a long time abroad.

zh: 你等一下要幹嘛？要不要跟我們一起去看電影？
py: nǐ děng yí xià yào gàn ma ？ yào bù yào gēn wǒ men yì qǐ qù kàn diàn yǐng ？
en: What are you going to do later? You want to go to the movies with us?

zh: 為了愛惜食物資源，同時也幫助生活困難的家庭，張老闆決定在國內開幾家食物銀行。
py: wèi le ài xī shí wù zī yuán ， tóng shí yě bāng zhù shēng huó kùn nán de jiā tíng ， zhāng lǎo bǎn jué dìng zài guó nèi kāi jǐ jiā shí wù yín xíng 。
en: In an effort to love food resources and to help families living in difficult circumstances, Mr. Zhang has decided to open several food banks in the country.

zh: 自己開店做老闆，事事都得自己來，其實不太容易。
py: zì jǐ kāi diàn zuò lǎo bǎn ， shì shì dōu dé zì jǐ lái ， qí shí bù tài róng yì 。
en: It's not easy for you to start your own business.

zh: 這家店的咖啡很好喝，你有他們的名片嗎？
py: zhè jiā diàn de kā fēi hěn hǎo hē ， nǐ yǒu tā men de míng piàn ma ？
en: The coffee's good in this place. Do you have their cards?

zh: 危險物品必須放在小朋友伸手拿不到的地方。
py: wēi xiǎn wù pǐn bì xū fàng zài xiǎo péng yǒu shēn shǒu ná bú dào de dì fāng 。
en: Dangerous goods must be left where children cannot reach.

zh: 覺得累的時候，可以伸伸雙手雙腳，讓身體動一動。
py: jué dé lèi de shí hòu ， kě yǐ shēn shēn shuāng shǒu shuāng jiǎo ， ràng shēn tǐ dòng yī dòng 。
en: When you're tired, you can stretch your hands and feet and move your body.

zh: 從小我父母就去世了，一直是我大哥、大嫂在照顧我的。
py: cóng xiǎo wǒ fù mǔ jiù qù shì le ， yì zhí shì wǒ dà gē 、 dà sǎo zài zhào gù wǒ de 。
en: My parents died as a child, and my brother and sister-in-law took care of me.

zh: 要是你有看電視的空，就幫我把髒衣服放到洗衣機裡吧。
py: yào shì nǐ yǒu kàn diàn shì de kōng ， jiù bāng wǒ bǎ zāng yī fú fàng dào xǐ yī jī lǐ ba 。
en: If you're free to watch TV, help me put my dirty clothes in the washing machine.

zh: 我有很急的事找張先生，請他到辦公室後回電，謝謝。
py: wǒ yǒu hěn jí de shì zhǎo zhāng xiān shēng ， qǐng tā dào bàn gōng shì hòu huí diàn ， xiè xiè 。
en: I'm in a hurry to find Mr. Cheung and call him back when he gets to the office. Thank you.

zh: 收到別人的信時，應該回信告訴對方收到了，這是一種禮貌。
py: shōu dào bié rén de xìn shí ， yīng gāi huí xìn gào sù duì fāng shōu dào le ， zhè shì yī zhǒng lǐ mào 。
en: It is a courtesy to reply to others when they receive them.

zh: 在臺灣，收到禮物的人要找機會回禮，表達自己的感謝。
py: zài tái wān ， shōu dào lǐ wù de rén yào zhǎo jī huì huí lǐ ， biǎo dá zì jǐ de gǎn xiè 。
en: In Taiwan, those who received gifts sought a chance to return their gifts and express their gratitude.

zh: 昨晚我接了好幾通沒有聲音的電話，真的很討厭。
py: zuó wǎn wǒ jiē le hǎo jǐ tōng méi yǒu shēng yīn de diàn huà ， zhēn de hěn tǎo yàn 。
en: I took several phone calls last night without a sound. I really hate it.

zh: 上週末我們去爬山，走到半路時忽然吹起大風來，害我們不得不下山。
py: shàng zhōu mò wǒ men qù pá shān ， zǒu dào bàn lù shí hū rán chuī qǐ dà fēng lái ， hài wǒ men bù dé bù xià shān 。
en: Last weekend, we went up the mountain, halfway to the road, and suddenly the wind blew, forcing us to go down the mountain.

zh: 外面下著大雨，路很滑，請小心開車。
py: wài miàn xià zhù dà yǔ ， lù hěn huá ， qǐng xiǎo xīn kāi chē 。
en: It's raining heavily, the road is slippery, please drive carefully.

zh: 我去樓下的超市買點菜，待會兒做些家鄉菜給你嘗嘗。
py: wǒ qù lóu xià de chāo shì mǎi diǎn cài ， dài huì ér zuò xiē jiā xiāng cài gěi nǐ cháng cháng 。
en: I'll go down to the supermarket and get you some food later.

zh: 你最好別穿著拖鞋去參加正式活動，要不然別人可能認為你不懂禮貌。
py: nǐ zuì hǎo bié chuān zhù tuō xié qù cān jiā zhèng shì huó dòng ， yào bù rán bié rén kě néng rèn wèi nǐ bù dǒng lǐ mào 。
en: You'd better not wear slippers for a formal event, or someone might think you're being rude.

zh: 花蓮那幾家旅館的雙人客房都客滿了，我們還是訂民宿吧。
py: huā lián nà jǐ jiā lǚ guǎn de shuāng rén kè fáng dōu kè mǎn le ， wǒ men hái shì dìng mín sù ba 。
en: The two hotels in Hualian are full of guest rooms. Let's order a house.

zh: 他這幾年因為投資生意發了，婚姻生活也很幸福，運氣非常好。
py: tā zhè jǐ nián yīn wèi tóu zī shēng yì fā le ， hūn yīn shēng huó yě hěn xìng fú ， yùn qì fēi cháng hǎo 。
en: He's been in the business for years, and he's been happily married and lucky.

zh: 想讓別人看得起你，你得先看得起自己。
py: xiǎng ràng bié rén kàn de qǐ nǐ ， nǐ dé xiān kàn de qǐ zì jǐ 。
en: If you want people to look at you, you have to look at yourself first.

zh: 如果看不清楚黑板上的字，你可以靠近一點兒。
py: rú guǒ kàn bù qīng chǔ hēi bǎn shàng de zì ， nǐ kě yǐ kào jìn yī diǎn ér 。
en: If you can't see the words on the board, you can come closer.

zh: 一個人做錯事多半是自己造成的，不能一做錯就怪別人。
py: yī gè rén zuò cuò shì duō bàn shì zì jǐ zào chéng de ， bù néng yī zuò cuò jiù guài bié rén 。
en: Most of the things that one does wrong are self-inflicted and cannot be blamed for doing so.

zh: 有人花大半輩子的時間工作，陪親人的時間卻非常少。
py: yǒu rén huā dà bàn bèi zi de shí jiān gōng zuò ， péi qīn rén de shí jiān què fēi cháng shǎo 。
en: Some spend most of their lives working, while others spend very little time with their relatives.

zh: 心裡很平靜(peaceful)的人，就算居住在人車又多又吵的市區，仍然覺得自在。
py: xīn lǐ hěn píng jìng (peaceful) de rén ， jiù suàn jū zhù zài rén chē yòu duō yòu chǎo de shì qū ， réng rán jué dé zì zài 。
en: People with peaceful hearts still feel comfortable even if they live in urban areas with lots of cars and noise.

zh: 叔叔時常跟我聊他到世界各地旅行的故事，真是有意思。
py: shū shū shí cháng gēn wǒ liáo tā dào shì jiè gè dì lǚ xíng de gù shì ， zhēn shì yǒu yì si 。
en: Uncle used to tell me stories about his travels around the world.

zh: 對我來說，幸福就是在身邊有一群願意互相幫助的好友。
py: duì wǒ lái shuō ， xìng fú jiù shì zài shēn biān yǒu yī qún yuàn yì hù xiāng bāng zhù de hǎo yǒu 。
en: For me, happiness means having friends who want to help each other.

zh: 人與人之間的感情很珍貴，就算擁有再多的錢也買不到。
py: rén yǔ rén zhī jiān de gǎn qíng hěn zhēn guì ， jiù suàn yōng yǒu zài duō de qián yě mǎi bú dào 。
en: People's feelings are precious and cannot be bought even if they have more money.

zh: 他們從小時候就很要好，有困難時一起解決，有好東西也會分給對方。
py: tā men cóng xiǎo shí hòu jiù hěn yào hǎo ， yǒu kùn nán shí yì qǐ jiě jué ， yǒu hǎo dōng xī yě huì fēn gěi duì fāng 。
en: They've been good since they were young, they've been hard to solve together, and they've got good things for each other.

zh: 呀！會議室裡怎麼擺著一個大蛋糕，是誰買的呀？
py: ya ！ huì yì shì lǐ zěn me bǎi zhù yī gè dà dàn gāo ， shì shuí mǎi de ya ？
en: Why is there a big cake in the conference room? Who bought it?

zh: 我已經退休了，不過還時常跟幾位要好的同事通信。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng tuì xiū le ， bù guò hái shí cháng gēn jǐ wèi yào hǎo de tóng shì tōng xìn 。
en: I'm retired, but I often communicate with some of my best colleagues.

zh: 大家都喜歡很貴的手機，可是他就不喜歡，覺得能用就好。
py: dà jiā dōu xǐ huān hěn guì de shǒu jī ， kě shì tā jiù bù xǐ huān ， jué dé néng yòng jiù hǎo 。
en: Everybody likes expensive phones, but he doesn't like them, and he thinks it works.

zh: 前天我收到大學的來信，才知道我被錄取了，真開心。
py: qián tiān wǒ shōu dào dà xué de lái xìn ， cái zhī dào wǒ bèi lù qǔ le ， zhēn kāi xīn 。
en: I got a letter from the university the other day, and it was so good to know that I was hired.

zh: 我看見路口有人舉著一面牌子，上面是銷售房屋的廣告。
py: wǒ kàn jiàn lù kǒu yǒu rén jǔ zhù yí miàn pái zi ， shàng miàn shì xiāo shòu fáng wū de guǎng gào 。
en: I saw a sign on the roadside with an advertisement for the sale of the house.

zh: 雖然我是臺灣人，不過臺灣有一些地方我可是從來都沒去過。
py: suī rán wǒ shì tái wān rén ， bù guò tái wān yǒu yī xiē dì fāng wǒ kě shì cóng lái dōu méi qù guò 。
en: Although I'm from Taiwan, there are places in Taiwan I've never been.

zh: 寄掛號信雖然貴了一點兒，可是比較可靠。
py: jì guà hào xìn suī rán guì le yī diǎn ér ， kě shì bǐ jiào kě kào 。
en: It's a little expensive, but it's more reliable.

zh: 小王做事非常粗心，因此公司一直不敢把重要的業務交給他。
py: xiǎo wáng zuò shì fēi cháng cū xīn ， yīn cǐ gōng sī yì zhí bù gǎn bǎ zhòng yào de yè wù jiāo gěi tā 。
en: Wang is very careless, so the company has been afraid to hand over important business to him.

zh: 我玩了整晚的手機遊戲，結果第二天差點被爸爸打一頓。
py: wǒ wán le zhěng wǎn de shǒu jī yóu xì ， jié guǒ dì èr tiān chà diǎn bèi bà bà dǎ yī dùn 。
en: I played the phone game all night, and Dad almost hit me the next day.

zh: 他對自己很小氣，可是對朋友卻很大方。
py: tā duì zì jǐ hěn xiǎo qì ， kě shì duì péng yǒu què hěn dà fāng 。
en: He's mean to himself, but generous to his friends.

zh: 明天的露營活動還欠什麼東西？我可以帶過來。
py: míng tiān de lù yíng huó dòng hái qiàn shén me dōng xī ？ wǒ kě yǐ dài guò lái 。
en: What do you owe me for camping tomorrow? I can bring it over.

zh: 剛剛大家推來推去的，結果把瓶子給打破了，這算誰的錯？
py: gāng gāng dà jiā tuī lái tuī qù de ， jié guǒ bǎ píng zi gěi dǎ pò le ， zhè suàn shuí de cuò ？
en: What's wrong with breaking the bottle?

zh: 隨著科技越來越進步，手機的功能也越來越多。
py: suí zhù kē jì yuè lái yuè jìn bù ， shǒu jī de gōng néng yě yuè lái yuè duō 。
en: As technology progresses, so does mobile phones.

zh: 我們約好下星期一在線上開會，討論辦員工運動會的事情。
py: wǒ men yuē hǎo xià xīng qī yī zài xiàn shàng kāi huì ， tǎo lùn bàn yuán gōng yùn dòng huì de shì qíng 。
en: We have an online meeting next Monday to discuss staff sports.

zh: 華人過新年時，如果到好友家拜訪，都會帶著禮物。
py: huá rén guò xīn nián shí ， rú guǒ dào hǎo yǒu jiā bài fǎng ， dōu huì dài zhù lǐ wù 。
en: When a man is in his new year, when he comes to his good friend's house, he carries a gift.

zh: 我跟朋友的愛好一樣，都喜歡露營。
py: wǒ gēn péng yǒu de ài hǎo yī yàng ， dōu xǐ huān lù yíng 。
en: Like friends, I like camping.

zh: 我心中有兩個夢想，一是當歌星，另一個是去各國旅行。
py: wǒ xīn zhōng yǒu liǎng gè mèng xiǎng ， yī shì dāng gē xīng ， lìng yī gè shì qù gè guó lǚ xíng 。
en: I have two dreams in my heart, one to be a singer and the other to travel to various countries.

zh: 個子小的人，不見得力量也小。
py: gè zi xiǎo de rén ， bù jiàn dé lì liàng yě xiǎo 。
en: Small people, they're not as powerful as small.

zh: 他有一點兒膽小，又容易緊張，我看這件事你先別告訴他。
py: tā yǒu yī diǎn ér dǎn xiǎo ， yòu róng yì jǐn zhāng ， wǒ kàn zhè jiàn shì nǐ xiān bié gào sù tā 。
en: He's a little timid and nervous. Don't tell him about it.

zh: 你要大膽一點兒，不喜歡的事情就拒絕。
py: nǐ yào dà dǎn yī diǎn ér ， bù xǐ huān de shì qíng jiù jù jué 。
en: You have to be bold and turn down something you don't like.

zh: 有的父母讓孩子嘗試打工，是為了讓孩子更加獨立。
py: yǒu de fù mǔ ràng hái zi cháng shì dǎ gōng ， shì wèi le ràng hái zi gèng jiā dú lì 。
en: Some parents let their children try to work in order to make them more independent.

zh: 父母對孩子表現的肯定，就是給孩子最好的鼓勵。
py: fù mǔ duì hái zi biǎo xiàn de kěn dìng ， jiù shì gěi hái zi zuì hǎo de gǔ lì 。
en: A parent's affirmation of a child's performance is the best encouragement for the child.

zh: 我剛剛忘了把垃圾拿出去丟，還好你提醒我。
py: wǒ gāng gāng wàng le bǎ lā jī ná chū qù diū ， hái hǎo nǐ tí xǐng wǒ 。
en: I just forgot to take the trash out and throw it. Good thing you reminded me.

zh: 跟別人握手時，握得太久或太緊都是沒有禮貌的行為。
py: gēn bié rén wò shǒu shí ， wò dé tài jiǔ huò tài jǐn dōu shì méi yǒu lǐ mào de xíng wèi 。
en: It is not polite to shake hands too long or too tight.

zh: 前幾天他們因為一點兒小誤會吵了一架，還好現在和好了。
py: qián jǐ tiān tā men yīn wèi yī diǎn ér xiǎo wù huì chǎo le yī jià ， hái hǎo xiàn zài hé hǎo le 。
en: They had a fight the other day over a little misunderstanding, and it's a good thing they're making up now.

zh: 有人說，想了解一個人的真心，就得看他做的事、他說的話。
py: yǒu rén shuō ， xiǎng liǎo jiě yī gè rén de zhēn xīn ， jiù dé kàn tā zuò de shì 、 tā shuō de huà 。
en: Some say that if you want to know a person's heart, you have to see what he does and what he says.

zh: 人人都有屬於自己的長處，要對自己更有信心。
py: rén rén dōu yǒu shǔ yú zì jǐ de zhǎng chù ， yào duì zì jǐ gèng yǒu xìn xīn 。
en: Every human being has his or her own merits, and he or she must have more faith in himself or herself.

zh: 剛學的詞和語法最好常使用、多複習，如此才能加深記憶。
py: gāng xué de cí hé yǔ fǎ zuì hǎo cháng shǐ yòng 、 duō fù xí ， rú cǐ cái néng jiā shēn jì yì 。
en: Newly learned words and grammar are best used and repeated so that memory can be deepened.

zh: 他跟我道歉時一點兒誠意都沒有，所以我不會原諒他。
py: tā gēn wǒ dào qiàn shí yī diǎn ér chéng yì dōu méi yǒu ， suǒ yǐ wǒ bù huì yuán liàng tā 。
en: He apologized to me for not being honest, so I won't forgive him.

zh: 想吃得安心、吃得健康，自己親手做是必需的。
py: xiǎng chī dé ān xīn 、 chī dé jiàn kāng ， zì jǐ qīn shǒu zuò shì bì xū de 。
en: To be comfortable and healthy, it is necessary to do it with your own hands.

zh: 答應別人的事就要做到，這才是有信用的人。
py: dá yīng bié rén de shì jiù yào zuò dào ， zhè cái shì yǒu xìn yòng de rén 。
en: You have to do what you have to do. That's the man with the credit.

zh: 機會來了就應該好好把握，不然就太可惜了。
py: jī huì lái le jiù yīng gāi hǎo hǎo bǎ wò ， bù rán jiù tài kě xī le 。
en: It would be a shame to take advantage of the opportunity.

zh: 這家醫院昨天半夜發生嚴重的火災，受傷的人數約有三十名。
py: zhè jiā yī yuàn zuó tiān bàn yè fā shēng yán zhòng de huǒ zāi ， shòu shāng de rén shù yuē yǒu sān shí míng 。
en: The hospital suffered a serious fire in the middle of the night, injuring about 30 people.

zh: 下週五有上百位家長會到我們學校，一同參加全校運動會。
py: xià zhōu wǔ yǒu shàng bǎi wèi jiā zhǎng huì dào wǒ men xué xiào ， yī tóng cān jiā quán xiào yùn dòng huì 。
en: Next Friday, hundreds of parents will come to our school and join us in the whole school Games.

zh: 想找吃喝玩樂的朋友不難，想有一位知心的朋友卻不容易。
py: xiǎng zhǎo chī hē wán lè de péng yǒu bù nán ， xiǎng yǒu yī wèi zhī xīn de péng yǒu què bù róng yì 。
en: It is not difficult to find friends who want to eat and have fun, but it is not easy to have a friend who knows his heart.

zh: 這幾年由於市長積極實行交通建設計畫，使當地交通情況明顯改善了。
py: zhè jǐ nián yóu yú shì zhǎng jī jí shí xíng jiāo tōng jiàn shè jì huà ， shǐ dāng dì jiāo tōng qíng kuàng míng xiǎn gǎi shàn le 。
en: As a result of the mayor's active and efficient transport project, the local traffic situation has improved significantly in the last few years.

zh: 我要去郵局辦事，有什麼事要我順便替你辦的嗎？
py: wǒ yào qù yóu jú bàn shì ， yǒu shén me shì yào wǒ shùn biàn tì nǐ bàn de ma ？
en: I'm going to the post office. Is there anything I can do for you?

zh: 我姑姑跟姑丈結婚已經有二十年了，感情一直很好。
py: wǒ gū gū gēn gū zhàng jié hūn yǐ jīng yǒu èr shí nián le ， gǎn qíng yì zhí hěn hǎo 。
en: My aunt and uncle have been married for 20 years.

zh: 圖書館入口那裡寫著不能帶食物進去，你吃完再進去吧。
py: tú shū guǎn rù kǒu nà lǐ xiě zhù bù néng dài shí wù jìn qù ， nǐ chī wán zài jìn qù ba 。
en: It says in the entrance to the library that you can't bring food in.

zh: A:哎，有沒有看見我的錢包？ B:哎，你怎麼又在找東西了呢？ A:哎，年紀大了就是這樣？ B:哎，你還年輕呢！讓我幫你一起找吧。
py: A: āi ， yǒu méi yǒu kàn jiàn wǒ de qián bāo ？ B: āi ， nǐ zěn me yòu zài zhǎo dōng xī le ne ？ A: āi ， nián jì dà le jiù shì zhè yàng ？ B: āi ， nǐ hái nián qīng ne ！ ràng wǒ bāng nǐ yì qǐ zhǎo ba 。
en: A: hey, have you seen my wallet? B: hey, why are you looking for something? A: hey, that's how old you are? B: hey, you're young. Let me help you find something.

zh: 他大哥跟大嫂是同年同月同日生的，真是太巧了。
py: tā dà gē gēn dà sǎo shì tóng nián tóng yuè tóng rì shēng de ， zhēn shì tài qiǎo le 。
en: It was a coincidence that his brother and sister-in-law were born on the same day.

zh: 在這家網路書店購買商品，顧客得先匯款。一般購物網站都是等收到顧客的匯款後，才寄出商品的。
py: zài zhè jiā wǎng lù shū diàn gòu mǎi shāng pǐn ， gù kè dé xiān huì kuǎn 。  yì bān gòu wù wǎng zhàn dōu shì děng shōu dào gù kè de huì kuǎn hòu ， cái jì chū shāng pǐn de 。
en: The Internet bookstore buys goods, and customers have to pay for them first.

zh: 這家公司非常重視每位客戶的需求。
py: zhè jiā gōng sī fēi cháng zhòng shì měi wèi kè hù de xū qiú 。
en: The company takes every client's needs very seriously.

zh: 他這個月花了太多錢，因此連水電費、房租都繳不出來。
py: tā zhè gè yuè huā le tài duō qián ， yīn cǐ lián shuǐ diàn fèi 、 fáng zū dōu jiǎo bù chū lái 。
en: He spent too much money this month, so he couldn't even pay for the water and electricity and the rent.

zh: 這面牆壁上的圖畫真美，是誰畫的？
py: zhè miàn qiáng bì shàng de tú huà zhēn měi ， shì shuí huà de ？
en: It's a beautiful picture of the wall. Who drew it?

zh: 天哪！這次期末考真不容易呀，要是考不好被當了，怎麼辦哪？
py: tiān nǎ ！ zhè cì qī mò kǎo zhēn bù róng yì ya ， yào shì kǎo bù hǎo bèi dāng le ， zěn me bàn nǎ ？
en: Oh, my God, it's a tough final. What if it doesn't work out?

zh: 這種鬧鐘有點特別，響了以後得按三下才能關掉。
py: zhè zhǒng nào zhōng yǒu diǎn tè bié ， xiǎng le yǐ hòu dé àn sān xià cái néng guān diào 。
en: This alarm clock is a little special. It'll have to be pressed three times before it's off.

zh: 自從有了抽號機以後，人們就不需要站著排隊了。
py: zì cóng yǒu le chōu hào jī yǐ hòu ， rén men jiù bù xū yào zhàn zhù pái duì le 。
en: People don't have to stand in line since they've got a pump.

zh: 現在的手機都具有語音轉成文字的功能，用來記錄事情非常便利。
py: xiàn zài de shǒu jī dōu jù yǒu yǔ yīn zhuǎn chéng wén zì de gōng néng ， yòng lái jì lù shì qíng fēi cháng biàn lì 。
en: Now all mobile phones have a voice-to-text function, which is very easy to record.

zh: 他說的華語帶點兒家鄉口音，聽起來很親切。
py: tā shuō de huá yǔ dài diǎn ér jiā xiāng kǒu yīn ， tīng qǐ lái hěn qīn qiè 。
en: He speaks Chinese with a bit of a native accent, which sounds kind of nice.

zh: 要是你在百貨公司掉了東西，可以去服務中心的櫃臺問問。
py: yào shì nǐ zài bǎi huò gōng sī diào le dōng xī ， kě yǐ qù fú wù zhōng xīn de guì tái wèn wèn 。
en: If you drop something at the department store, you can ask at the service desk.

zh: 我去醫院看完病後，醫生給了我一張單子去櫃檯付錢和領藥。
py: wǒ qù yī yuàn kàn wán bìng hòu ， yī shēng gěi le wǒ yī zhāng dān zi qù guì tái fù qián hé lǐng yào 。
en: After I went to the hospital, the doctor gave me a list to pay for and take medicine.

zh: 一個人的想法會隨著身分、角色的不同而改變。
py: yī gè rén de xiǎng fǎ huì suí zhù shēn fèn 、 jué sè de bù tóng ér gǎi biàn 。
en: A person's thoughts change with different identities and roles.

zh: 您想辦簽證的話，請先準備好相關證件再來辦理。
py: nín xiǎng bàn qiān zhèng de huà ， qǐng xiān zhǔn bèi hǎo xiāng guān zhèng jiàn zài lái bàn lǐ 。
en: If you wish to issue a visa, please prepare the relevant documents before processing them.

zh: 學習是別人無法代你去做的，得親自來。
py: xué xí shì bié rén wú fǎ dài nǐ qù zuò de ， dé qīn zì lái 。
en: You can't do it on your behalf. You have to do it yourself.

zh: 身分證是用來證明一個人的身分時使用的。
py: shēn fèn zhèng shì yòng lái zhèng míng yī gè rén de shēn fèn shí shǐ yòng de 。
en: The identity card is used to prove a person's identity.

zh: 銀行裡有很多種表格，看你辦什麼事，就用什麼表格。
py: yín xíng lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhǒng biǎo gé ， kàn nǐ bàn shén me shì ， jiù yòng shén me biǎo gé 。
en: There's a lot of forms in the bank, whatever you do, you use them.

zh: 我老婆最近又忙又累，因此我特地在餐桌上頭擺了她最愛的紅玫瑰，讓她開心一下。為了打開(to open up)國外市場，公司上頭決定增加網路銷售方面的經費。
py: wǒ lǎo pó zuì jìn yòu máng yòu lèi ， yīn cǐ wǒ tè dì zài cān zhuō shàng tóu bǎi le tā zuì ài de hóng méi guī ， ràng tā kāi xīn yī xià 。  wèi le dǎ kāi (to open up) guó wài shì chǎng ， gōng sī shàng tóu jué dìng zēng jiā wǎng lù xiāo shòu fāng miàn de jīng fèi 。
en: My wife has been busy and tired lately, so I put her favorite red rose on the table to make her happy. To open up, the company decided to increase the cost of Internet sales.

zh: 在我們學校，上課時是不能使用手機的，連老師也不能破壞規定。那所學校規定學生不能帶手機上學，是希望他們專心學習。
py: zài wǒ men xué xiào ， shàng kè shí shì bù néng shǐ yòng shǒu jī de ， lián lǎo shī yě bù néng pò huài guī dìng 。  nà suǒ xué xiào guī dìng xué shēng bù néng dài shǒu jī shàng xué ， shì xī wàng tā men zhuān xīn xué xí 。
en: In our school, you can't use a cell phone, even a teacher can't break the rules. The school's rule is that students can't take a cell phone to school.

zh: 出國旅遊的時候，能帶的現金是有限制的。
py: chū guó lǚ yóu de shí hòu ， néng dài de xiàn jīn shì yǒu xiàn zhì de 。
en: There are limits to the cash that can be brought when travelling abroad.

zh: 國內幾家銀行決定從明年起，降低跨行匯款的手續費。
py: guó nèi jǐ jiā yín xíng jué dìng cóng míng nián qǐ ， jiàng dī kuà xíng huì kuǎn de shǒu xù fèi 。
en: Several banks in the country have decided to reduce the costs of cross-border transfers starting next year.

zh: 那輛腳踏車對個子小的我來說太高了，腳很難跨過去。我們大學前年起已開放跨校選課，增加各校的交流機會。
py: nà liàng jiǎo tà chē duì gè zi xiǎo de wǒ lái shuō tài gāo le ， jiǎo hěn nán kuà guò qù 。  wǒ men dà xué qián nián qǐ yǐ kāi fàng kuà xiào xuǎn kè ， zēng jiā gè xiào de jiāo liú jī huì 。
en: The bike was too tall for me to cross for a small one.   We've been running cross-schools since the year before college, increasing the opportunities for schools to communicate.

zh: 收到帳單的時候得準時去繳費，以免超過時間後得繳更多錢。
py: shōu dào zhàng dān de shí hòu dé zhǔn shí qù jiǎo fèi ， yǐ miǎn chāo guò shí jiān hòu dé jiǎo gèng duō qián 。
en: The bill must be paid on time so that more money will not be paid beyond that time.

zh: 窗外正下著大雨，我又沒帶傘，看來得在公司多留一會兒了。
py: chuāng wài zhèng xià zhù dà yǔ ， wǒ yòu méi dài sǎn ， kàn lái dé zài gōng sī duō liú yī huì ér le 。
en: It's raining a lot out of the window, and I don't have an umbrella. It looks like I'm staying at the company for a while.

zh: 如果你想到菲律賓旅行，還是帶著美金到當地換錢比較方便。
py: rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng dào fēi lǜ bīn lǚ xíng ， hái shì dài zhù měi jīn dào dāng dì huàn qián bǐ jiào fāng biàn 。
en: If you want to travel to the Philippines, it's easier to change money with US dollars.

zh: 中國開放國內投資後，想投資人民幣的人也越來越多了。
py: zhōng guó kāi fàng guó nèi tóu zī hòu ， xiǎng tóu zī rén mín bì de rén yě yuè lái yuè duō le 。
en: More and more people want to invest in the renminbi after China has opened up its investments in the country.

zh: 週末的時候，火車站的賣票窗口總是排滿了人。
py: zhōu mò de shí hòu ， huǒ chē zhàn de mài piào chuāng kǒu zǒng shì pái mǎn le rén 。
en: By the end of the week, the ticket sales window at the train station was always full of people.

zh: 這家公司雖然要求員工得穿西裝上班，但費用全是公司負擔的。
py: zhè jiā gōng sī suī rán yāo qiú yuán gōng dé chuān xī zhuāng shàng bān ， dàn fèi yòng quán shì gōng sī fù dān de 。
en: Although the company requires employees to wear suits to work, the costs are all at the company's expense.

zh: 要是新買的商品有問題，七天以內可帶收據到店裡處理。
py: yào shì xīn mǎi de shāng pǐn yǒu wèn tí ， qī tiān yǐ nèi kě dài shōu jù dào diàn lǐ chù lǐ 。
en: If there is a problem with the newly purchased goods, the receipts can be brought to the store within seven days.

zh: 那家餐廳的服務生很貼心，只要客人一上門，立刻提供面紙給客人擦手。
py: nà jiā cān tīng de fú wù shēng hěn tiē xīn ， zhǐ yào kè rén yī shàng mén ， lì kè tí gōng miàn zhǐ gěi kè rén cā shǒu 。
en: The waiter at the restaurant was very kind, and as soon as the guests came to the door, they were provided with tissue to wipe their hands.

zh: 這份文件很急，請你下班以前傳真給對方公司。
py: zhè fèn wén jiàn hěn jí ， qǐng nǐ xià bān yǐ qián chuán zhēn gěi duì fāng gōng sī 。
en: This is a very urgent document. Please fax it to each other before you close work.

zh: 老闆說，除了緊急情況，下班時間別打電話找他。
py: lǎo bǎn shuō ， chú le jǐn jí qíng kuàng ， xià bān shí jiān bié dǎ diàn huà zhǎo tā 。
en: The boss said not to call him after work, except in case of emergency.

zh: 有張紙卡在傳真機裡，你拿得出來嗎？
py: yǒu zhāng zhǐ kǎ zài chuán zhēn jī lǐ ， nǐ ná dé chū lái ma ？
en: There's a card in the fax machine. Can you get it out?

zh: 到銀行開戶，必須本人親自去辦理。
py: dào yín xíng kāi hù ， bì xū běn rén qīn zì qù bàn lǐ 。
en: If you open a bank, you must take care of it yourself.

zh: 我的鞋底快要掉下來了，得去店裡請人把它粘起來。他不管我忙不忙，老是黏著我聊天，讓我覺得有點煩。夏天的時候容易流汗，讓衣服變得黏黏的，真不舒服。
py: wǒ de xié dǐ kuài yào diào xià lái le ， dé qù diàn lǐ qǐng rén bǎ tā zhān qǐ lái 。  tā bù guǎn wǒ máng bù máng ， lǎo shì nián zhù wǒ liáo tiān ， ràng wǒ jué dé yǒu diǎn fán 。  xià tiān de shí hòu róng yì liú hàn ， ràng yī fú biàn dé nián nián de ， zhēn bù shū fú 。
en: My soles were about to fall and I had to go to the store and ask someone to stick it up. He kept chatting with me, whether I was busy or not, and it made me a little tired. It made it easier to sweat in the summer to make my clothes sticky and uncomfortable.

zh: 印章也叫圖章，華人常在重要的文件上使用印章。
py: yìn zhāng yě jiào tú zhāng ， huá rén cháng zài zhòng yào de wén jiàn shàng shǐ yòng yìn zhāng 。
en: The stamp is also called a stamp, and Chinese often use it on important documents.

zh: 冰店的生意好壞得看季節，冬天的生意總是不如夏天。
py: bīng diàn de shēng yì hǎo huài dé kàn jì jié ， dōng tiān de shēng yì zǒng shì bù rú xià tiān 。
en: The ice shop's business is as bad as the season, and winter's business is always worse than summer.

zh: 教授打算向學校申請一筆經費，進行高山地區的調查計畫。
py: jiào shòu dǎ suàn xiàng xué xiào shēn qǐng yī bǐ jīng fèi ， jìn xíng gāo shān dì qū de diào chá jì huà 。
en: The professor intends to apply to the school for a fee to carry out an investigation project in the highlands.

zh: 在網路上，商品的交易雖然方便，但也應注意安全問題。許小姐知道社團網友想賣手機，就拿二手(second hand)筆電去交易，結果對方同意了。
py: zài wǎng lù shàng ， shāng pǐn de jiāo yì suī rán fāng biàn ， dàn yě yīng zhù yì ān quán wèn tí 。  xǔ xiǎo jiě zhī dào shè tuán wǎng yǒu xiǎng mài shǒu jī ， jiù ná èr shǒu (second hand) bǐ diàn qù jiāo yì ， jié guǒ duì fāng tóng yì le 。
en: On the Internet, commodities are easy to trade, but security concerns should be addressed as well. Ms.   knows that the network wants to sell cell phones, and takes second hand hands, and the other side agrees.

zh: 老是忘記東西不見得是因為個性迷糊，也可能與健康有關。
py: lǎo shì wàng jì dōng xī bù jiàn dé shì yīn wèi gè xìng mí hū ， yě kě néng yǔ jiàn kāng yǒu guān 。
en: Always forgetting that things are missing because of personality confusion or health-related problems.

zh: 公司交給你的支票記得要收好，別弄丟了。
py: gōng sī jiāo gěi nǐ de zhī piào jì dé yào shōu hǎo ， bié nòng diū le 。
en: Keep your check from the company and don't lose it.

zh: 你上班別遲到，小心公司扣你的錢！
py: nǐ shàng bān bié chí dào ， xiǎo xīn gōng sī kòu nǐ de qián ！
en: Don't be late for work. Watch your money!

zh: 我剛來臺灣，不知道怎麼在銀行開戶存錢，請教我怎麼申請。
py: wǒ gāng lái tái wān ， bù zhī dào zěn me zài yín xíng kāi hù cún qián ， qǐng jiào wǒ zěn me shēn qǐng 。
en: I've just come to Taiwan, and I don't know how to open a bank. Please teach me how to apply.

zh: 有幾位學生的期中考沒考好，教授要他們下星期補考。出門上班前，我才發現短裙破了，不得不先補號再去上班，結果就遲到了。
py: yǒu jǐ wèi xué shēng de qī zhōng kǎo méi kǎo hǎo ， jiào shòu yào tā men xià xīng qī bǔ kǎo 。  chū mén shàng bān qián ， wǒ cái fā xiàn duǎn qún pò le ， bù dé bù xiān bǔ hào zài qù shàng bān ， jié guǒ jiù chí dào le 。
en: Several students failed their midterms, and the professor asked them to resume next week. Before   went out to work, I discovered that the skirts were broken and had to be filled before going to work, and then I was late.

zh: 媽媽常一邊看做菜節目，一邊把作法抄下來。
py: mā mā cháng yī biān kàn zuò cài jié mù ， yī biān bǎ zuò fǎ chāo xià lái 。
en: Mom used to watch the food show and copy it.

zh: 他曾替公司談成了三億美元的生意，因此老闆讓他當經理。
py: tā céng tì gōng sī tán chéng le sān yì měi yuán de shēng yì ， yīn cǐ lǎo bǎn ràng tā dāng jīng lǐ 。
en: He had negotiated a $300 million deal for the company, so the boss put him in charge.

zh: 那位服裝設計師相當喜愛十八世紀時的歐洲傳統風格。
py: nà wèi fú zhuāng shè jì shī xiāng dāng xǐ ài shí bā shì jì shí de ōu zhōu chuán tǒng fēng gé 。
en: The designer of the apparel is quite fond of the 18th century European tradition.

zh: 假如東西買回家後常擺著不用，那樣的消費就是不必要的。在開心消費前應先想想，那些商品是不是需要的。
py: jiǎ rú dōng xī mǎi huí jiā hòu cháng bǎi zhù bù yòng ， nà yàng de xiāo fèi jiù shì bù bì yào de 。  zài kāi xīn xiāo fèi qián yīng xiān xiǎng xiǎng ， nà xiē shāng pǐn shì bú shì xū yào de 。
en: If things are bought and used when they come home, then there's no need for them. Before you're happy about them, think about whether they're needed.

zh: 國外旅行時隨時攜帶護照、信用卡，可讓你玩得安心又順利。
py: guó wài lǚ xíng shí suí shí xié dài hù zhào 、 xìn yòng kǎ ， kě ràng nǐ wán dé ān xīn yòu shùn lì 。
en: Traveling abroad with passports and credit cards at all times will make it easier for you to play well.

zh: 你別把剛領的鈔票放在口袋裡，很容易不見的。
py: nǐ bié bǎ gāng lǐng de chāo piào fàng zài kǒu dài lǐ ， hěn róng yì bù jiàn de 。
en: Don't put the money you just got in your pocket. It's easy not to see.

zh: 我想加入社會服務組織，幫助別人的同時也讓自己成長。
py: wǒ xiǎng jiā rù shè huì fú wù zǔ zhī ， bāng zhù bié rén de tóng shí yě ràng zì jǐ chéng zhǎng 。
en: I want to be a member of social services to help others grow up at the same time.

zh: 刷卡買東西很方便，用讀卡機器刷一下信用卡就能付錢了。
py: shuā kǎ mǎi dōng xī hěn fāng biàn ， yòng dú kǎ jī qì shuā yī xià xìn yòng kǎ jiù néng fù qián le 。
en: It's easy to buy a card, you can pay for a credit card with a reading machine.

zh: 他剛去超市買了一把刷子，想趁週末時好好把浴室刷乾淨。
py: tā gāng qù chāo shì mǎi le yī bǎ shuā zi ， xiǎng chèn zhōu mò shí hǎo hǎo bǎ yù shì shuā qián jìng 。
en: He just went to the supermarket to buy a brush to clean up the bathroom during the weekend.

zh: 在臺灣，碰到緊急情況可撥110，請警察提供協助。
py: zài tái wān ， pèng dào jǐn jí qíng kuàng kě bō 110， qǐng jǐng chá tí gōng xié zhù 。
en: In Taiwan, an emergency can be reached by calling 110 for assistance from the police.

zh: 信用卡的正面和背面都有一組號碼，在線上刷卡時用得到。
py: xìn yòng kǎ de zhèng miàn hé bèi miàn dōu yǒu yī zǔ hào mǎ ， zài xiàn shàng shuā kǎ shí yòng dé dào 。
en: Both the front and the back of the credit cards have a set of numbers that can be used to brush the cards online.

zh: 有一些口罩正面跟反面的差異很小，不過一般來說，正面的顏色較深，反面的顏色較淺。
py: yǒu yī xiē kǒu zhào zhèng miàn gēn fǎn miàn de chà yì hěn xiǎo ， bù guò yì bān lái shuō ， zhèng miàn de yán sè jiào shēn ， fǎn miàn de yán sè jiào qiǎn 。
en: In some cases, the difference between the front and the reverse is small, although in general the color of the front is deeper and the color of the back is lighter.

zh: 以前人們常用磁帶來存電腦的重要資料。
py: yǐ qián rén men cháng yòng cí dài lái cún diàn nǎo de zhòng yào zī liào 。
en: In the past, it was common for people to bring important data from their stored computers through magnetics.

zh: 發展科技對國家來說很重要，不過也應該注意環保問題。
py: fā zhǎn kē jì duì guó jiā lái shuō hěn zhòng yào ， bù guò yě yīng gāi zhù yì huán bǎo wèn tí 。
en: The development of technology is important for the country, but it is also important to pay attention to environmental issues.

zh: 現在的電腦晶片速度越來越快，功能也越來越多了。
py: xiàn zài de diàn nǎo jīng piàn sù dù yuè lái yuè kuài ， gōng néng yě yuè lái yuè duō le 。
en: Now the computer chip is getting faster and more and more functional.

zh: 華語中心的學生想在臺灣的銀行開戶，得先準備在學證明。
py: huá yǔ zhōng xīn de xué shēng xiǎng zài tái wān de yín xíng kāi hù ， dé xiān zhǔn bèi zài xué zhèng míng 。
en: Chinese students who want to open their accounts at banks in Taiwan have to prepare their credentials.

zh: 到國外旅遊時身上別攜帶太多鈔票，否則錢丟了就麻煩了。
py: dào guó wài lǚ yóu shí shēn shàng bié xié dài tài duō chāo piào ， fǒu zé qián diū le jiù má fán le 。
en: Don't carry too much money when you travel abroad, or you'll be in trouble if you lose it.

zh: 你寄報告給老師前最好確認一下地址，萬一老師沒收到，到時你就麻煩了。
py: nǐ jì bào gào gěi lǎo shī qián zuì hǎo què rèn yī xià dì zhǐ ， wàn yī lǎo shī méi shōu dào ， dào shí nǐ jiù má fán le 。
en: You better check the address before you send a report to the teacher. In case you don't get it, you'll be in trouble.

zh: 他做事很慢，時常要人催他。
py: tā zuò shì hěn màn ， shí cháng yào rén cuī tā 。
en: He's slow. He's always been pushed.

zh: 你在銀行存的錢越多，得到的利息也越多。
py: nǐ zài yín xíng cún de qián yuè duō ， dé dào de lì xī yě yuè duō 。
en: The more money you put in the bank, the more interest you get.

zh: 一個人要學會儲蓄，需要用錢的時候，就不必擔心沒錢可用。
py: yī gè rén yào xué huì chǔ xù ， xū yào yòng qián de shí hòu ， jiù bù bì dān xīn méi qián kě yòng 。
en: When a person needs money to learn to save, there is no need to worry about the lack of money.

zh: 手機雖然使生活更便利，但過度使用也可能傷害身心健康。人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
py: shǒu jī suī rán shǐ shēng huó gèng biàn lì ， dàn guò dù shǐ yòng yě kě néng shāng hài shēn xīn jiàn kāng 。  rén lèi guò dù de fā zhǎn huó dòng ， yǐ duì dòng zhí wù de shēng huó huán jìng zào chéng yán zhòng pò huài 。
en: While mobile phones make life easier, excessive use can also harm physical and mental health.   Human excess development has caused severe damage to the living conditions of plants.

zh: 想申請獎學金的話，得先影印你的證件，再把影本寄給學校。
py: xiǎng shēn qǐng jiǎng xué jīn de huà ， dé xiān yǐng yìn nǐ de zhèng jiàn ， zài bǎ yǐng běn jì gěi xué xiào 。
en: If you want to apply for a scholarship, you have to print your papers and send copies to the school.

zh: 我習慣來這家銀行存款，因為這裡的員工都十分親切。你在辦一些國家的簽證時，他們得看你的銀行存款。
py: wǒ xí guàn lái zhè jiā yín xíng cún kuǎn ， yīn wèi zhè lǐ de yuán gōng dōu shí fēn qīn qiè 。  nǐ zài bàn yī xiē guó jiā de qiān zhèng shí ， tā men dé kàn nǐ de yín xíng cún kuǎn 。
en: I'm used to coming to this bank deposit because the employees here are very kind. When you're doing some country visas, they have to look at your bank deposits.

zh: 如果工作太忙，每天最少還是應該運動半個小時，對健康比較好。
py: rú guǒ gōng zuò tài máng ， měi tiān zuì shǎo hái shì yīng gāi yùn dòng bàn gè xiǎo shí ， duì jiàn kāng bǐ jiào hǎo 。
en: If you work too hard, you should at least exercise for half an hour a day, which is better for your health.

zh: 在臺灣鐵路局的網站訂票，一人最多只能訂六張搭車當天的票。
py: zài tái wān tiě lù jú de wǎng zhàn dìng piào ， yī rén zuì duō zhǐ néng dìng liù zhāng dā chē dāng tiān de piào 。
en: A maximum of six tickets per person can be booked on the Taiwan Railways website.

zh: 當你急著需要某個物品時，不管划不划算，都非買不可。
py: dāng nǐ jí zhù xū yào mǒu gè wù pǐn shí ， bù guǎn huà bù huá suàn ， dōu fēi mǎi bù kě 。
en: When you're in a hurry to need something, you have to buy it, whether it's cost-effective or not.

zh: 去郵局領包裹的時候，記得帶身分證、圖章還有通知單。
py: qù yóu jú lǐng bāo guǒ de shí hòu ， jì dé dài shēn fèn zhèng 、 tú zhāng hái yǒu tōng zhī dān 。
en: When you go to the post office to pick up the package, you must bring identification cards, stamps and notice sheets.

zh: 噢，沒問題，你就放心交給我吧。
py: ō ， méi wèn tí ， nǐ jiù fàng xīn jiāo gěi wǒ ba 。
en: Oh, no problem. Just leave it to me.

zh: 他把這塊長方形蛋糕分成兩塊三角形的。
py: tā bǎ zhè kuài zhǎng fāng xíng dàn gāo fēn chéng liǎng kuài sān jiǎo xíng de 。
en: He splits this rectangular cake into two triangles.

zh: 市中心有座正方形的廣場，民眾經常到那裡散步。
py: shì zhōng xīn yǒu zuò zhèng fāng xíng de guǎng chǎng ， mín zhòng jīng cháng dào nà lǐ sàn bù 。
en: There is a square square square in the centre of the city, where people often walk.

zh: A:聽說百貨公司的衣服要降價了，現在降了嗎？ B:夏天的衣服降價了，因為已經開始賣冬天的衣服了。
py: A: tīng shuō bǎi huò gōng sī de yī fú yào jiàng jià le ， xiàn zài jiàng le ma ？ B: xià tiān de yī fú jiàng jià le ， yīn wèi yǐ jīng kāi shǐ mài dōng tiān de yī fú le 。
en: A: Did you hear that the clothing of the department store is going down? B: Summer clothes are going down because they have already started selling winter clothes.

zh: 鞋子的尺寸很重要，太大或是太小都不舒服。
py: xié zi de chǐ cùn hěn zhòng yào ， tài dà huò shì tài xiǎo dōu bù shū fú 。
en: The size of the shoes is important, too big or too small to be comfortable.

zh: 我們無法決定生命的長度，卻能夠決定生活的品質。
py: wǒ men wú fǎ jué dìng shēng mìng de zhǎng dù ， què néng gòu jué dìng shēng huó de pǐn zhì 。
en: We cannot determine the length of life, but we can determine the quality of life.

zh: 你穿的這件衣服肩膀寬度很合適，就是長度太長了，要是能改短一些就好了。
py: nǐ chuān de zhè jiàn yī fú jiān bǎng kuān dù hěn hé shì ， jiù shì zhǎng dù tài zhǎng le ， yào shì néng gǎi duǎn yī xiē jiù hǎo le 。
en: You're wearing this dress with a nice shoulder width, but it's too long, if only for a shorter one.

zh: 這座橋對車子的高度有限制，開大車的人要小心。
py: zhè zuò qiáo duì chē zi de gāo dù yǒu xiàn zhì ， kāi dà chē de rén yào xiǎo xīn 。
en: This bridge has a limit on the height of the car, so be careful who drives the big car.

zh: 搭飛機時，行李的重量是有限制的，大約一件25公斤。
py: dā fēi jī shí ， xíng lǐ de zhòng liàng shì yǒu xiàn zhì de ， dà yuē yī jiàn 25 gōng jīn 。
en: On board the plane, the weight of the luggage was limited, about 25 kilograms per piece.

zh: 上網買鞋子前先比一下腳的大小，才知道選哪個尺寸。
py: shàng wǎng mǎi xié zi qián xiān bǐ yī xià jiǎo de dà xiǎo ， cái zhī dào xuǎn nǎ gè chǐ cùn 。
en: The size of the shoe is better than the size of the foot before you go online to buy it.

zh: 中國與美國之間的貿易問題很嚴重，這個新聞早就上電視了。
py: zhōng guó yǔ měi guó zhī jiān de mào yì wèn tí hěn yán zhòng ， zhè gè xīn wén zǎo jiù shàng diàn shì le 。
en: The trade problem between China and the United States is serious, and the news is already on TV.

zh: 那家超市蔬菜水果的種類很多，可提供民眾較多的選擇。
py: nà jiā chāo shì shū cài shuǐ guǒ de zhǒng lèi hěn duō ， kě tí gōng mín zhòng jiào duō de xuǎn zé 。
en: There are many kinds of vegetables and fruits in the supermarket that provide a larger choice for the population.

zh: 那家文具店賣的文具種類很多，像筆、書包、本子等學生用品，不僅品質好，價錢也不貴。
py: nà jiā wén jù diàn mài de wén jù zhǒng lèi hěn duō ， xiàng bǐ 、 shū bāo 、 běn zi děng xué shēng yòng pǐn ， bù jǐn pǐn zhì hǎo ， jià qián yě bù guì 。
en: The stationery store sold many items of stationery, such as pens, school bags, books, etc., not only of good quality but also of no cost.

zh: 這些跟卡通人物有關書籍，很適合兒童閱讀。
py: zhè xiē gēn kǎ tōng rén wù yǒu guān shū jí ， hěn shì hé ér tóng yuè dú 。
en: These are books about cartoon characters, and they're good for children.

zh: 對上班族來說，上網買牙刷、內衣褲、面紙等日用品，既輕鬆又方便。
py: duì shàng bān zú lái shuō ， shàng wǎng mǎi yá shuā 、 nèi yī kù 、 miàn zhǐ děng rì yòng pǐn ， jì qīng sōng yòu fāng biàn 。
en: For working people, it is easy and convenient to buy daily goods such as toothbrushes, underwear and tissue on the Internet.

zh: 吃了健康食品以後，還是得經常運動才能擁有好身材。
py: chī le jiàn kāng shí pǐn yǐ hòu ， hái shì dé jīng cháng yùn dòng cái néng yōng yǒu hǎo shēn cái 。
en: After eating healthy food, it takes a lot of exercise to get a good body.

zh: 不管做任何事都應先了解情況，省得白花精神。
py: bù guǎn zuò rèn hé shì dōu yīng xiān liǎo jiě qíng kuàng ， shěng de bái huā jīng shén 。
en: Whatever you do, you should know what's going on, save it for nothing.

zh: 送禮品給外國朋友前，最好先了解不同國家的送禮習慣。
py: sòng lǐ pǐn gěi wài guó péng yǒu qián ， zuì hǎo xiān liǎo jiě bù tóng guó jiā de sòng lǐ xí guàn 。
en: Before delivering gifts to foreign friends, it would be better to learn about the customs of gifts in different countries.

zh: 前主任一天到晚做研究，連周末也不休息，這樣身體怎麼受得了？
py: qián zhǔ rèn yī tiān dào wǎn zuò yán jiū ， lián zhōu mò yě bù xiū xī ， zhè yàng shēn tǐ zěn me shòu dé le ？
en: How can a former director work all day, not even on weekends?

zh: 我覺得跳舞這項活動對健康很有幫助，還可以交到很多朋友。
py: wǒ jué dé tiào wǔ zhè xiàng huó dòng duì jiàn kāng hěn yǒu bāng zhù ， hái kě yǐ jiāo dào hěn duō péng yǒu 。
en: I think dancing is good for health and makes a lot of friends.

zh: 按照商品目錄的說明，消費滿五百元可以打八五折。
py: àn zhào shāng pǐn mù lù de shuō míng ， xiāo fèi mǎn wǔ bǎi yuán kě yǐ dǎ bā wǔ zhé 。
en: According to the catalogue, the cost of 500 yuan can be reduced by 80 per cent.

zh: A:這幾雙拖鞋我都喜歡，不知道怎麼挑選？ B:這容易，你挑雙便宜的就好。
py: A: zhè jǐ shuāng tuō xié wǒ dōu xǐ huān ， bù zhī dào zěn me tiāo xuǎn ？ B: zhè róng yì ， nǐ tiāo shuāng pián yi de jiù hǎo 。
en: A: I like these slippers and I don't know how to pick them? B: It's easy. Just pick the cheap ones.

zh: 爸爸挑選西裝時，最重視的是品質，其次才是式樣。
py: bà bà tiāo xuǎn xī zhuāng shí ， zuì zhòng shì de shì pǐn zhì ， qí cì cái shì shì yàng 。
en: When Dad chooses a suit, the quality is the most important, and the style is the second.

zh: 小張的個性比較懶，很少主動幫同事的忙。
py: xiǎo zhāng de gè xìng bǐ jiào lǎn ， hěn shǎo zhǔ dòng bāng tóng shì de máng 。
en: Chang's personality is lazy and rarely helps his colleagues.

zh: 吃完飯到櫃臺結帳前，應該先看清楚帳單有沒有錯。
py: chī wán fàn dào guì tái jié zhàng qián ， yīng gāi xiān kàn qīng chǔ zhàng dān yǒu méi yǒu cuò 。
en: You should see if the bill is correct before you finish your meal at the counter.

zh: 那家禮品店的商品樣式不錯，並且價格合理，所以生意很好。
py: nà jiā lǐ pǐn diàn de shāng pǐn yàng shì bù cuò ， bìng qiě jià gé hé lǐ ， suǒ yǐ shēng yì hěn hǎo 。
en: The gift shop had a good pattern and a reasonable price, so business was good.

zh: 我想出國當背包客，除了能打開視野，並能訓練自己更獨立。
py: wǒ xiǎng chū guó dāng bēi bāo kè ， chú le néng dǎ kāi shì yě ， bìng néng xùn liàn zì jǐ gèng dú lì 。
en: I want to be a backpacker outside the country, besides opening my eyes and training myself to be more independent.

zh: 國外商品來到本國後，賣出的價錢往往比國外高出一兩成。
py: guó wài shāng pǐn lái dào běn guó hòu ， mài chū de jià qián wǎng wǎng bǐ guó wài gāo chū yī liǎng chéng 。
en: When foreign goods arrive in the country, they are often sold at a price of 10 per cent or 20 per cent higher than abroad.

zh: 如果你是那家網路商店的會員，購買任何商品都可以便宜兩成。
py: rú guǒ nǐ shì nà jiā wǎng lù shāng diàn de huì yuán ， gòu mǎi rèn hé shāng pǐn dōu kě yǐ pián yi liǎng chéng 。
en: If you're a member of that Internet store, you can buy 20% of anything.

zh: 學校規定新生必須在開學前一週完成註冊手續。
py: xué xiào guī dìng xīn shēng bì xū zài kāi xué qián yī zhōu wán chéng zhù cè shǒu xù 。
en: School regulations stipulate that a new student must complete the registration process one week before the start of school.

zh: 不斷複習生字卡片能幫我們記住新的字。
py: bù duàn fù xí shēng zì kǎ piàn néng bāng wǒ men jì zhù xīn de zì 。
en: It's not like we're going to be able to remember new words, but we're going to be able to remember new ones.

zh: 室友A:嘿，吃完飯後不能把碗筷擺在桌子讓別人洗喔。室友B:不好意思，我這就去洗。室友A:嘿，你還真聽話(obedient)啊。
py: shì yǒu A: hēi ， chī wán fàn hòu bù néng bǎ wǎn kuài bǎi zài zhuō zi ràng bié rén xǐ ō 。 shì yǒu B: bù hǎo yì sī ， wǒ zhè jiù qù xǐ 。 shì yǒu A: hēi ， nǐ hái zhēn tīng huà (obedient) a 。
en: Roommate A: Hey, don't put chopsticks on the table after dinner. Roomie B: I'm sorry, I'm just going to wash them. Roomie A: Hey, you're really good.

zh: 你搭飛機去美國的話，得確認行李有沒有超過五十磅，多了就得付錢了。
py: nǐ dā fēi jī qù měi guó de huà ， dé què rèn xíng lǐ yǒu méi yǒu chāo guò wǔ shí bàng ， duō le jiù dé fù qián le 。
en: If you fly to America, make sure you have more than 50 pounds of luggage, you'll have to pay for it.

zh: 註了冊以後，新生要把相關證件各影印一份，交給學校。
py: zhù le cè yǐ hòu ， xīn shēng yào bǎ xiāng guān zhèng jiàn gè yǐng yìn yī fèn ， jiāo gěi xué xiào 。
en: Once registered, a copy of the relevant certificate will be given to the school.

zh: 那家工廠的設備及員工都嚴重缺乏，哪裡有辦法進一步發展？
py: nà jiā gōng chǎng de shè bèi jí yuán gōng dōu yán zhòng quē fá ， nǎ lǐ yǒu bàn fǎ jìn yī bù fā zhǎn ？
en: There's a serious lack of equipment and staff at that factory. What can be done to further develop it?

zh: 臺灣的超商有店到店的送貨服務，不但速度快，運費也不貴。
py: tái wān de chāo shāng yǒu diàn dào diàn de sòng huò fú wù ， bù dàn sù dù kuài ， yùn fèi yě bù guì 。
en: Taiwan's supermarket has a delivery service to the shop, which is not only fast but also expensive.

zh: 這幾箱書都是我念過的課本跟參考資料，打算送給育幼院的孩子。
py: zhè jǐ xiāng shū dōu shì wǒ niàn guò de kè běn gēn cān kǎo zī liào ， dǎ suàn sòng gěi yù yòu yuàn de hái zi 。
en: These boxes are books and references I've read and are intended for children in nursing homes.

zh: 過年時什麼都漲，連搭計程車的時候，車費都漲價了。
py: guò nián shí shén me dōu zhǎng ， lián dā jì chéng chē de shí hòu ， chē fèi dōu zhǎng jià le 。
en: Everything went up in the New Year's, even on a taxi, the fare went up.

zh: 百貨公司經常辦活動及送贈品，都是為了鼓勵客人多消費。
py: bǎi huò gōng sī jīng cháng bàn huó dòng jí sòng zèng pǐn ， dōu shì wèi le gǔ lì kè rén duō xiāo fèi 。
en: The department store regularly organizes events and delivers gifts to encourage customers to spend more money.

zh: 小李離婚後才知道失去老婆很痛苦，不過後悔也來不及了。
py: xiǎo lǐ lí hūn hòu cái zhī dào shī qù lǎo pó hěn tòng kǔ ， bù guò hòu huǐ yě lái bù jí le 。
en: It was only after Li's divorce that she learned that it was painful to lose her wife, but it was too late to regret it.

zh: 在臺灣，退火車票得早一點兒，越晚退的話，扣的錢也越多。
py: zài tái wān ， tuì huǒ chē piào dé zǎo yī diǎn ér ， yuè wǎn tuì de huà ， kòu de qián yě yuè duō 。
en: In Taiwan, the earlier the train rolls out, the later it returns, the more money is withheld.

zh: 假如他不聽你的，颱風天堅持去爬山，發生意外也是他活該。
py: jiǎ rú tā bù tīng nǐ de ， tái fēng tiān jiān chí qù pá shān ， fā shēng yì wài yě shì tā huó gāi 。
en: If he doesn't listen to you, he deserves an accident.

zh: 別人對你有誤會的時候用不著生氣，解釋清楚就好。
py: bié rén duì nǐ yǒu wù huì de shí hòu yòng bù zhù shēng qì ， jiě shì qīng chǔ jiù hǎo 。
en: There is no need to be angry when there is a misunderstanding. Just explain it.

zh: 這件事他就可以幫你了，你還用得著去別的地方請人嗎？
py: zhè jiàn shì tā jiù kě yǐ bāng nǐ le ， nǐ hái yòng dé zhù qù bié de dì fāng qǐng rén ma ？
en: He can help you with this. Do you need to go somewhere else?

zh: 購物時不能只看包裝，品質才是最重要的。
py: gòu wù shí bù néng zhǐ kàn bāo zhuāng ， pǐn zhì cái shì zuì zhòng yào de 。
en: The quality is the most important thing when shopping is not just about packaging.

zh: 冷氣機裡的網子要常拆下來洗，不然可能吹出髒空氣。
py: lěng qì jī lǐ de wǎng zi yào cháng chāi xià lái xǐ ， bù rán kě néng chuī chū zāng kōng qì 。
en: The nets in the air conditioners are often removed and washed, otherwise they may blow out the dirty air.

zh: 他的獎學金申請書因少了一份資料，已被學校退回。
py: tā de jiǎng xué jīn shēn qǐng shū yīn shǎo le yī fèn zī liào ， yǐ bèi xué xiào tuì huí 。
en: His application for a scholarship had been returned to the school due to a lack of data.

zh: 現代社會資訊很發達，一發生重要事情，立刻就上電視、上報了。
py: xiàn dài shè huì zī xùn hěn fā dá ， yī fā shēng zhòng yào shì qíng ， lì kè jiù shàng diàn shì 、 shàng bào le 。
en: The modern society is very well informed, and as soon as something important happens, it's on television and in the press.

zh: 他愛亂花錢，三天下來，就把一個月的生活費花光了。
py: tā ài luàn huā qián ， sān tiān xià lái ， jiù bǎ yī gè yuè de shēng huó fèi huā guāng le 。
en: He loves spending money, three days down, and he spends a month of his life.

zh: 購物網站會把常見的購物問題及處理方式放在網頁上，提供給顧客參考。
py: gòu wù wǎng zhàn huì bǎ cháng jiàn de gòu wù wèn tí jí chù lǐ fāng shì fàng zài wǎng yè shàng ， tí gōng gěi gù kè cān kǎo 。
en: The website will place the usual shopping problems and how they are handled on the web site, which will be made available to customers.

zh: 這家店面的租金太高，所以一直租不出去。
py: zhè jiā diàn miàn de zū jīn tài gāo ， suǒ yǐ yì zhí zū bù chū qù 。
en: The rent in this store is too high to rent out.

zh: 做生意前得先算一下成本，划算才去做。
py: zuò shēng yì qián dé xiān suàn yī xià chéng běn ， huá suàn cái qù zuò 。
en: It's a matter of cost before doing business.

zh: 相同的商品，每家商店給的折扣都不相同。
py: xiāng tóng de shāng pǐn ， měi jiā shāng diàn gěi de zhé kòu dōu bù xiāng tóng 。
en: For the same goods, discounts vary from one store to another.

zh: 拿到購物收據，要是發現算錯帳了，就請店員再算一次。
py: ná dào gòu wù shōu jù ， yào shì fā xiàn suàn cuò zhàng le ， jiù qǐng diàn yuán zài suàn yī cì 。
en: If you get the purchase receipt and you find it wrong, ask the clerk to do it again.

zh: 在學習新知識的過程中，總是會有開心與煩惱的時候。
py: zài xué xí xīn zhī shí de guò chéng zhōng ， zǒng shì huì yǒu kāi xīn yǔ fán nǎo de shí hòu 。
en: In the course of learning new knowledge, there are always moments of joy and distress.

zh: 博物館內的藝術品價值都很高，不小心弄壞了可是要賠償不少錢的。
py: bó wù guǎn nèi de yì shù pǐn jià zhí dōu hěn gāo ， bù xiǎo xīn nòng huài le kě shì yào péi cháng bù shǎo qián de 。
en: The art in the museum is very valuable, but it's worth a lot of money.

zh: 根據車禍調查的結果，保險公司及對方應各賠我十萬元。
py: gēn jù chē huò diào chá de jié guǒ ， bǎo xiǎn gōng sī jí duì fāng yīng gè péi wǒ shí wàn yuán 。
en: According to the results of the accident, the insurance company and its counterpart should pay me $100,000 each.

zh: 要是你想建議公司採購新設備，可以上網填採購單。
py: yào shì nǐ xiǎng jiàn yì gōng sī cǎi gòu xīn shè bèi ， kě yǐ shàng wǎng tián cǎi gòu dān 。
en: If you want to suggest that the company buy new equipment, you can post the purchase order online.

zh: 這次颱風可能帶來大量雨水，地形較低的地區應該多注意。
py: zhè cì tái fēng kě néng dài lái dà liàng yǔ shuǐ ， dì xíng jiào dī de dì qū yīng gāi duō zhù yì 。
en: The storm could bring a lot of rain, and areas with lower terrain should be given more attention.

zh: 他昨天在酒吧的花費，比我一個月的生活費還高。
py: tā zuó tiān zài jiǔ bā de huā fèi ， bǐ wǒ yī gè yuè de shēng huó fèi hái gāo 。
en: He spent more than I spent a month at the bar yesterday.

zh: 他每次出國，都會幫朋友代購許多具有當地特色的商品。
py: tā měi cì chū guó ， dōu huì bāng péng yǒu dài gòu xǔ duō jù yǒu dāng dì tè sè de shāng pǐn 。
en: Every time he leaves the country, he buys a lot of local goods for his friends.

zh: 過年時，著名點心店都會收到大量的訂單，甚至有顧客在半年前就下訂單了。
py: guò nián shí ， zhù míng diǎn xīn diàn dōu huì shōu dào dà liàng de dìng dān ， shèn zhì yǒu gù kè zài bàn nián qián jiù xià dìng dān le 。
en: By the end of the year, well-known snack shops will receive a lot of orders, and even customers will have done so six months ago.

zh: 小王對農業很有興趣，家裡的倉庫擺滿了種田用的工具。
py: xiǎo wáng duì nóng yè hěn yǒu xìng qù ， jiā lǐ de cāng kù bǎi mǎn le zhǒng tián yòng de gōng jù 。
en: Wang is very interested in farming, and the warehouse is full of tools for farming.

zh: 過海關時，請配合相關人員檢查行李。
py: guò hǎi guān shí ， qǐng pèi hé xiāng guān rén yuán jiǎn chá xíng lǐ 。
en: When passing customs, please cooperate with the relevant personnel in checking the luggage.

zh: 顧客付了錢，賣家也交了貨，這樣子交易才算完成。
py: gù kè fù le qián ， mài jiā yě jiāo le huò ， zhè yàng zi jiāo yì cái suàn wán chéng 。
en: Customers pay and sellers pay, so the deal is done.

zh: 那位畫家的作品，很多國內外的買家都十分感興趣。
py: nà wèi huà jiā de zuò pǐn ， hěn duō guó nèi wài de mǎi jiā dōu shí fēn gǎn xìng qù 。
en: The painter's work is of great interest to many buyers, both inside and outside the country.

zh: 在臺灣，上網訂好火車票後，可選擇到車站或便利商店取票。
py: zài tái wān ， shàng wǎng dìng hǎo huǒ chē piào hòu ， kě xuǎn zé dào chē zhàn huò biàn lì shāng diàn qǔ piào 。
en: In Taiwan, a train ticket can be ordered online and a stop or convenience store can be chosen.

zh: 你把廣告設計得那麼小，這樣的宣傳怎麼有效果呢？
py: nǐ bǎ guǎng gào shè jì dé nà me xiǎo ， zhè yàng de xuān chuán zěn me yǒu xiào guǒ ne ？
en: How can this propaganda work if you're so small in advertising?

zh: 他利用發傳單的方式來宣傳自己新開的餐廳。
py: tā lì yòng fā chuán dān de fāng shì lái xuān chuán zì jǐ xīn kāi de cān tīng 。
en: He used a flyer to promote his new restaurant.

zh: 他個性獨立，加上做事總是很細心，因此老闆很欣賞他。
py: tā gè xìng dú lì ， jiā shàng zuò shì zǒng shì hěn xì xīn ， yīn cǐ lǎo bǎn hěn xīn shǎng tā 。
en: He's independent, and he always does things very carefully, so the boss likes him.

zh: 青少年期的心理變化相當大，需要父母及老師多關心。
py: qīng shào nián qī de xīn lǐ biàn huà xiāng dāng dà ， xū yào fù mǔ jí lǎo shī duō guān xīn 。
en: Mental changes in adolescence are considerable and require greater attention from parents and teachers.

zh: 會賺錢雖然重要，可是有的人認為會存錢、不亂花錢更重要。
py: huì zhuàn qián suī rán zhòng yào ， kě shì yǒu de rén rèn wèi huì cún qián 、 bù luàn huā qián gèng zhòng yào 。
en: It's important to make money, but some people think it's more important to save money and not spend it.

zh: 跟朋友飲酒是一件開心的事，不過飲酒過度卻可能傷害身體。
py: gēn péng yǒu yǐn jiǔ shì yī jiàn kāi xīn de shì ， bù guò yǐn jiǔ guò dù què kě néng shāng hài shēn tǐ 。
en: It's a pleasure drinking with friends, but drinking too much can hurt the body.

zh: 他今天忙得不得了，連喝一口水的時間都沒有。
py: tā jīn tiān máng dé bù dé le ， lián hē yī kǒu shuǐ de shí jiān dōu méi yǒu 。
en: He's too busy today, he doesn't even have time to drink water.

zh: A:喲，你今天怎麼穿得這麼帥？ B:下午要參加公司茶會，得穿得正式一些？ A:那下次跟我約會時，也要這麼穿呦！
py: A: yō ， nǐ jīn tiān zěn me chuān dé zhè me shuài ？ B: xià wǔ yào cān jiā gōng sī chá huì ， dé chuān dé zhèng shì yī xiē ？ A: nà xià cì gēn wǒ yuē huì shí ， yě yào zhè me chuān yōu ！
en: A: Yo, why are you dressed so good today? B: We're going to a company tea party in the afternoon and we're going to have to wear it properly? A: When we're on a date, we're going to wear it like this!

zh: 他願意挑戰自己的工作能力，並積極地克服挫折，真是難得。
py: tā yuàn yì tiāo zhàn zì jǐ de gōng zuò néng lì ， bìng jī jí dì kè fú cuò zhé ， zhēn shì nán dé 。
en: It is rare that he is willing to challenge his ability to work and actively overcome setbacks.

zh: 在交通不方便的地區上班，得一大早就出門才行。
py: zài jiāo tōng bù fāng biàn de dì qū shàng bān ， dé yī dà zǎo jiù chū mén cái xíng 。
en: If you work in an inaccessible area, you have to leave early in the morning.

zh: 在地理條件好的地區，不但農產品種類較多，價格也便宜。
py: zài dì lǐ tiáo jiàn hǎo de dì qū ， bù dàn nóng chǎn pǐn zhǒng lèi jiào duō ， jià gé yě pián yi 。
en: In geographically well-positioned areas, not only are there more types of produce, but they are also cheap.

zh: 這種麵不必煮，只要倒進熱水、泡幾分鐘，就可以吃了。
py: zhè zhǒng miàn bù bì zhǔ ， zhǐ yào dào jìn rè shuǐ 、 pào jǐ fēn zhōng ， jiù kě yǐ chī le 。
en: It doesn't have to be boiled. It's just poured in hot water and soaked for a few minutes.

zh: 公司辦公室裡有咖啡機，隨時想煮一壺熱咖啡都很方便。
py: gōng sī bàn gōng shì lǐ yǒu kā fēi jī ， suí shí xiǎng zhǔ yī hú rè kā fēi dōu hěn fāng biàn 。
en: There's a coffee machine in the company's office, and it's easy to make a hot cup of coffee at any time.

zh: 想要泡出一壺好茶或是一杯好咖啡，都是需要功夫的。
py: xiǎng yào pào chū yī hú hǎo chá huò shì yī bēi hǎo kā fēi ， dōu shì xū yào gōng fu de 。
en: If you want to make a nice cup of tea or a good cup of coffee, you'll need some kung fu.

zh: 利用暑期打工不只可以賺點兒零用錢，還可以增加工作經驗。
py: lì yòng shǔ qī dǎ gōng bù zhǐ kě yǐ zhuàn diǎn ér líng yòng qián ， hái kě yǐ zēng jiā gōng zuò jīng yàn 。
en: The use of summer work not only makes a small amount of pocket money, but also increases work experience.

zh: 每年大學迎新時，學校總是會辦舞會歡迎大家。
py: měi nián dà xué yíng xīn shí ， xué xiào zǒng shì huì bàn wǔ huì huān yíng dà jiā 。
en: Every year, when college is new, schools always have dances to welcome you.

zh: 這次茶會主要是為了招待客戶，同時透過這個茶會來發表公司的新產品。
py: zhè cì chá huì zhǔ yào shì wèi le zhāo dài kè hù ， tóng shí tòu guò zhè gè chá huì lái fā biǎo gōng sī de xīn chǎn pǐn 。
en: The main purpose of the tea party was to entertain clients and present new products from the company through the tea party.

zh: 警察亮出證件，叫那個正在吸毒的人乖乖把毒品交出來。
py: jǐng chá liàng chū zhèng jiàn ， jiào nà gè zhèng zài xī dú de rén guāi guāi bǎ dú pǐn jiāo chū lái 。
en: The police showed up their papers and told the guy who was doing drugs to hand it over.

zh: 那個廚師很有一手，能用一條魚做出五道菜。
py: nà gè chú shī hěn yǒu yī shǒu ， néng yòng yī tiáo yú zuò chū wǔ dào cài 。
en: That chef is very good at making five dishes with one fish.

zh: 茶食就是喝茶時配著吃的點心、小吃。「茶點」的意思有三種，包含：「茶食」、「茶和點心」、「用茶做的點心」。
py: chá shí jiù shì hē chá shí pèi zhù chī de diǎn xīn 、 xiǎo chī 。 「 chá diǎn 」 de yì si yǒu sān zhǒng ， bāo hán ：「 chá shí 」、「 chá hé diǎn xīn 」、「 yòng chá zuò de diǎn xīn 」。
en: Tea meals are snacks and snacks for drinking tea.   Tea Spots means three kinds, including "tea snacks", "tea and snacks" and "tea snacks made of tea".

zh: 太太：要是你閒著沒事，就幫我泡一壺熱茶吧。先生：我哪裡閒？我馬上要開雲端會議了，可是忙得很呢！
py: tài tài ： yào shì nǐ xián zhù méi shì ， jiù bāng wǒ pào yī hú rè chá ba 。 xiān shēng ： wǒ nǎ lǐ xián ？ wǒ mǎ shàng yào kāi yún duān huì yì le ， kě shì máng dé hěn ne ！
en: Ma'am: If you're free, make me a cup of hot tea. Sir, where am I? I'm about to have a cloud meeting, but I'm busy.

zh: 茶樹的葉子沒有被破壞的話，做出來的茶葉品質都比較好。
py: chá shù de yè zi méi yǒu bèi pò huài de huà ， zuò chū lái de chá yè pǐn zhì dōu bǐ jiào hǎo 。
en: If the leaves of the tea trees are not destroyed, the quality of the tea is better.

zh: 我們不能因為自來水很方便，就不愛惜水資源。
py: wǒ men bù néng yīn wèi zì lái shuǐ hěn fāng biàn ， jiù bù ài xī shuǐ zī yuán 。
en: We don't care about water resources because running water is convenient.

zh: 那件名牌長裙才兩千元而已，用不著跟老闆殺價。
py: nà jiàn míng pái zhǎng qún cái liǎng qiān yuán ér yǐ ， yòng bù zhù gēn lǎo bǎn shā jià 。
en: That long dress is only $2,000. You don't have to kill your boss.

zh: 同事搬新家，我們送他一組茶具，恭喜他吧。
py: tóng shì bān xīn jiā ， wǒ men sòng tā yī zǔ chá jù ， gōng xǐ tā ba 。
en: My colleague moved to his new home. We sent him a set of tea sets. Congratulations.

zh: 那家餐廳的服務生很厲害，一隻手能端好幾個盤子。
py: nà jiā cān tīng de fú wù shēng hěn lì hài ， yī zhī shǒu néng duān hǎo jǐ gè pán zi 。
en: The waiter at that restaurant was great. He had a few plates on his hands.

zh: 火鍋(hotpot)剛煮好時很燙，吃的時候小心點兒。
py: huǒ guō (hotpot) gāng zhǔ hǎo shí hěn tàng ， chī de shí hòu xiǎo xīn diǎn ér 。
en: It's hot when it's ready. Be careful when you eat.

zh: 文化中心跟大學合辦了一場音樂會，吸引不少民眾參加。
py: wén huà zhōng xīn gēn dà xué hé bàn le yī chǎng yīn lè huì ， xī yǐn bù shǎo mín zhòng cān jiā 。
en: The cultural centre organized a concert with the university, which attracted a large number of people.

zh: 我姑姑的房間裡有淡淡的玫瑰花味兒，那種氣味真香。
py: wǒ gū gū de fáng jiān lǐ yǒu dàn dàn de méi guī huā wèi ér ， nà zhǒng qì wèi zhēn xiāng 。
en: My aunt's room smells of light roses. It smells so good.

zh: 這道菜是用新鮮蔬果做的，不僅味道甘甜，對健康也有好處。
py: zhè dào cài shì yòng xīn xiān shū guǒ zuò de ， bù jǐn wèi dào gān tián ， duì jiàn kāng yě yǒu hǎo chù 。
en: This dish is made of fresh vegetables, not only sweet, but also healthy.

zh: 我跟朋友手機的式樣很接近，難怪我們常常拿錯。
py: wǒ gēn péng yǒu shǒu jī de shì yàng hěn jiē jìn ， nán guài wǒ men cháng cháng ná cuò 。
en: I'm close to a friend's cell phone, so that's why we're always wrong.

zh: 醫生告訴我，喝這瓶藥前得先搖一搖。
py: yī shēng gào sù wǒ ， hē zhè píng yào qián dé xiān yáo yī yáo 。
en: The doctor told me to shake it before drinking it.

zh: 他們在露營活動中現學現唱了八首歌，真是了不起。
py: tā men zài lù yíng huó dòng zhōng xiàn xué xiàn chàng le bā shǒu gē ， zhēn shì liǎo bù qǐ 。
en: It's amazing that they're now singing eight songs during camping.

zh: 很濃的茶跟很濃的咖啡一樣，都會讓人睡不著覺。
py: hěn nóng de chá gēn hěn nóng de kā fēi yī yàng ， dōu huì ràng rén shuì bù zhù jué 。
en: A very strong cup of tea, like a very strong cup of coffee, makes it hard to sleep.

zh: 我考慮接受公司的安排，到國外協助市場調查工作。
py: wǒ kǎo lǜ jiē shòu gōng sī de ān pái ， dào guó wài xié zhù shì chǎng diào chá gōng zuò 。
en: I'm thinking of accepting company arrangements to assist with market investigations abroad.

zh: 鮮奶是做冰淇淋、甜點不可少的東西。
py: xiān nǎi shì zuò bīng qí lín 、 tián diǎn bù kě shǎo de dōng xī 。
en: Milk is something to make ice cream and sweets.

zh: 這是我剛買回來的魚，吃起來又鮮又甜。
py: zhè shì wǒ gāng mǎi huí lái de yú ， chī qǐ lái yòu xiān yòu tián 。
en: This is the fish I just bought. It's fresh and sweet.

zh: 臺灣的年輕人愛喝咖啡，因此很多地方都是咖啡店比茶館多。
py: tái wān de nián qīng rén ài hē kā fēi ， yīn cǐ hěn duō dì fāng dōu shì kā fēi diàn bǐ chá guǎn duō 。
en: Young people in Taiwan like to drink coffee, so there are more cafes in many places than tea shops.

zh: 我爺爺習慣吃中式早餐，每天早上都是吃包子配豆漿。
py: wǒ yé yé xí guàn chī zhōng shì zǎo cān ， měi tiān zǎo shàng dōu shì chī bāo zi pèi dòu jiāng 。
en: My grandfather used to eat Chinese breakfast and buns and soy sauce every morning.

zh: 這家民宿提供西式、中式兩種早餐，既豐富又好吃。
py: zhè jiā mín sù tí gōng xī shì 、 zhōng shì liǎng zhǒng zǎo cān ， jì fēng fù yòu hǎo chī 。
en: It provides two types of Western and Chinese breakfast, rich and good.

zh: 臺灣人常用花生、紅豆做傳統點心。
py: tái wān rén cháng yòng huā shēng 、 hóng dòu zuò chuán tǒng diǎn xīn 。
en: In Taiwan, peanuts and red beans are often used as traditional snacks.

zh: 中國人看傳統戲劇時都喜歡準備一盤瓜子，邊吃邊欣賞。
py: zhōng guó rén kàn chuán tǒng xì jù shí dōu xǐ huān zhǔn bèi yī pán guā zi ， biān chī biān xīn shǎng 。
en: Chinese people like to prepare a plate of melons while they eat it and enjoy it.

zh: 我種了一些瓜，賣了五分之四，剩下的就全送人了。
py: wǒ zhǒng le yī xiē guā ， mài le wǔ fēn zhī sì ， shèng xià de jiù quán sòng rén le 。
en: I planted some melons, sold four fifths, and the rest was delivered.

zh: 在歐洲，小麥做的各種食品常被當作餐桌上的主要食物。
py: zài ōu zhōu ， xiǎo mài zuò de gè zhǒng shí pǐn cháng bèi dāng zuò cān zhuō shàng de zhǔ yào shí wù 。
en: In Europe, wheat-made foods are often used as the main food on the table.

zh: 不少人利用新年期間到國外旅行，國內過年的氣氛就越來越淡了。
py: bù shǎo rén lì yòng xīn nián qī jiān dào guó wài lǚ xíng ， guó nèi guò nián de qì fēn jiù yuè lái yuè dàn le 。
en: Many people take advantage of the New Year's period to travel abroad, and the mood within the country is getting less and less.

zh: 購物是一種享受，超過個人需求的消費，卻只會帶來煩惱。
py: gòu wù shì yī zhǒng xiǎng shòu ， chāo guò gè rén xū qiú de xiāo fèi ， què zhǐ huì dài lái fán nǎo 。
en: Buying is an enjoyment that exceeds personal needs, but only causes trouble.

zh: 姊姊覺得木頭地板很麻煩，因為得跪著擦才擦得乾淨。
py: zǐ zǐ jué dé mù tóu dì bǎn hěn má fán ， yīn wèi dé guì zhù cā cái cā dé qián jìng 。
en: The sister felt that the wood floor was a problem, because she had to get on her knees and wipe it clean.

zh: 當周圍環境很靜的時候，可以聽見平常聽不到的聲音。
py: dāng zhōu wéi huán jìng hěn jìng de shí hòu ， kě yǐ tīng jiàn píng cháng tīng bú dào de shēng yīn 。
en: When the surrounding environment is quiet, you can hear voices that are not normally heard.

zh: 談戀愛時不能太花心，(也)就是說不能見一個就愛一個。
py: tán liàn ài shí bù néng tài huā xīn ，( yě ) jiù shì shuō bù néng jiàn yī gè jiù ài yī gè 。
en: When you're in love, you can't go too far, that's when you can't see one.

zh: 公司的午餐時間很短，因此同事們總是吃得很趕。
py: gōng sī de wǔ cān shí jiān hěn duǎn ， yīn cǐ tóng shì men zǒng shì chī dé hěn gǎn 。
en: The company has very short lunch hours, so colleagues always eat very fast.

zh: 我很怕熱，不過天氣太冷的時候，也不得不開暖氣。
py: wǒ hěn pà rè ， bù guò tiān qì tài lěng de shí hòu ， yě bù dé bù kāi nuǎn qì 。
en: I'm afraid of heat, but when it's too cold, it has to be warm.

zh: 在冬天，臺灣南部比北部暖和，你可以到南部享受暖暖的陽光。
py: zài dōng tiān ， tái wān nán bù bǐ běi bù nuǎn huo ， nǐ kě yǐ dào nán bù xiǎng shòu nuǎn nuǎn de yáng guāng 。
en: In winter, the south of Taiwan is warmer than the north, and you can enjoy warm sunlight in the south.

zh: 今天氣溫只有零下(below zero)三度，我家沒暖氣，不管穿多厚的衣服，全身還是冰冰的。
py: jīn tiān qì wēn zhǐ yǒu líng xià (below zero) sān dù ， wǒ jiā méi nuǎn qì ， bù guǎn chuān duō hòu de yī fú ， quán shēn hái shì bīng bīng de 。
en: Today's temperature is three degrees below zero, and my house has no heat, no matter how thick it is, it's cold.

zh: 世界上再困難的問題，不管早或晚都會有聰明的人解開的。
py: shì jiè shàng zài kùn nán de wèn tí ， bù guǎn zǎo huò wǎn dōu huì yǒu cōng míng de rén jiě kāi de 。
en: The world's more difficult problems, sooner or later, will be solved by smart people.

zh: 有一些中式餐廳的桌上會擺一壺茶，要式客人覺得菜太油，就能喝口茶，解解嘴裡油膩的味道。
py: yǒu yī xiē zhōng shì cān tīng de zhuō shàng huì bǎi yī hú chá ， yào shì kè rén jué dé cài tài yóu ， jiù néng hē kǒu chá ， jiě jiě zuǐ lǐ yóu nì de wèi dào 。
en: Some Chinese restaurants have a pot of tea on their tables, and if the customers feel that the food is too oily, they can have a cup of tea and unspare the greasy smell of their mouths.

zh: 雖然新租的房子空間不大，環境倒挺乾淨的。
py: suī rán xīn zū de fáng zi kōng jiān bù dà ， huán jìng dào tǐng qián jìng de 。
en: Although the space for the new rented house is small, the environment is quite clean.

zh: 身體不舒服時，就應該吃對身體負擔較小、容易消化的食物。
py: shēn tǐ bù shū fú shí ， jiù yīng gāi chī duì shēn tǐ fù dān jiào xiǎo 、 róng yì xiāo huà de shí wù 。
en: When you are not feeling well, you should eat food that is less burdensome to the body and more easily digestive.

zh: 這家便利商店現在有「咖啡、茶飲買一送一」的優惠活動。
py: zhè jiā biàn lì shāng diàn xiàn zài yǒu 「 kā fēi 、 chá yǐn mǎi yī sòng yī 」 de yōu huì huó dòng 。
en: The convenience store now has a "coffee, tea, one-for-one" initiative.

zh: 我們國家出口的農產品很有名，不但價格低，品質又好。
py: wǒ men guó jiā chū kǒu de nóng chǎn pǐn hěn yǒu míng ， bù dàn jià gé dī ， pǐn zhì yòu hǎo 。
en: Our country ' s exports of agricultural products are well known, not only for low prices but also for good quality.

zh: 這裡的資源不多，大部分的石油得從國外進口。
py: zhè lǐ de zī yuán bù duō ， dà bù fèn de shí yóu dé cóng guó wài jìn kǒu 。
en: There are few resources here, and most of the oil has to be imported from abroad.

zh: 我的家鄉出產小麥、葡萄，可是不產茶。
py: wǒ de jiā xiāng chū chǎn xiǎo mài 、 pú táo ， kě shì bù chǎn chá 。
en: My hometown produces wheat, grapes, but no tea.

zh: 我來臺灣，算起來才三個月而已，卻已去過十幾家茶館了。
py: wǒ lái tái wān ， suàn qǐ lái cái sān gè yuè ér yǐ ， què yǐ qù guò shí jǐ jiā chá guǎn le 。
en: I've only been in Taiwan for three months, but I've been to dozens of teahouses.

zh: 到別人家做客時不能太隨便，以免發生不愉快的事。
py: dào bié rén jiā zuò kè shí bù néng tài suí biàn ， yǐ miǎn fā shēng bù yú kuài de shì 。
en: It is important not to be too casual when visiting someone else's home, lest something unpleasant happen.

zh: 上個星期我去鄉下旅行，當地人非常好客。
py: shàng gè xīng qī wǒ qù xiāng xià lǚ xíng ， dāng dì rén fēi cháng hào kè 。
en: I went on a country trip last week. The locals were very nice.

zh: 在這個地區，山地是最主要的地形，因此人口較少。
py: zài zhè gè dì qū ， shān dì shì zuì zhǔ yào de dì xíng ， yīn cǐ rén kǒu jiào shǎo 。
en: In this region, mountains are the dominant terrain and therefore have a smaller population.

zh: 假如缺乏陽光、空氣和水這三項條件，植物就無法生長。
py: jiǎ rú quē fá yáng guāng 、 kōng qì hé shuǐ zhè sān xiàng tiáo jiàn ， zhí wù jiù wú fǎ shēng zhǎng 。
en: Plants cannot grow without the three conditions of sunlight, air and water.

zh: 地球氣溫越來越高，世界各地氣候的變化也越來越明顯。
py: dì qiú qì wēn yuè lái yuè gāo ， shì jiè gè dì qì hòu de biàn huà yě yuè lái yuè míng xiǎn 。
en: The temperature of the Earth is increasing and climate changes around the world are becoming more evident.

zh: 這個山區種了許多茶樹，到了收穫季節，就會有一群採茶姑娘上山採茶。
py: zhè gè shān qū zhǒng le xǔ duō chá shù ， dào le shōu huò jì jié ， jiù huì yǒu yī qún cǎi chá gū niáng shàng shān cǎi chá 。
en: This mountain has grown many tea trees and, by the time of the harvest season, there will be a group of tea-taking girls on the mountain.

zh: 這種植物的葉子尖尖的，流出來的汁又臭又黏，觀察時要小心。
py: zhè zhǒng zhí wù de yè zi jiān jiān de ， liú chū lái de zhī yòu chòu yòu nián ， guān chá shí yào xiǎo xīn 。
en: The plant's leaves are sharp, the flowing juice is stenchy and sticky, and watch carefully.

zh: 他沖咖啡的技術很好，香味總是比別人沖的濃。
py: tā chōng kā fēi de jì shù hěn hǎo ， xiāng wèi zǒng shì bǐ bié rén chōng de nóng 。
en: He's very good at making coffee and always smells better than anyone else.

zh: 每個時代都有自己的價值標準，社會習俗及生活規矩也常隨著時代改變。
py: měi gè shí dài dōu yǒu zì jǐ de jià zhí biāo zhǔn ， shè huì xí sú jí shēng huó guī jǔ yě cháng suí zhù shí dài gǎi biàn 。
en: Every generation has its own values, and social habits and rules of life often change over time.

zh: 華人送禮最重心意，以這種方式向收禮的人表達關心與祝福。
py: huá rén sòng lǐ zuì zhòng xīn yì ， yǐ zhè zhǒng fāng shì xiàng shōu lǐ de rén biǎo dá guān xīn yǔ zhù fú 。
en: This is the way in which the people of Yahweh give their prayers with the greatest care and blessings to those who receive them.

zh: 廚師們都會好好保養他們的用具，以免影響做菜的品質。
py: chú shī men dōu huì hǎo hǎo bǎo yǎng tā men de yòng jù ， yǐ miǎn yǐng xiǎng zuò cài de pǐn zhì 。
en: The chefs will keep their tools well in order not to affect the quality of the cooking.

zh: 銀做的東西雖然漂亮，不過不好保養。
py: yín zuò de dōng xī suī rán piào liàng ， bù guò bù hǎo bǎo yǎng 。
en: The silver is beautiful, but it's not safe.

zh: 那家商店不只賣日用品，另外也賣食品和文具。
py: nà jiā shāng diàn bù zhǐ mài rì yòng pǐn ， lìng wài yě mài shí pǐn hé wén jù 。
en: The store sold not only daily items, but also food and stationery.

zh: 資源回收不分你我他，一個人的回收是榜樣，一群人的回收是力量。
py: zī yuán huí shōu bù fēn nǐ wǒ tā ， yī gè rén de huí shōu shì bǎng yàng ， yī qún rén de huí shōu shì lì liàng 。
en: Reclamation doesn't matter between you and me. One's recycling is an example. A group of people's recycling is power.

zh: 開早餐店很辛苦，大清早老闆就得起來準備。
py: kāi zǎo cān diàn hěn xīn kǔ ， dà qīng zǎo lǎo bǎn jiù dé qǐ lái zhǔn bèi 。
en: It's hard to open a breakfast shop, and the boss needs to get up and get ready.

zh: 在路上撿到錢包可以交給警察，請他們幫忙處理。
py: zài lù shàng jiǎn dào qián bāo kě yǐ jiāo gěi jǐng chá ， qǐng tā men bāng máng chù lǐ 。
en: When you get your wallet on the way, you can hand it over to the police and ask them to help you handle it.

zh: 這次颱風雨大風又強，大街上不少店家都關店休息。
py: zhè cì tái fēng yǔ dà fēng yòu qiáng ， dà jiē shàng bù shǎo diàn jiā dōu guān diàn xiū xī 。
en: The storm was stormy and strong, and many shopkeepers on the street closed down for rest.

zh: 一家餐廳要是受歡迎，就算把店關在郊區的某個小巷子裡，也還是時常客滿。
py: yī jiā cān tīng yào shì shòu huān yíng ， jiù suàn bǎ diàn guān zài jiāo qū de mǒu gè xiǎo xiàng zi lǐ ， yě hái shì shí cháng kè mǎn 。
en: A restaurant that is popular, even if it is locked in an alley in a suburb, is always filled with people.

zh: 那位客人在地攤買東西揀來揀去，最後又不買，難怪老闆滿臉不高興的樣子。
py: nà wèi kè rén zài dì tān mǎi dōng xī jiǎn lái jiǎn qù ， zuì hòu yòu bù mǎi ， nán guài lǎo bǎn mǎn liǎn bù gāo xìng de yàng zi 。
en: The customer bought things at the market and did not buy them, so no wonder the boss was so upset.

zh: A:你快點把衣服換好。還不出門，就趕不上飛機嘍？ B:好啦，我知道了。
py: A: nǐ kuài diǎn bǎ yī fú huàn hǎo 。 hái bù chū mén ， jiù gǎn bù shàng fēi jī lóu ？ B: hǎo la ， wǒ zhī dào le 。
en: A: Change your clothes. If you don't get out of here, you won't be able to make it? B: All right, I get it.

zh: 食品罐頭吃完以後把罐子洗乾淨，就可以回收了。
py: shí pǐn guàn tóu chī wán yǐ hòu bǎ guàn zi xǐ qián jìng ， jiù kě yǐ huí shōu le 。
en: When the cans are finished, the cans are cleaned and recycled.

zh: 我採花的時候被刺了一下，不過還好不太痛。
py: wǒ cǎi huā de shí hòu bèi cì le yī xià ， bù guò hái hǎo bù tài tòng 。
en: I was stabbed when I was picking flowers, but it didn't hurt much.

zh: 我昨天割草時沒戴帽子，整張臉都因為陽光太強而變紅了。
py: wǒ zuó tiān gē cǎo shí méi dài mào zi ， zhěng zhāng liǎn dōu yīn wèi yáng guāng tài qiáng ér biàn hóng le 。
en: I didn't wear a hat when I mowed the grass yesterday, and the whole face got red because the sun was too strong.

zh: 她做的籃子很漂亮，很多人買來當作禮物。
py: tā zuò de lán zi hěn piào liàng ， hěn duō rén mǎi lái dāng zuò lǐ wù 。
en: She made a nice basket. A lot of people bought it as a gift.

zh: 部分國家規定，騎腳踏車時是不能載人的。
py: bù fèn guó jiā guī dìng ， qí jiǎo tà chē shí shì bù néng zài rén de 。
en: Some countries have established that people cannot be carried on bicycles.

zh: 我每天騎車上班前，總是習慣先檢查摩托車的輪子正不正常。
py: wǒ měi tiān qí chē shàng bān qián ， zǒng shì xí guàn xiān jiǎn chá mó tuō chē de lún zi zhèng bú zhèng cháng 。
en: I always get used to checking the wheels of motorcycles before I ride to work every day.

zh: 我每個月都會清一次冷氣，這樣比較省電，風也比較涼。
py: wǒ měi gè yuè dōu huì qīng yī cì lěng qì ， zhè yàng bǐ jiào shěng diàn ， fēng yě bǐ jiào liáng 。
en: I'll clear the air every month, so it'll save you electricity and the wind's cooler.

zh: 他把我的手機壓壞了，我要他買一支賠我。
py: tā bǎ wǒ de shǒu jī yā huài le ， wǒ yào tā mǎi yī zhī péi wǒ 。
en: He crushed my phone. I want him to buy one for me.

zh: 我喜歡玻璃做的杯子，用起來比較安心，看起來也很漂亮。
py: wǒ xǐ huān bō lí zuò de bēi zi ， yòng qǐ lái bǐ jiào ān xīn ， kàn qǐ lái yě hěn piào liàng 。
en: I like glass cups. They're more reassuring. They look beautiful.

zh: 這間教室的門有問題，得用力才能打開。
py: zhè jiān jiào shì de mén yǒu wèn tí ， dé yòng lì cái néng dǎ kāi 。
en: There's a problem with the door to this classroom. It's gonna have to be hard to open it.

zh: 你放餅乾盒的時候輕一點兒，餅乾碎了就不好吃、不好拿了。
py: nǐ fàng bǐng qián hé de shí hòu qīng yī diǎn ér ， bǐng qián suì le jiù bù hǎo chī 、 bù hǎo ná le 。
en: When you put the cookies in the box, it's not good enough to take them when they're broken.

zh: 會議資料的分類不必太仔細，分得簡單清楚就行了。
py: huì yì zī liào de fēn lèi bù bì tài zǎi xì ， fēn de jiǎn dān qīng chǔ jiù xíng le 。
en: The classification of conference data need not be too detailed, and a clear and simple division should be achieved.

zh: 這個牌子的衛生紙打八折，很多人搶著購買。
py: zhè gè pái zi de wèi shēng zhǐ dǎ bā zhé ， hěn duō rén qiǎng zhù gòu mǎi 。
en: This brand's sanitary paper is 20% discounted, and many people are buying it.

zh: 他在超市隨手買了瓶飲料，回家後才發現有效日期快到了，只好趕快喝完。
py: tā zài chāo shì suí shǒu mǎi le píng yǐn liào ， huí jiā hòu cái fā xiàn yǒu xiào rì qī kuài dào le ， zhǐ hǎo gǎn kuài hē wán 。
en: He bought a bottle of drinks at the supermarket before he came home and found out that the effective date was nearing completion.

zh: 妹妹提了一個小桶水，很細心地幫爸爸擦櫃子。
py: mèi mèi tí le yī gè xiǎo tǒng shuǐ ， hěn xì xīn dì bāng bà bà cā guì zi 。
en: My sister brought up a little bucket of water and was very careful to wipe Dad's locker.

zh: 他上課時偷偷出去拿了蛋糕進來，原來是要幫老師慶祝生日。
py: tā shàng kè shí tōu tōu chū qù ná le dàn gāo jìn lái ， yuán lái shì yào bāng lǎo shī qìng zhù shēng rì 。
en: He snuck out to pick up the cake while he was in class and was supposed to celebrate his birthday.

zh: 教授的房間堆滿了各種書籍，本來就不大的房間感覺更擠了。
py: jiào shòu de fáng jiān duī mǎn le gè zhǒng shū jí ， běn lái jiù bù dà de fáng jiān gǎn jué gèng jǐ le 。
en: The professor's room was full of books, and the smaller room felt more crowded.

zh: 這家超商食品賣不完就丟掉的作法，不但白白浪費食物，回收處理的成本也增加了，長期下來十分浪費。
py: zhè jiā chāo shāng shí pǐn mài bù wán jiù diū diào de zuò fǎ ， bù dàn bái bái làng fèi shí wù ， huí shōu chù lǐ de chéng běn yě zēng jiā le ， zhǎng qī xià lái shí fēn làng fèi 。
en: In addition to the waste of food, the cost of recycling has increased, and in the long run it has been wasted.

zh: 電腦和手機要是不常擦的話，比馬桶還骯髒。
py: diàn nǎo hé shǒu jī yào shì bù cháng cā de huà ， bǐ mǎ tǒng hái āng zāng 。
en: Computers and cell phones are worse than toilets if they're not rubbing.

zh: 在路邊的攤子享受小吃，得注意他們處理食物的方式衛不衛生。
py: zài lù biān de tān zi xiǎng shòu xiǎo chī ， dé zhù yì tā men chù lǐ shí wù de fāng shì wèi bù wèi shēng 。
en: Enjoy the snacks at the side of the road, and beware of the manner in which they handle them.

zh: 政府最主要的任務應是維持並保護社會安全，其次是規畫各種制度，使國家穩定地成長。
py: zhèng fǔ zuì zhǔ yào de rèn wù yīng shì wéi chí bìng bǎo hù shè huì ān quán ， qí cì shì guī huà gè zhǒng zhì dù ， shǐ guó jiā wěn dìng dì chéng zhǎng 。
en: The main task of the Government is to maintain and protect social security, followed by the regulation of systems to stabilize the country.

zh: 人類破壞了自然，就是破壞了自己的生活環境。
py: rén lèi pò huài le zì rán ， jiù shì pò huài le zì jǐ de shēng huó huán jìng 。
en: Humans destroy nature by destroying their own environment.

zh: 向圖書館借的書籍要是超過規定的時間沒還，可是要罰錢的。
py: xiàng tú shū guǎn jiè de shū jí yào shì chāo guò guī dìng de shí jiān méi hái ， kě shì yào fá qián de 。
en: If the books borrowed from the library are not paid in excess of the prescribed time, they are fined.

zh: 一個國家光是依靠免費簽證，是無法吸引國外遊客來旅行的。
py: yī gè guó jiā guāng shì yī kào miǎn fèi qiān zhèng ， shì wú fǎ xī yǐn guó wài yóu kè lái lǚ xíng de 。
en: A country that relies on free visas alone cannot attract foreign tourists to travel.

zh: 上課光聽老師教是沒用的，還要親自練習幾遍。
py: shàng kè guāng tīng lǎo shī jiào shì méi yòng de ， hái yào qīn zì liàn xí jǐ biàn 。
en: It is useless to listen to a teacher and practice it in person a few times.

zh: 台灣有句著名的廣告台詞「心動不如馬上行動」，意思是當個人有了想法之後，光是想是沒用的，得立刻行動才行。
py: tái wān yǒu jù zhù míng de guǎng gào tái cí 「 xīn dòng bù rú mǎ shàng háng dòng 」， yì si shì dāng gè rén yǒu le xiǎng fǎ zhī hòu ， guāng shì xiǎng shì méi yòng de ， dé lì kè xíng dòng cái xíng 。
en: Taiwan has a famous ad line, "I don't want to act immediately," which means that when a person has an idea, it's useless to just think and act immediately.

zh: 這班學生多數都會說法國話，其中有半數是從歐洲來的。
py: zhè bān xué shēng duō shù dōu huì shuō fǎ guó huà ， qí zhōng yǒu bàn shù shì cóng ōu zhōu lái de 。
en: Most of these students speak French, half of them from Europe.

zh: 這輛卡車有十二個輪子，大約能載二十五噸的物品。
py: zhè liàng kǎ chē yǒu shí èr gè lún zi ， dà yuē néng zài èr shí wǔ dūn de wù pǐn 。
en: This truck has 12 wheels, about 25 tons of stuff.

zh: 對大多數人來說，沒有用的垃圾是廢物，有用的垃圾是資源。
py: duì dà duō shù rén lái shuō ， méi yǒu yòng de lā jī shì fèi wù ， yǒu yòng de lā jī shì zī yuán 。
en: For most people, useless waste is waste, useful waste is resource.

zh: 家中的廢車可送到汽車修理工廠回收，多多少少能賣點錢。
py: jiā zhōng de fèi chē kě sòng dào qì chē xiū lǐ gōng chǎng huí shōu ， duō duō shǎo shǎo néng mài diǎn qián 。
en: Wasted cars at home can be sent to a car repair factory for recycling, with a little more to sell.

zh: 奶奶把變黃的蔬菜葉子埋在地裡，讓它變成草地的營養。
py: nǎi nǎi bǎ biàn huáng de shū cài yè zi mái zài dì lǐ ， ràng tā biàn chéng cǎo dì de yíng yǎng 。
en: Grandma buried yellow vegetable leaves in the ground and turned them into pastures.

zh: 露營最開心的就是當營火(campfire)燃燒時，大家在營火周圍又唱又跳。
py: lù yíng zuì kāi xīn de jiù shì dāng yíng huǒ (campfire) rán shāo shí ， dà jiā zài yíng huǒ zhōu wéi yòu chàng yòu tiào 。
en: The funniest thing about camping is that when the campfire burns, people sing and dance around the campfire.

zh: 完全按照別人的話來工作，是很省事沒錯，卻失去了讓自己進步的機會。
py: wán quán àn zhào bié rén de huà lái gōng zuò ， shì hěn shěng shì méi cuò ， què shī qù le ràng zì jǐ jìn bù de jī huì 。
en: It's easy to work exactly what others say, but it's a lost opportunity to make progress.

zh: 那位博士在本次會議中所提到的問題，值得我們進一步研究。
py: nà wèi bó shì zài běn cì huì yì zhōng suǒ tí dào de wèn tí ， zhí de wǒ men jìn yī bù yán jiū 。
en: The issues mentioned by the doctor at this meeting deserve further study.

zh: 不論是工業或家庭廢水，對人們的健康都有不好的影響。
py: bù lùn shì gōng yè huò jiā tíng fèi shuǐ ， duì rén men de jiàn kāng dōu yǒu bù hǎo de yǐng xiǎng 。
en: There is a negative impact on people ' s health, whether it is industrial or household waste water.

zh: 人類活動產生許多垃圾，不但汙染了環境，更改變了全球氣候。
py: rén lèi huó dòng chǎn shēng xǔ duō lā jī ， bù dàn wū rǎn le huán jìng ， gēng gǎi biàn le quán qiú qì hòu 。
en: Human activity generates a lot of garbage, not only to pollute the environment, but also to change the global climate.

zh: 每次看到有河流經過的都市，就會想起我生長的家鄉。
py: měi cì kàn dào yǒu hé liú jīng guò de dū shì ， jiù huì xiǎng qǐ wǒ shēng zhǎng de jiā xiāng 。
en: Every time I see a city with a river passing through, I think of my birthplace.

zh: 生命就像海洋一樣，只有勇敢的人們才能抵達海的另一邊。
py: shēng mìng jiù xiàng hǎi yáng yī yàng ， zhǐ yǒu yǒng gǎn de rén men cái néng dǐ dá hǎi de lìng yī biān 。
en: Life is like the sea, and only brave people can reach the other side of the sea.

zh: 工廠排水系統得設計好，以免汙染自然環境。
py: gōng chǎng pái shuǐ xì tǒng dé shè jì hǎo ， yǐ miǎn wū rǎn zì rán huán jìng 。
en: Plant drainage systems need to be designed to avoid contamination of the natural environment.

zh: 汽車的汽油燃燒不完全的話，容易產生很多廢氣。
py: qì chē de qì yóu rán shāo bù wán quán de huà ， róng yì chǎn shēng hěn duō fèi qì 。
en: Cars are prone to a lot of decomposition if their gasoline is not completely burned.

zh: 空氣越髒，人們的肺也就越不健康。
py: kōng qì yuè zāng ， rén men de fèi yě jiù yuè bù jiàn kāng 。
en: The more dirty the air, the less healthy the lungs.

zh: 做任何事以前要先想清楚，這麼做會有什麼後果。
py: zuò rèn hé shì yǐ qián yào xiān xiǎng qīng chǔ ， zhè me zuò huì yǒu shén me hòu guǒ 。
en: You have to think before you do anything. What happens when you do it?

zh: 那家工廠排出的廢氣很毒，附近已經有不少民眾生病了。
py: nà jiā gōng chǎng pái chū de fèi qì hěn dú ， fù jìn yǐ jīng yǒu bù shǎo mín zhòng shēng bìng le 。
en: The waste gas from the factory was very toxic and many people were already sick in the vicinity.

zh: 他的夢想是利用水來當作交通工具的燃料，可是很多人認為不可能。
py: tā de mèng xiǎng shì lì yòng shuǐ lái dāng zuò jiāo tōng gōng jù de rán liào ， kě shì hěn duō rén rèn wèi bù kě néng 。
en: His dream was to use water as fuel for transportation, but many thought it was impossible.

zh: 想把菜園照顧好，平時就得多用心，看到蟲子就得處理。
py: xiǎng bǎ cài yuán zhào gù hǎo ， píng shí jiù dé duō yòng xīn ， kàn dào chóng zi jiù dé chù lǐ 。
en: If you want to take care of the garden, you usually have to take care of the bugs.

zh: 再過幾天就要過年了，在此願大家新年平安，事事如意。
py: zài guò jǐ tiān jiù yào guò nián le ， zài cǐ yuàn dà jiā xīn nián píng ān ， shì shì rú yì 。
en: In a few days, the New Year will be a good year for all of us.

zh: 夏天一到，就有不少遊客到海灘，光著身體享受陽光與海風。
py: xià tiān yī dào ， jiù yǒu bù shǎo yóu kè dào hǎi tān ， guāng zhù shēn tǐ xiǎng shòu yáng guāng yǔ hǎi fēng 。
en: As soon as summer arrives, a lot of tourists come to the beach and enjoy the sun and the winds of the sea naked.

zh: 大地就像我們的母親一樣，一直保護著我們。
py: dà dì jiù xiàng wǒ men de mǔ qīn yī yàng ， yì zhí bǎo hù zhù wǒ men 。
en: The earth has been like our mother, protecting us.

zh: 他靠自己的力量，經過了十年，終於完成了這個發明。
py: tā kào zì jǐ de lì liàng ， jīng guò le shí nián ， zhōng yú wán chéng le zhè gè fā míng 。
en: After 10 years of doing so, he finally finished the invention.

zh: 市長宣布明天因為颱風的風雨太大，不上班、不上課。
py: shì zhǎng xuān bù míng tiān yīn wèi tái fēng de fēng yǔ tài dà ， bù shàng bān 、 bù shàng kè 。
en: The mayor announced that tomorrow, because of the storm, he was out of work and out of school.

zh: 醫生提醒我少吃油、鹽和糖，以減輕身體的負擔。
py: yī shēng tí xǐng wǒ shǎo chī yóu 、 yán hé táng ， yǐ jiǎn qīng shēn tǐ de fù dān 。
en: The doctor reminded me to eat less oil, salt and sugar to lighten the burden on my body.

zh: 用過一面的紙張別急著丟，另一面也可以用。
py: yòng guò yí miàn de zhǐ zhāng bié jí zhù diū ， lìng yí miàn yě kě yǐ yòng 。
en: Don't lose the paper on one side, and the other on the other.

zh: 他以前化學成績常不及格，沒想到現在卻是有名的化學教授。
