py: tā yǐ qián huà xué chéng jī cháng bù jí gé ， méi xiǎng dào xiàn zài què shì yǒu míng de huà xué jiào shòu 。
en: He used to fail in his previous chemical grades, but now he's a famous professor of chemistry.

zh: 停電(power failure)的時候有支手電筒，做起事來比較方便。
py: tíng diàn (power failure) de shí hòu yǒu zhī shǒu diàn tǒng ， zuò qǐ shì lái bǐ jiào fāng biàn 。
en: Power blackouts with a flashlight are easier to do.

zh: 那件事我已經跟你重複說過好多次了，你怎麼還問我？
py: nà jiàn shì wǒ yǐ jīng gēn nǐ zhòng fù shuō guò hǎo duō cì le ， nǐ zěn me hái wèn wǒ ？
en: I've told you so many times about that. Why are you asking me?

zh: 開冷氣時如果能好好利用電扇，房間很快就涼了。
py: kāi lěng qì shí rú guǒ néng hǎo hǎo lì yòng diàn shàn ， fáng jiān hěn kuài jiù liáng le 。
en: When the air is turned on, if the fan is used properly, the room will soon be cold.

zh: 從前有很多生活用具都是用銅做的，像銅杯、銅碗什麼的。
py: cóng qián yǒu hěn duō shēng huó yòng jù dōu shì yòng tóng zuò de ， xiàng tóng bēi 、 tóng wǎn shén me de 。
en: There used to be a lot of living things made of copper, like bronze cups, bronze bowls or something.

zh: 颱風過後，很多電線被強風吹壞了，需要幾天才能恢復正常。
py: tái fēng guò hòu ， hěn duō diàn xiàn bèi qiáng fēng chuī huài le ， xū yào jǐ tiān cái néng huī fù zhèng cháng 。
en: After the hurricane, a lot of the wires were blown off and it took a few days to get back to normal.

zh: 家裡用不到的毯子可以拿給環保社團，他們會送給需要的家庭。
py: jiā lǐ yòng bú dào de tǎn zi kě yǐ ná gěi huán bǎo shè tuán ， tā men huì sòng gěi xū yào de jiā tíng 。
en: Unspent blankets at home can be given to the environmentalists, who will send them to families in need.

zh: 今天百貨公司有優惠活動，買一條床單就送一床被子(quilt)。
py: jīn tiān bǎi huò gōng sī yǒu yōu huì huó dòng ， mǎi yī tiáo chuáng dān jiù sòng yī chuáng bèi zi (quilt)。
en: Today, the department store has a privileged activity, buying a sheet and giving it a blanket (quilt).

zh: 這條棉被是用品質很好的棉花做的，裡面的棉又白又溫暖。
py: zhè tiáo mián bèi shì yòng pǐn zhì hěn hǎo de mián huā zuò de ， lǐ miàn de mián yòu bái yòu wēn nuǎn 。
en: The cotton is made of cotton, which is of good quality, and in which the cotton is white and warm.

zh: 我把房間裡那條黑色繩子看成蛇，嚇了我一大跳。
py: wǒ bǎ fáng jiān lǐ nà tiáo hēi sè shéng zi kàn chéng shé ， xià le wǒ yī dà tiào 。
en: I looked at that black rope in the room as a snake, and it scared me.

zh: 那件襯衫的材料百分之百是棉，穿起來十分舒服。
py: nà jiàn chèn shān de cái liào bǎi fēn zhī bǎi shì mián ， chuān qǐ lái shí fēn shū fú 。
en: The shirt was 100% cotton, and it was very comfortable.

zh: 這些帶子是我小學的記錄，我請朋友把它存進電腦裡。
py: zhè xiē dài zi shì wǒ xiǎo xué de jì lù ， wǒ qǐng péng yǒu bǎ tā cún jìn diàn nǎo lǐ 。
en: These tapes are my primary school records, and I asked my friends to put them on the computer.

zh: 家裡的衛生紙快用完了，下班回家時順便買幾卷吧。
py: jiā lǐ de wèi shēng zhǐ kuài yòng wán le ， xià bān huí jiā shí shùn biàn mǎi jǐ juǎn ba 。
en: We're going to run out of toilet paper and get some rolls when we get home from work.

zh: 人的一生就如一場電影，故事中的每個人都是主角。
py: rén de yī shēng jiù rú yī chǎng diàn yǐng ， gù shì zhōng de měi gè rén dōu shì zhǔ jué 。
en: A man's life is like a movie, and everyone in the story is the lead.

zh: 他很喜歡買文具，尤其是筆，各國進口的原子筆他都有。
py: tā hěn xǐ huān mǎi wén jù ， yóu qí shì bǐ ， gè guó jìn kǒu de yuán zi bǐ tā dōu yǒu 。
en: He likes to buy stationery, especially pens. He has atomic pens in every country.

zh: 今天兩小時的會議，因為要討論的事增加而延長了三十分。
py: jīn tiān liǎng xiǎo shí de huì yì ， yīn wèi yào tǎo lùn de shì zēng jiā ér yán zhǎng le sān shí fēn 。
en: Today's two-hour meeting has been prolonged by a 30-minute increase in the number of matters to be discussed.

zh: 過度消費及使用塑膠材料的產品，都會增加自然環境的負擔。
py: guò dù xiāo fèi jí shǐ yòng sù jiāo cái liào de chǎn pǐn ， dōu huì zēng jiā zì rán huán jìng de fù dān 。
en: Overexploitation and the use of plastic materials can add to the burden of the natural environment.

zh: 那個眼鏡的金屬材料相當特別，因此價格比一般眼鏡貴三成。
py: nà gè yǎn jìng de jīn shǔ cái liào xiāng dāng tè bié ， yīn cǐ jià gé bǐ yì bān yǎn jìng guì sān chéng 。
en: The metal material on the glasses was very special and therefore 30% more expensive than the regular glasses.

zh: 如果能好好利用食物材料，就能有效地減少廚餘。
py: rú guǒ néng hǎo hǎo lì yòng shí wù cái liào ， jiù néng yǒu xiào dì jiǎn shǎo chú yú 。
en: If the food material is used properly, it can effectively reduce the surplus.

zh: 元旦那天因為不少人放假，大部分餐廳都客滿了。
py: yuán dàn nà tiān yīn wèi bù shǎo rén fàng jià ， dà bù fèn cān tīng dōu kè mǎn le 。
en: On New Year's Day, most restaurants were full because of a lot of people on vacation.

zh: 離我家不遠的劇院，是請著名設計師來設計的。
py: lí wǒ jiā bù yuǎn de jù yuàn ， shì qǐng zhù míng shè jì shī lái shè jì de 。
en: The theater, not far from my house, was designed by a famous designer.

zh: 那位演員有劇場表演的經驗，所以導演決定用他。
py: nà wèi yǎn yuán yǒu jù chǎng biǎo yǎn de jīng yàn ， suǒ yǐ dǎo yǎn jué dìng yòng tā 。
en: The actor had the theatre experience, so the director decided to use him.

zh: 這首古老民謠的風格很獨特，不管大人小孩都會唱。
py: zhè shǒu gǔ lǎo mín yáo de fēng gé hěn dú tè ， bù guǎn dà rén xiǎo hái dōu huì chàng 。
en: It's an old folk rumour with a unique style, no matter how grown-up kids sing.

zh: 為了在這場鋼琴演奏中有優秀的表現，小戴早晚不停地練習。
py: wèi le zài zhè chǎng gāng qín yǎn zòu zhōng yǒu yōu xiù de biǎo xiàn ， xiǎo dài zǎo wǎn bù tíng dì liàn xí 。
en: In order to have a good performance in this piano play, Dai has been practicing all day and night.

zh: 這種巧克力是情人節最熱門的商品，總是一下子就賣光了。
py: zhè zhǒng qiǎo kè lì shì qíng rén jié zuì rè mén de shāng pǐn ， zǒng shì yī xià zi jiù mài guāng le 。
en: This chocolate is the hottest commodity for Valentine's Day. It's always sold out.

zh: 大型體育活動常選擇在都市舉行，主要原因是交通方便。
py: dà xíng tǐ yù huó dòng cháng xuǎn zé zài dū shì jǔ xíng ， zhǔ yào yuán yīn shì jiāo tōng fāng biàn 。
en: Large-scale sports activities often take place in urban areas, mainly because of accessibility.

zh: 以前我的小學老師總是親切地教導我們，讓我到現在還是很懷念她。
py: yǐ qián wǒ de xiǎo xué lǎo shī zǒng shì qīn qiè dì jiào dǎo wǒ men ， ràng wǒ dào xiàn zài hái shì hěn huái niàn tā 。
en: My little school teacher used to teach us so well that I still miss her.

zh: 他們班明天有一場籃球比賽，我想到現場替他們加油。
py: tā men bān míng tiān yǒu yī chǎng lán qiú bǐ sài ， wǒ xiǎng dào xiàn chǎng tì tā men jiā yóu 。
en: There's a basketball game in their class tomorrow, and I want to be there to cheer them up.

zh: 生命就像一片海洋，有時穩定有時瘋狂。
py: shēng mìng jiù xiàng yī piàn hǎi yáng ， yǒu shí wěn dìng yǒu shí fēng kuáng 。
en: Life is like a sea, stable and crazy sometimes.

zh: 當掉進海裡的小孩被救上來時，大家都激動地歡呼了起來。
py: dāng diào jìn hǎi lǐ de xiǎo hái bèi jiù shàng lái shí ， dà jiā dōu jī dòng dì huān hū le qǐ lái 。
en: When the children who fell into the sea were rescued, they cheered with excitement.

zh: 當別人表現得很好時，別忘了為他們鼓掌，給他們鼓勵。
py: dāng bié rén biǎo xiàn dé hěn hǎo shí ， bié wàng le wèi tā men gǔ zhǎng ， gěi tā men gǔ lì 。
en: When people do well, don't forget to applaud them and encourage them.

zh: 我罵他是因為他太可惡了，你要我別生氣，我真的忍不住。
py: wǒ mà tā shì yīn wèi tā tài kě è le ， nǐ yào wǒ bié shēng qì ， wǒ zhēn de rěn bú zhù 。
en: I yelled at him because he was disgusting. You told me not to be angry, and I couldn't help it.

zh: 牙痛時最好快點兒去看醫生，不然越忍越疼。
py: yá tòng shí zuì hǎo kuài diǎn ér qù kàn yī shēng ， bù rán yuè rěn yuè téng 。
en: It's better to go to a doctor if you have a toothache before it hurts.

zh: 每次比賽到了緊張的時候，觀眾就大聲叫喊，我也跟著喊。
py: měi cì bǐ sài dào le jǐn zhāng de shí hòu ， guān zhòng jiù dà shēng jiào hǎn ， wǒ yě gēn zhù hǎn 。
en: And every time the race reached its height, the crowd shouted out, and so did I.

zh: 我坐在公園裡看著花兒隨著風搖擺，那個樣子真是可愛極了。
py: wǒ zuò zài gōng yuán lǐ kàn zhù huā ér suí zhù fēng yáo bǎi ， nà gè yàng zi zhēn shì kě ài jí le 。
en: I sat in the park and watched the flowers swing with the wind. It was so cute.

zh: 這部電影一點兒都不吸引人，就算錯過了也無所謂。
py: zhè bù diàn yǐng yī diǎn ér dōu bù xī yǐn rén ， jiù suàn cuò guò le yě wú suǒ wèi 。
en: It doesn't even matter if it's missing.

zh: 經理因商品售完而跟顧客道歉，並表示明天就會補上。
py: jīng lǐ yīn shāng pǐn shòu wán ér gēn gù kè dào qiàn ， bìng biǎo shì míng tiān jiù huì bǔ shàng 。
en: The manager apologized to the customer for selling the goods and said it would be made up tomorrow.

zh: 學校的游泳比賽報名時間到今天截止，有興趣的同學別錯過了。
py: xué xiào de yóu yǒng bǐ sài bào míng shí jiān dào jīn tiān jié zhǐ ， yǒu xìng qù de tóng xué bié cuò guò le 。
en: The school's swimming competition ends today, and interested students miss it.

zh: 有好的投資機會就該好好掌握，不要等到事後才開始後悔。
py: yǒu hǎo de tóu zī jī huì jiù gāi hǎo hǎo zhǎng wò ， bú yào děng dào shì hòu cái kāi shǐ hòu huǐ 。
en: If you have a good chance to invest, you should not wait until you regret it.

zh: 我買了海洋公園的門票，打算利用週末帶孩子一起去逛逛。
py: wǒ mǎi le hǎi yáng gōng yuán de mén piào ， dǎ suàn lì yòng zhōu mò dài hái zi yì qǐ qù guàng guàng 。
en: I bought tickets to Ocean Park to take the kids out on weekends.

zh: 今年下雪的時間提早了，氣候改變或許是最主要的原因。
py: jīn nián xià xuě de shí jiān tí zǎo le ， qì hòu gǎi biàn huò xǔ shì zuì zhǔ yào de yuán yīn 。
en: The snowfall this year is early, and climate change may be the main cause.

zh: 明天的會議改時間了，你趕緊通知大家。
py: míng tiān de huì yì gǎi shí jiān le ， nǐ gǎn jǐn tōng zhī dà jiā 。
en: It's time for tomorrow's meeting. You have to let us know.

zh: 練習八百公尺跑步時，教練除了要大家記得自己是跑第幾棒的，並且提醒我們把棒子拿好。
py: liàn xí bā bǎi gōng chǐ pǎo bù shí ， jiào liàn chú le yào dà jiā jì dé zì jǐ shì pǎo dì jǐ bàng de ， bìng qiě tí xǐng wǒ men bǎ bàng zi ná hǎo 。
en: During the 800-meter run, the coach wanted to remind everyone that he was the best, and reminded us to hold the stick.

zh: 我住的地方距離公司很近，省了很多時間與交通費。
py: wǒ zhù de dì fāng jù lí gōng sī hěn jìn ， shěng le hěn duō shí jiān yǔ jiāo tōng fèi 。
en: I live close to the company, saving a lot of time and transportation.

zh: 演唱會開演前，工作人員請大家不要拿手機錄現場的情況。
py: yǎn chàng huì kāi yǎn qián ， gōng zuò rén yuán qǐng dà jiā bú yào ná shǒu jī lù xiàn chǎng de qíng kuàng 。
en: Before the concert, the staff asked you not to record the scene with your cell phone.

zh: 彩色照片看起來很真實，不過黑白照片給人的感覺也很特別。
py: cǎi sè zhào piān kàn qǐ lái hěn zhēn shí ， bù guò hēi bái zhào piān gěi rén de gǎn jué yě hěn tè bié 。
en: Colored pictures look real, but black and white pictures are very special.

zh: 學校邀請李教授來演講，內容相當精彩，讓我有很大的收穫。
py: xué xiào yāo qǐng lǐ jiào shòu lái yǎn jiǎng ， nèi róng xiāng dāng jīng cǎi ， ràng wǒ yǒu hěn dà de shōu huò 。
en: Professor Lee was invited to speak at the school, and it was wonderful, and it made me feel good.

zh: 球員的表現讓教練不斷搖頭，並表示得加強平常的訓練。
py: qiú yuán de biǎo xiàn ràng jiào liàn bù duàn yáo tóu ， bìng biǎo shì dé jiā qiáng píng cháng de xùn liàn 。
en: The performance of the players kept the coach from shaking his head and expressed the need for more regular training.

zh: 七歲以下的孩子對手部動作還無法完全地掌握，因此不應要求他們正確地握筆。
py: qī suì yǐ xià de hái zi duì shǒu bù dòng zuò hái wú fǎ wán quán dì zhǎng wò ， yīn cǐ bù yīng yāo qiú tā men zhèng què dì wò bǐ 。
en: Children under the age of seven are not yet fully equipped with hand moves and should not be asked to hold their pen properly.

zh: 我看到前面有人跟我揮手，可是我不認識那個人。
py: wǒ kàn dào qián miàn yǒu rén gēn wǒ huī shǒu ， kě shì wǒ bù rèn shí nà gè rén 。
en: I saw someone waving at me, but I don't know that guy.

zh: 對自己的事業很熱情的人，就不怕挑戰任何困難。
py: duì zì jǐ de shì yè hěn rè qíng de rén ， jiù bù pà tiāo zhàn rèn hé kùn nán 。
en: Those who are passionate about their careers are not afraid to challenge any difficulties.

zh: 每次到了特別的節日，張先生就會送鮮花給太太，真是浪漫。
py: měi cì dào le tè bié de jié rì ， zhāng xiān shēng jiù huì sòng xiān huā gěi tài tài ， zhēn shì làng màn 。
en: It's romantic for Mr. Zhang to send flowers to his wife every time he gets to a special holiday.

zh: 在大都市，早上起床能聽見鳥叫聲，那真是太難得了。
py: zài dà dū shì ， zǎo shàng qǐ chuáng néng tīng jiàn niǎo jiào shēng ， nà zhēn shì tài nán dé le 。
en: In the big city, it's so hard to wake up in the morning and hear birds.

zh: 上臺報告以前要把資料準備好，以免到時候手忙腳亂的。
py: shàng tái bào gào yǐ qián yào bǎ zī liào zhǔn bèi hǎo ， yǐ miǎn dào shí hòu shǒu máng jiǎo luàn de 。
en: You have to prepare the data before you go on the stage, so that you don't get too busy.

zh: 聽見他欣賞的那位歌星來演唱的消息，令他興奮地跳了起來。
py: tīng jiàn tā xīn shǎng de nà wèi gē xīng lái yǎn chàng de xiāo xī ， lìng tā xìng fèn dì tiào le qǐ lái 。
en: And when he heard the song that he had been watching, he rose up and jumped.

zh: 所有令人傷腦筋的過程，都是為了使自己變成腦筋很好的人。
py: suǒ yǒu lìng rén shāng nǎo jīn de guò chéng ， dōu shì wèi le shǐ zì jǐ biàn chéng nǎo jīn hěn hǎo de rén 。
en: All that's going on is to make yourself a good person.

zh: A:哎呀！我的手機掉到河裡了。 （shock or annoyance）B:那真是傷腦筋，看來你只好再買一支了。
py: A: āi yā ！ wǒ de shǒu jī diào dào hé lǐ le 。 （shock or annoyance）B: nà zhēn shì shāng nǎo jīn ， kàn lái nǐ zhǐ hǎo zài mǎi yī zhī le 。
en: A: Oh, my phone fell into the river. (shock or agreement) B: That's a pain in the ass. Looks like you're gonna have to buy another one.

zh: 儘管他沒主持過什麼節目，他的獨特風格仍然引起大家注意。
py: jǐn guǎn tā méi zhǔ chí guò shén me jié mù ， tā de dú tè fēng gé réng rán yǐn qǐ dà jiā zhù yì 。
en: Despite the fact that he has not conducted any shows, his unique style has attracted attention.

zh: 要是你覺得那部電影很爛，我們就走吧，又不是非看不可。
py: yào shì nǐ jué dé nà bù diàn yǐng hěn làn ， wǒ men jiù zǒu ba ， yòu bú shì fēi kàn bù kě 。
en: If you think that movie sucks, let's go. It's not necessary.

zh: 他說的話都很有道理，不是廢話，只是你聽不進去而已。
py: tā shuō de huà dōu hěn yǒu dào lǐ ， bú shì fèi huà ， zhǐ shì nǐ tīng bù jìn qù ér yǐ 。
en: He's got a point. It's not bullshit, it's just that you can't listen.

zh: 樂團主唱的唱歌技巧，對樂團演出表現的影響相當大。
py: lè tuán zhǔ chàng de chàng gē jì qiǎo ， duì lè tuán yǎn chū biǎo xiàn de yǐng xiǎng xiāng dāng dà 。
en: The singing skills of the orchestra singers have had a significant impact on the performance of the band.

zh: 在表演以前準備得越多，上舞臺就越有自信。
py: zài biǎo yǎn yǐ qián zhǔn bèi dé yuè duō ， shàng wǔ tái jiù yuè yǒu zì xìn 。
en: The more you get ready before the show, the more confident you get on the stage.

zh: 要是你對文藝領域不了解，最好不要隨便批評別人的作品。
py: yào shì nǐ duì wén yì lǐng yù bù liǎo jiě ， zuì hǎo bù yào suí biàn pī píng bié rén de zuò pǐn 。
en: If you don't know anything about the arts, don't judge people's work.

zh: 他迷上足球，所以買了各式各樣的足球鞋。
py: tā mí shàng zú qiú ， suǒ yǐ mǎi le gè shì gè yàng de zú qiú xié 。
en: He was fascinated by football, so he bought a variety of football shoes.

zh: 他從音樂學院畢業以後就加入歌劇團，到世界各地表演。
py: tā cóng yīn lè xué yuàn bì yè yǐ hòu jiù jiā rù gē jù tuán ， dào shì jiè gè dì biǎo yǎn 。
en: He's been in the opera since he graduated from the Academy of Music to perform around the world.

zh: 從那個偶像團體的舞蹈，就可以看出他們練(to practice)舞時花了多少工夫。
py: cóng nà gè ǒu xiàng tuán tǐ de wǔ dǎo ， jiù kě yǐ kàn chū tā men liàn (to practice) wǔ shí huā le duō shǎo gōng fu 。
en: From the dance of that group of idols, we can see how much work they've spent practicing to dance.

zh: 現在很少年輕人看得懂京劇，其實京劇沒那麼難。
py: xiàn zài hěn shào nián qīng rén kàn de dǒng jīng jù ， qí shí jīng jù méi nà me nán 。
en: There are very few young people who can read the opera, but it's not that hard.

zh: 龍在中國人的心目中具有特殊的地位。
py: lóng zài zhōng guó rén de xīn mù zhōng jù yǒu tè shū de dì wèi 。
en: Dragons have a special place in the minds of Chinese people.

zh: 每次當我回憶起大學的社團生活，就會想到那一群知心好友。
py: měi cì dāng wǒ huí yì qǐ dà xué de shè tuán shēng huó ， jiù huì xiǎng dào nà yī qún zhī xīn hǎo yǒu 。
en: Every time I remember college club life, I think of those friends.

zh: 為了更有效地利用地球資源，我寧願減少不必要的生活享受。
py: wèi le gèng yǒu xiào dì lì yòng dì qiú zī yuán ， wǒ níng yuàn jiǎn shǎo bù bì yào de shēng huó xiǎng shòu 。
en: In order to make more efficient use of the resources of the planet, I would prefer to reduce unnecessary enjoyment of life.

zh: 那位母親寧可犧牲自己的生命，也要保護孩子的安全。
py: nà wèi mǔ qīn níng kě xī shēng zì jǐ de shēng mìng ， yě yào bǎo hù hái zi de ān quán 。
en: The mother would rather sacrifice her life than protect her child.

zh: 病人受傷的地方如果沒有好好處理，很容易會被感染。
py: bìng rén shòu shāng de dì fāng rú guǒ méi yǒu hǎo hǎo chù lǐ ， hěn róng yì huì bèi gǎn rǎn 。
en: Where patients are injured, they are vulnerable to infection if they are not properly treated.

zh: 電視臺常在熱門比賽的轉播中放一些廣告，靠這種方式來賺錢。
py: diàn shì tái cháng zài rè mén bǐ sài de zhuǎn bō zhōng fàng yī xiē guǎng gào ， kào zhè zhǒng fāng shì lái zhuàn qián 。
en: TV stations often broadcast ads in popular competitions to make money in this way.

zh: 網路直播的內容各種各樣，甚至有人因為直播平日生活而變成明星。
py: wǎng lù zhí bō de nèi róng gè zhǒng gè yàng ， shèn zhì yǒu rén yīn wèi zhí bō píng rì shēng huó ér biàn chéng míng xīng 。
en: The content of live webcasts is diverse, and even people become stars because they live on-air.

zh: 你帶著邀請卡給門口的服務人員檢查，才能入場參加活動。
py: nǐ dài zhù yāo qǐng kǎ gěi mén kǒu de fú wù rén yuán jiǎn chá ， cái néng rù chǎng cān jiā huó dòng 。
en: You take the invitation card and check it with the waiter at the door in order to be able to attend the event.

zh: 如果想入會員並享受我們健身房所提供的服務，請您到櫃臺辦理。
py: rú guǒ xiǎng rù huì yuán bìng xiǎng shòu wǒ men jiàn shēn fáng suǒ tí gōng de fú wù ， qǐng nín dào guì tái bàn lǐ 。
en: If you wish to join the membership and enjoy the services offered by our gym, please come to the counter.

zh: 那家商店的廣告牌子被一陣強風吹起後，還差一點打到路上的摩托車，真可怕。
py: nà jiā shāng diàn de guǎng gào pái zi bèi yī zhèn qiáng fēng chuī qǐ hòu ， hái chà yī diǎn dǎ dào lù shàng de mó tuō chē ， zhēn kě pà 。
en: It was horrible that the shop's billboard had been blown up by a strong wind and almost hit the motorbike on the road.

zh: 當聽到周博士多年的研究終於有了成果時，所有員工都給他最大的掌聲。
py: dāng tīng dào zhōu bó shì duō nián de yán jiū zhōng yú yǒu le chéng guǒ shí ， suǒ yǒu yuán gōng dōu gěi tā zuì dà de zhǎng shēng 。
en: When Dr. Chow's years of research finally came to fruition, all the employees gave him their best round of applause.

zh: 我雖然尊敬他，卻不認同他所堅持的觀點。
py: wǒ suī rán zūn jìng tā ， què bù rèn tóng tā suǒ jiān chí de guān diǎn 。
en: I respect him, but I do not agree with what he stands for.

zh: 電腦展內的人太多了，大家擠來擠去的，真是受不了。
py: diàn nǎo zhǎn nèi de rén tài duō le ， dà jiā jǐ lái jǐ qù de ， zhēn shì shòu bù liǎo 。
en: There's too many people in the computer show. It's too much crowding.

zh: 爬山時如果碰到大雨就應避免繼續前進，以免發生危險。
py: pá shān shí rú guǒ pèng dào dà yǔ jiù yīng bì miǎn jì xù qián jìn ， yǐ miǎn fā shēng wēi xiǎn 。
en: When climbing a mountain, when it comes to heavy rains, it should be avoided from moving forward in order to avoid danger.

zh: 碰到困難無法繼續前進時，暫時後退等待機會也是一種作法。
py: pèng dào kùn nán wú fǎ jì xù qián jìn shí ， zàn shí hòu tuì děng dài jī huì yě shì yī zhǒng zuò fǎ 。
en: It is also a practice to stand back and wait for an opportunity when it is impossible to move forward in the face of difficulties.

zh: 上星期電視臺的人來訪問我們，請我們談談學習華語的經驗。
py: shàng xīng qī diàn shì tái de rén lái fǎng wèn wǒ men ， qǐng wǒ men tán tán xué xí huá yǔ de jīng yàn 。
en: Last week, we were interviewed by people from TV and asked to talk about our experience in Chinese.

zh: 這部電影的字幕翻譯得很糟糕，讓人弄不清楚它的意思。
py: zhè bù diàn yǐng de zì mù fān yì dé hěn zāo gāo ， ràng rén nòng bù qīng chǔ tā de yì si 。
en: The subtitles of this movie are a terrible translation, and it's not clear what it means.

zh: 請你把空罐子放在袋子裡，好讓垃圾車一起回收。
py: qǐng nǐ bǎ kōng guàn zi fàng zài dài zi lǐ ， hǎo ràng lā jī chē yì qǐ huí shōu 。
en: Please put the empty cans in the bag so that the garbage cans can be recycled together.

zh: 雖然現在網路很普遍了，還是有不少人喜歡聽電臺的節目。
py: suī rán xiàn zài wǎng lù hěn pǔ biàn le ， hái shì yǒu bù shǎo rén xǐ huān tīng diàn tái de jié mù 。
en: Although the Internet is now widespread, there are a lot of people who like to listen to radio shows.

zh: 如果從事某項工作能令你忘掉時間，或許就可當作一生的事業。
py: rú guǒ cóng shì mǒu xiàng gōng zuò néng lìng nǐ wàng diào shí jiān ， huò xǔ jiù kě dāng zuò yī shēng de shì yè 。
en: If a job can make you forget about time, maybe it'll be a career for life.

zh: 有位功夫明星的動作很快，一次能踢十幾腿，真的讓人驚訝。
py: yǒu wèi gōng fu míng xīng de dòng zuò hěn kuài ， yī cì néng tī shí jǐ tuǐ ， zhēn de ràng rén jīng yà 。
en: It's amazing how fast a kung fu star can kick a dozen legs at a time.

zh: 國內外的社會運動，經常都是因為人民的意見不被尊重而引起的。
py: guó nèi wài de shè huì yùn dòng ， jīng cháng dōu shì yīn wèi rén mín de yì jiàn bù bèi zūn zhòng ér yǐn qǐ de 。
en: Social movements, both within and outside the country, are often motivated by the lack of respect for the views of the people.

zh: 一個政府如果事事控制人民，沒有給人民自由，就不是個理想的政府。
py: yī gè zhèng fǔ rú guǒ shì shì kòng zhì rén mín ， méi yǒu gěi rén mín zì yóu ， jiù bú shì gè lǐ xiǎng de zhèng fǔ 。
en: A Government that controls people and does not give them freedom is not an ideal Government.

zh: 自從他改變飲食習慣以後，就變得既健康又有活力。
py: zì cóng tā gǎi biàn yǐn shí xí guàn yǐ hòu ， jiù biàn dé jì jiàn kāng yòu yǒu huó lì 。
en: Since he changed his eating habits, he has become both healthy and dynamic.

zh: 說到興趣，我們全家的興趣都不同，總是你玩你的，我做我的。
py: shuō dào xìng qù ， wǒ men quán jiā de xìng qù dōu bù tóng ， zǒng shì nǐ wán nǐ de ， wǒ zuò wǒ de 。
en: Speaking of interest, our family's interests are different. You always play you, I do mine.

zh: 在這家餐廳，沒有人替你服務，點菜、拿碗筷等一切都得自助。
py: zài zhè jiā cān tīng ， méi yǒu rén tì nǐ fú wù ， diǎn cài 、 ná wǎn kuài děng yī qiè dōu dé zì zhù 。
en: In this restaurant, there's no one to serve you, order food, take chopsticks and everything.

zh: 所謂「人助天助」的意思，就是得自己先努力，天(God,Heavens)才會幫助你。
py: suǒ wèi 「 rén zhù tiān zhù 」 de yì si ， jiù shì dé zì jǐ xiān nǔ lì ， tiān (God,Heavens) cái huì bāng zhù nǐ 。
en: The term "helping God" means that you have to work on your own, and God, Heavens, will help you.

zh: 春天是花開的季節，在愛情故事中，往往也是適合戀愛的季節。
py: chūn tiān shì huā kāi de jì jié ， zài ài qíng gù shì zhōng ， wǎng wǎng yě shì shì hé liàn ài de jì jié 。
en: Spring is a flowering season, and in love stories, it's often the season of love.

zh: 媽媽買了鮮花來插花，她覺得插花是一門藝術，讓人欣賞到花的美。
py: mā mā mǎi le xiān huā lái chā huā ， tā jué dé chā huā shì yī mén yì shù ， ràng rén xīn shǎng dào huā de měi 。
en: Mom bought flowers to plug in flowers, and she thought they were an art, and they were beautiful.

zh: 吃飯的時候把筷子插在碗裡，會被臺灣人認為沒有規矩。
py: chī fàn de shí hòu bǎ kuài zi chā zài wǎn lǐ ， huì bèi tái wān rén rèn wèi méi yǒu guī jǔ 。
en: Put chopsticks in a bowl while eating, and the Taiwanese think there are no rules.

zh: 這家醫院每個月都到鄉下地區免費為老人門診。
py: zhè jiā yī yuàn měi gè yuè dōu dào xiāng xià dì qū miǎn fèi wèi lǎo rén mén zhěn 。
en: The hospital goes to the countryside every month for free consultations for the elderly.

zh: 冷氣的溫度要是控制得剛好，不但對健康好，也能省點兒電費。
py: lěng qì de wēn dù yào shì kòng zhì dé gāng hǎo ， bù dàn duì jiàn kāng hǎo ， yě néng shěng diǎn ér diàn fèi 。
en: If the temperature is properly controlled, not only is it good for health, but it also saves electricity.

zh: 這所學校規定學生每兩週至少參加一次服務學習活動。
py: zhè suǒ xué xiào guī dìng xué shēng měi liǎng zhōu zhì shǎo cān jiā yī cì fú wù xué xí huó dòng 。
en: The school provides for students to attend at least one service study every two weeks.

zh: 我叔叔總是說工作很累想休息，可是休了假之後又覺得無聊。
py: wǒ shū shū zǒng shì shuō gōng zuò hěn lèi xiǎng xiū xī ， kě shì xiū le jiǎ zhī hòu yòu jué dé wú liáo 。
en: My uncle always said that work was exhausting, but after taking vacation, it was boring.

zh: 你的身體狀況不太好，就別自己開車了，讓我送你回家。
py: nǐ de shēn tǐ zhuàng kuàng bù tài hǎo ， jiù bié zì jǐ kāi chē le ， ràng wǒ sòng nǐ huí jiā 。
en: You're not feeling well, so don't drive yourself. Let me take you home.

zh: 參加旅行團或自助旅遊各有各的優點，懶得自己安排行程的人，就跟著導遊走吧。
py: cān jiā lǚ xíng tuán huò zì zhù lǚ yóu gè yǒu gè de yōu diǎn ， lǎn dé zì jǐ ān pái xíng chéng de rén ， jiù gēn zhù dǎo yóu zǒu ba 。
en: Those who take part in travel groups or self-help tours with their respective advantages and are reluctant to arrange their own travels follow the tour.

zh: 根據規定，每位旅客只能攜帶一件七公斤以下的行李上飛機。
py: gēn jù guī dìng ， měi wèi lǚ kè zhǐ néng xié dài yī jiàn qī gōng jīn yǐ xià de xíng lǐ shàng fēi jī 。
en: According to the regulations, each passenger can only carry one luggage of less than seven kilograms on board the plane.

zh: 我們工廠與那家旅行社有合作關係，廠內員工如果報名他們的旅行團，都可以享受優惠價。
py: wǒ men gōng chǎng yǔ nà jiā lǚ xíng shè yǒu hé zuò guān xì ， chǎng nèi yuán gōng rú guǒ bào míng tā men de lǚ xíng tuán ， dōu kě yǐ xiǎng shòu yōu huì jià 。
en: Our factory has a cooperative relationship with the travel agency, and the workers in the factory are entitled to a discount if they report their travel group.

zh: 旅行團的行程及路線是公司及導遊決定的，不喜歡的話，就只能自助旅遊了。
py: lǚ xíng tuán de xíng chéng jí lù xiàn shì gōng sī jí dǎo yóu jué dìng de ， bù xǐ huān de huà ， jiù zhǐ néng zì zhù lǚ yóu le 。
en: The journeys and routes of the group are determined by the company and the guide, and if they do not like them, they can only travel on their own.

zh: 今年學校的預算只夠修理宿舍的衛生設備，其他需要改善的只能等到明年了。
py: jīn nián xué xiào de yù suàn zhǐ gòu xiū lǐ sù shè de wèi shēng shè bèi ， qí tā xū yào gǎi shàn de zhǐ néng děng dào míng nián le 。
en: This year's school budget is only enough to repair the sanitation of the dormitories, and the rest will have to wait until next year.

zh: 這個旅行團的目的地是中國北京(Beijing)，旅客目的是參觀古蹟及拜訪朋友。
py: zhè gè lǚ xíng tuán de mù dì dì shì zhōng guó běi jīng (Beijing)， lǚ kè mù dì shì cān guān gǔ jī jí bài fǎng péng yǒu 。
en: The destination of the group is Beijing, China, and the purpose of the group is to visit ancient signs and friends.

zh: 這個城市夜晚因各種各樣的彩色燈光，而使得景色既浪漫又迷人。
py: zhè gè chéng shì yè wǎn yīn gè zhǒng gè yàng de cǎi sè dēng guāng ， ér shǐ de jǐng sè jì làng màn yòu mí rén 。
en: The evenings of this city are romantic and fascinating because of all kinds of colored lights.

zh: 我國四季都有美麗的風景：春季時平原有花海、夏季時海灘有日出、秋季時山區有紅樹、冬季時高山有白雪，都十分迷人。
py: wǒ guó sì jì dōu yǒu měi lì de fēng jǐng ： chūn jì shí píng yuán yǒu huā hǎi 、 xià jì shí hǎi tān yǒu rì chū 、 qiū jì shí shān qū yǒu hóng shù 、 dōng jì shí gāo shān yǒu bái xuě ， dōu shí fēn mí rén 。
en: The four seasons of our country have a beautiful view: the flowering spring, the sunrise on summer beaches, the red trees in autumn and the snow in winter's mountains.

zh: 你來得正好，請你幫我檢查這些文件，我一個人實在做不來。
py: nǐ lái dé zhèng hǎo ， qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ jiǎn chá zhè xiē wén jiàn ， wǒ yī gè rén shí zài zuò bù lái 。
en: You're just in time to check these files for me. I can't do them alone.

zh: 我很少到這個地區，所以對附近的路沒什麼印象。
py: wǒ hěn shǎo dào zhè gè dì qū ， suǒ yǐ duì fù jìn de lù méi shén me yìn xiàng 。
en: I rarely get to this area, so I don't remember the road around.

zh: 白天沙漠裡的沙子很燙(to be scalded)，要是光著腳，一定會被燙傷的。
py: bái tiān shā mò lǐ de shā zi hěn tàng (to be scalded)， yào shì guāng zhù jiǎo ， yí dìng huì bèi tàng shāng de 。
en: The sand in the desert is hot during the day, and if it's barefoot, it'll burn.

zh: 那家中式點心店的紅豆沙包子又香又甜，我時常買來當作早餐。
py: nà jiā zhōng shì diǎn xīn diàn de hóng dòu shā bāo zi yòu xiāng yòu tián ， wǒ shí cháng mǎi lái dāng zuò zǎo cān 。
en: I always buy them for breakfast.

zh: 我通常在家吃晚餐，只有好朋友邀請我吃飯，才會出門。
py: wǒ tōng cháng zài jiā chī wǎn cān ， zhǐ yǒu hǎo péng yǒu yāo qǐng wǒ chī fàn ， cái huì chū mén 。
en: I usually have dinner at home, but only when my best friend invites me to dinner.

zh: 我去英國留學時，常利用週末到旅行社打工，帶觀光客到著名的景點觀光。
py: wǒ qù yīng guó liú xué shí ， cháng lì yòng zhōu mò dào lǚ xíng shè dǎ gōng ， dài guān guāng kè dào zhù míng de jǐng diǎn guān guāng 。
en: When I went to school in England, I used weekends to work at travel agencies and bring tourists to well-known sightseeing sites.

zh: 觀光客都說日本四季的景色都很有特色，有機會我要親自去體驗一下。
py: guān guāng kè dōu shuō rì běn sì jì de jǐng sè dōu hěn yǒu tè sè ， yǒu jī huì wǒ yào qīn zì qù tǐ yàn yī xià 。
en: The viewers say that Japan's four seasons are unique, and I have a chance to see them myself.

zh: 鄉村生活雖然不如都市那樣方便，但風景美多了。
py: xiāng cūn shēng huó suī rán bù rú dū shì nà yàng fāng biàn ， dàn fēng jǐng měi duō le 。
en: Village life may not be as convenient as urban life, but it is much more beautiful.

zh: 大自然除了有各種動植物，還有山地、平原、河流等等，這一切應該是上帝創造的。
py: dà zì rán chú le yǒu gè zhǒng dòng zhí wù ， hái yǒu shān dì 、 píng yuán 、 hé liú děng děng ， zhè yī qiè yīng gāi shì shàng dì chuàng zào de 。
en: In addition to the vegetative plants, the mountains, plains, rivers and so on, nature should have been created by God.

zh: 學校每學期都帶學生到郊外旅行，體驗大自然的美好。
py: xué xiào měi xué qī dōu dài xué shēng dào jiāo wài lǚ xíng ， tǐ yàn dà zì rán de měi hǎo 。
en: Schools take students out to the suburbs every semester to experience the beauty of nature.

zh: 在瀑布旁邊照相要看看周圍環境，別不小心掉下去了。
py: zài pù bù páng biān zhào xiàng yào kàn kàn zhōu wéi huán jìng ， bié bù xiǎo xīn diào xià qù le 。
en: Take a picture next to the waterfall and look around. Don't fall.

zh: 登山的時候得注意安全，事前多準備，才能享受登山的樂趣。
py: dēng shān de shí hòu dé zhù yì ān quán ， shì qián duō zhǔn bèi ， cái néng xiǎng shòu dēng shān de lè qù 。
en: You have to be safe when you go up there and be prepared before you can enjoy the climb.

zh: 要去山上看夜景的話，最好帶著手電筒。
py: yào qù shān shàng kàn yè jǐng de huà ， zuì hǎo dài zhù shǒu diàn tǒng 。
en: If you're going to the mountains to watch the night view, you'd better carry a flashlight.

zh: 這處風景區非常有名，假日都擠滿了遊客。
py: zhè chù fēng jǐng qū fēi cháng yǒu míng ， jià rì dōu jǐ mǎn le yóu kè 。
en: The scenery is very well known and the holidays are crowded with tourists.

zh: 上次你跟我提的事，我一點兒印象都沒有，真是不好意思。
py: shàng cì nǐ gēn wǒ tí de shì ， wǒ yī diǎn ér yìn xiàng dōu méi yǒu ， zhēn shì bù hǎo yì sī 。
en: I'm sorry I didn't remember anything you told me last time.

zh: 我夢想有一天可以到世界各地旅行。
py: wǒ mèng xiǎng yǒu yī tiān kě yǐ dào shì jiè gè dì lǚ xíng 。
en: I dreamt that one day I could travel all over the world.

zh: 每天光說夢想，一點兒用都沒有，還是努力實現比較實在。
py: měi tiān guāng shuō mèng xiǎng ， yī diǎn ér yòng dōu méi yǒu ， hái shì nǔ lì shí xiàn bǐ jiào shí zài 。
en: Every day it's just a dream, it's useless, it's still trying to be realistic.

zh: 班機起飛前，服務人員都會為旅客說明應注意的安全規定。
py: bān jī qǐ fēi qián ， fú wù rén yuán dōu huì wèi lǚ kè shuō míng yīng zhù yì de ān quán guī dìng 。
en: Before the flight takes off, the attendants explain to the passengers the safety regulations to be observed.

zh: 我請旅行社代訂從台北直飛美國的班機，機票較貴，但能節省不少時間。
py: wǒ qǐng lǚ xíng shè dài dìng cóng tái běi zhí fēi měi guó de bān jī ， jī piào jiào guì ， dàn néng jié shěng bù shǎo shí jiān 。
en: I asked the travel agency to book a direct flight from Taipei to the United States, which is expensive, but it saves a lot of time.

zh: 這個地區的路規劃得不太理想，不僅沒有一條是直的，方向也有點兒亂，很容易就迷路了。
py: zhè gè dì qū de lù guī huà dé bù tài lǐ xiǎng ， bù jǐn méi yǒu yī tiáo shì zhí de ， fāng xiàng yě yǒu diǎn ér luàn ， hěn róng yì jiù mí lù le 。
en: The road map in this area is not ideal, not only is it straight, it's a little messy, it's easy to get lost.

zh: 從國外坐飛機到臺灣來，有時需要轉機。
py: cóng guó wài zuò fēi jī dào tái wān lái ， yǒu shí xū yào zhuǎn jī 。
en: Flights from abroad to Taiwan sometimes require a switch.

zh: 聽說那場演唱會很熱門，我們最好先預訂門票。
py: tīng shuō nà chǎng yǎn chàng huì hěn rè mén ， wǒ men zuì hǎo xiān yù dìng mén piào 。
en: I heard the concert was hot. We'd better book tickets first.

zh: 你的商品計畫，我可以幫你一起做，反正我晚上沒事。
py: nǐ de shāng pǐn jì huà ， wǒ kě yǐ bāng nǐ yì qǐ zuò ， fǎn zhèng wǒ wǎn shàng méi shì 。
en: Your commodity project, I can do it for you. I'm fine at night anyway.

zh: 這場大型戶外活動因為租不到合適的地方，就被取消了。
py: zhè chǎng dà xíng hù wài huó dòng yīn wèi zū bú dào hé shì de dì fāng ， jiù bèi qǔ xiāo le 。
en: This large outdoor activity was cancelled because it did not rent the right place.

zh: 這班飛機因為天氣不穩定，所以誤點了。
py: zhè bān fēi jī yīn wèi tiān qì bù wěn dìng ， suǒ yǐ wù diǎn le 。
en: The plane was misled because the weather was unstable.

zh: 這個題目怪難的，連老師都要想很久。
py: zhè gè tí mù guài nán de ， lián lǎo shī dōu yào xiǎng hěn jiǔ 。
en: It's a strange topic. Even teachers think about it for a long time.

zh: 現在去看第一場表演時間快來不及了，要不我們改看下一場吧。
py: xiàn zài qù kàn dì yī chǎng biǎo yǎn shí jiān kuài lái bù jí le ， yào bù wǒ men gǎi kàn xià yī chǎng ba 。
en: We're running out of time for the first show, so let's move on to the next one.

zh: 那家早餐店的生意很好，你得早點(兒)去，才買得到早點。
py: nà jiā zǎo cān diàn de shēng yì hěn hǎo ， nǐ dé zǎo diǎn ( ér ) qù ， cái mǎi dé dào zǎo diǎn 。
en: The breakfast shop was a good business. You had to go earlier before you could buy it earlier.

zh: 老師不滿意我們這一組的報告，要我們重做一次。
py: lǎo shī bù mǎn yì wǒ men zhè yī zǔ de bào gào ， yào wǒ men zhòng zuò yī cì 。
en: The teacher doesn't like our group's reports. He wants us to do it again.

zh: 為了旅客搭機安全，機場入境、出境時都要檢查行李。
py: wèi le lǚ kè dā jī ān quán ， jī chǎng rù jìng 、 chū jìng shí dōu yào jiǎn chá xíng lǐ 。
en: For the safety of passengers by air, luggage is checked upon entry into and exit from the airport.

zh: 自從住校以後，我得學習自己收拾、整理房間。
py: zì cóng zhù xiào yǐ hòu ， wǒ dé xué xí zì jǐ shōu shí 、 zhěng lǐ fáng jiān 。
en: Since I've been at school, I've had to learn to clean my own room.

zh: 有些國家為了吸引更多的觀光客來旅遊，就把一些出境、入境的手續改簡單了。
py: yǒu xiē guó jiā wèi le xī yǐn gèng duō de guān guāng kè lái lǚ yóu ， jiù bǎ yī xiē chū jìng 、 rù jìng de shǒu xù gǎi jiǎn dān le 。
en: In order to attract more tourists to travel, some countries have made it easier to leave and enter the country.

zh: 開車時萬一發生車禍，千萬要冷靜，以免情況更嚴重。
py: kāi chē shí wàn yī fā shēng chē huò ， qiān wàn yào lěng jìng ， yǐ miǎn qíng kuàng gèng yán zhòng 。
en: In the event of a car accident, calm down so that the situation does not get worse.

zh: 我去澳洲登山時，碰見了正在自助旅行的老朋友，真巧！
py: wǒ qù ào zhōu dēng shān shí ， pèng jiàn le zhèng zài zì zhù lǚ xíng de lǎo péng yǒu ， zhēn qiǎo ！
en: When I went up to Australia, I met an old friend on a self-help trip. What a coincidence!

zh: 行動不方便的乘客乘車時，車站有服務員為他們服務。
py: xíng dòng bù fāng biàn de chéng kè chéng chē shí ， chē zhàn yǒu fú wù yuán wèi tā men fú wù 。
en: There are attendants at the station for those passengers who are unable to move.

zh: 這家餐廳的帳單已經加了服務費了，你不必再給小費。
py: zhè jiā cān tīng de zhàng dān yǐ jīng jiā le fú wù fèi le ， nǐ bù bì zài gěi xiǎo fèi 。
en: The bill for this restaurant has been added to the service bill. You don't have to tip anymore.

zh: 有些運動中心規定個人得帶自己的毛巾，否則不可以進去。
py: yǒu xiē yùn dòng zhōng xīn guī dìng gè rén dé dài zì jǐ de máo jīn ， fǒu zé bù kě yǐ jìn qù 。
en: Some sports centres require individuals to bring their towels or not to go in.

zh: 下過雨後道路比較滑，開車時速度別太快。
py: xià guò yǔ hòu dào lù bǐ jiào huá ， kāi chē shí sù dù bié tài kuài 。
en: The roads are more slippery after the rains, and not too fast to drive.

zh: 我來教你中國功夫，我怎麼打，你就跟著照打。
py: wǒ lái jiào nǐ zhōng guó gōng fu ， wǒ zěn me dǎ ， nǐ jiù gēn zhù zhào dǎ 。
en: I'll teach you Chinese kung fu. I'll do it, you'll do it.

zh: 在熱鬧的都市裡，常見一些人在街頭表演。
py: zài rè nào de dū shì lǐ ， cháng jiàn yī xiē rén zài jiē tóu biǎo yǎn 。
en: In hot cities, people often perform in the streets.

zh: 週六你到我家來寫作業，或者我們一起到圖書館去讀書也行。
py: zhōu liù nǐ dào wǒ jiā lái xiě zuò yè ， huò zhě wǒ men yì qǐ dào tú shū guǎn qù dú shū yě xíng 。
en: You can come to my house on Saturday to do your homework, or we can go to the library together.

zh: 天氣不穩定的時候，氣溫也時時跟著變化(to change,to vary)。
py: tiān qì bù wěn dìng de shí hòu ， qì wēn yě shí shí gēn zhù biàn huà (to change,to vary)。
en: Temperatures change sometimes when the weather is unstable (to change, to vary).

zh: 這條街道旁有各式各樣的商店與餐廳，假日時相當熱鬧。
py: zhè tiáo jiē dào páng yǒu gè shì gè yàng de shāng diàn yǔ cān tīng ， jià rì shí xiāng dāng rè nào 。
en: The street is surrounded by a wide variety of shops and restaurants, which are very popular during the holidays.

zh: 缺少運動的人總是說自己太忙，缺時間去活動。
py: quē shǎo yùn dòng de rén zǒng shì shuō zì jǐ tài máng ， quē shí jiān qù huó dòng 。
en: People who lack sports always say they are too busy to have time to move.

zh: 知道自己誤會別人以後，最好早一點兒跟對方道歉。
py: zhī dào zì jǐ wù huì bié rén yǐ hòu ， zuì hǎo zǎo yī diǎn ér gēn duì fāng dào qiàn 。
en: If you know you're wrong about someone else, you'd better apologize to each other sooner.

zh: 我看著你只是想告訴你，你的臉上黏了東西。
py: wǒ kàn zhù nǐ zhǐ shì xiǎng gào sù nǐ ， nǐ de liǎn shàng nián le dōng xī 。
en: I just look at you and I just want you to know that you have something sticky on your face.

zh: 生日時，老婆親手織了一頂帽子送我，讓我好感動。
py: shēng rì shí ， lǎo pó qīn shǒu zhī le yī dǐng mào zi sòng wǒ ， ràng wǒ hǎo gǎn dòng 。
en: On my birthday, my wife swollen me with a hat. It touched me.

zh: 那項新產品的設計圖你一個人負責太辛苦了，倒不如找同事一起來做。
py: nà xiàng xīn chǎn pǐn de shè jì tú nǐ yī gè rén fù zé tài xīn kǔ le ， dào bù rú zhǎo tóng shì yì qǐ lái zuò 。
en: The design for the new product is too hard for you to do it alone.

zh: 他一直熱愛翻譯工作，不論多困難都會想辦法克服。
py: tā yì zhí rè ài fān yì gōng zuò ， bù lùn duō kùn nán dōu huì xiǎng bàn fǎ kè fú 。
en: He's always been a fan of translation work, and he'll find a way to overcome it no matter how difficult it is.

zh: 我們吃完早餐，就動身去舞蹈教室練習舞蹈。
py: wǒ men chī wán zǎo cān ， jiù dòng shēn qù wǔ dǎo jiào shì liàn xí wǔ dǎo 。
en: After breakfast, we go to the dance class and practice.

zh: 這次長途旅行不僅行程豐富，並且讓我交到了不少朋友、擴大了視野。
py: zhè cì zhǎng tú lǚ xíng bù jǐn xíng chéng fēng fù ， bìng qiě ràng wǒ jiāo dào le bù shǎo péng yǒu 、 kuò dà le shì yě 。
en: This long trip was more than a rich journey and allowed me to make a lot of friends and expand my horizons.

zh: 經理對新產品計畫的指示不太清楚，我們最好去問清楚。
py: jīng lǐ duì xīn chǎn pǐn jì huà de zhǐ shì bù tài qīng chǔ ， wǒ men zuì hǎo qù wèn qīng chǔ 。
en: The manager's instructions for the new product project are not clear, and we'd better ask.

zh: 我明天要把這份作業交給老師，遲了老師就不收了。
py: wǒ míng tiān yào bǎ zhè fèn zuò yè jiāo gěi lǎo shī ， chí le lǎo shī jiù bù shōu le 。
en: I'm going to give this to the teacher tomorrow, and the teacher won't take it.

zh: 生活忙碌的時候，也要給自己留一些休息時間。
py: shēng huó máng lù de shí hòu ， yě yào gěi zì jǐ liú yī xiē xiū xī shí jiān 。
en: You have to leave yourself some rest while you're busy.

zh: 我的電腦無法上網，檢查之後才發現網路線沒有接著電腦。
py: wǒ de diàn nǎo wú fǎ shàng wǎng ， jiǎn chá zhī hòu cái fā xiàn wǎng lù xiàn méi yǒu jiē zhù diàn nǎo 。
en: My computer was unable to access the Internet, and it was only after checking that the network was not connected to the computer.

zh: 我的同事遲到的次數太多了，這個月被扣了半個月的薪水。
py: wǒ de tóng shì chí dào de cì shù tài duō le ， zhè gè yuè bèi kòu le bàn gè yuè de xīn shuǐ 。
en: My colleagues are too late for half a month's salary this month.

zh: 每個人都有煩惱，如果能好好處理，就能從過程中得到經驗。
py: měi gè rén dōu yǒu fán nǎo ， rú guǒ néng hǎo hǎo chù lǐ ， jiù néng cóng guò chéng zhōng dé dào jīng yàn 。
en: Everyone has a problem, and if they can handle it properly, they can learn from the process.

zh: 感冒要是一個星期左右還沒好，就應該去看醫生。
py: gǎn mào yào shì yī gè xīng qī zuǒ yòu hái méi hǎo ， jiù yīng gāi qù kàn yī shēng 。
en: If the cold's not ready for a week or so, you should see a doctor.

zh: 每天早上都有人在附近公園大聲唱流行歌，聽久了真的很煩。
py: měi tiān zǎo shàng dōu yǒu rén zài fù jìn gōng yuán dà shēng chàng liú xíng gē ， tīng jiǔ le zhēn de hěn fán 。
en: Every morning people sing pop songs in nearby parks, and it's really annoying to hear them for a long time.

zh: 主管的工作壓力往往比下面的員工更大。
py: zhǔ guǎn de gōng zuò yā lì wǎng wǎng bǐ xià miàn de yuán gōng gèng dà 。
en: The work of the supervisor is often more stressful than that of the workers below.

zh: 當你心裡覺得難受的時候，可以跟好朋友聊聊。
py: dāng nǐ xīn lǐ jué dé nán shòu de shí hòu ， kě yǐ gēn hǎo péng yǒu liáo liáo 。
en: You can talk to your best friends when you feel bad.

zh: 逃避或許是解決問題的一種方式，但有些問題是你逃不了，不得不解決的。
py: táo bì huò xǔ shì jiě jué wèn tí de yī zhǒng fāng shì ， dàn yǒu xiē wèn tí shì nǐ táo bù liǎo ， bù dé bù jiě jué de 。
en: Avoidance may be a way to solve problems, but there are some problems that you cannot escape and that you have to solve.

zh: 他的臉色白不是因為不舒服，是因為他平日很少出門。
py: tā de liǎn sè bái bú shì yīn wèi bù shū fú ， shì yīn wèi tā píng rì hěn shǎo chū mén 。
en: His face is not white because he is uncomfortable, because he rarely leaves the house on a daily basis.

zh: 要是你每天都坐在電腦前，不起來運動運動，遲早會生病的。
py: yào shì nǐ měi tiān dōu zuò zài diàn nǎo qián ， bù qǐ lái yùn dòng yùn dòng ， chí zǎo huì shēng bìng de 。
en: If you sit in front of a computer every day and don't get up to sports, you'll get sick sooner or later.

zh: 有人一天到晚總看著手機，連錯過了精彩的生活時刻也不知道。
py: yǒu rén yī tiān dào wǎn zǒng kàn zhù shǒu jī ， lián cuò guò le jīng cǎi de shēng huó shí kè yě bù zhī dào 。
en: Some people look at their phones all the time and don't even know when they miss a good time in life.

zh: 剛跑完步最好不要馬上坐下，這樣對心臟不好。
py: gāng pǎo wán bù zuì hǎo bù yào mǎ shàng zuò xià ， zhè yàng duì xīn zàng bù hǎo 。
en: It's better not to sit down right after the run. It's bad for the heart.

zh: 碰到危險時，人的心跳總跳得很快。
py: pèng dào wēi xiǎn shí ， rén de xīn tiào zǒng tiào dé hěn kuài 。
en: When you're in danger, your heart beats fast.

zh: 我的腰越來越胖，現在買的褲子尺寸比以前大了兩號。
py: wǒ de yāo yuè lái yuè pàng ， xiàn zài mǎi de kù zi chǐ cùn bǐ yǐ qián dà le liǎng hào 。
en: My waist is getting fat and I'm buying pants two sizes bigger than before.

zh: 聽說騎腳踏車可以讓大腿瘦一點兒。
py: tīng shuō qí jiǎo tà chē kě yǐ ràng dà tuǐ shòu yī diǎn ér 。
en: I heard that riding a bike makes the thigh thinner.

zh: 我對人體各部分的功能很有興趣，不過我沒想過當醫生。
py: wǒ duì rén tǐ gè bù fèn de gōng néng hěn yǒu xìng qù ， bù guò wǒ méi xiǎng guò dāng yī shēng 。
en: I'm interested in the functioning of all parts of the human body, but I never wanted to be a doctor.

zh: 肚子痛有時不一定是消化器官的問題，得去醫院檢查。
py: dù zi tòng yǒu shí bù yí dìng shì xiāo huà qì guān de wèn tí ， dé qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá 。
en: A stomach ache may not always be a problem with digestive organs, but it has to be examined at the hospital.

zh: 關上燈、關上手機，這麼做你才能好好休息。
py: guān shàng dēng 、 guān shàng shǒu jī ， zhè me zuò nǐ cái néng hǎo hǎo xiū xī 。
en: Turn off the lights, turn off the phone, so you can get some rest.

zh: 人類大腦分成幾區，有的管語言，有的管記憶，很有意思。
py: rén lèi dà nǎo fēn chéng jǐ qū ， yǒu de guǎn yǔ yán ， yǒu de guǎn jì yì ， hěn yǒu yì si 。
en: The human brain is divided into regions, languages, memories, and interesting.

zh: 有的房子前院、後院都有花園，住起來一定很舒服。
py: yǒu de fáng zi qián yuàn 、 hòu yuàn dōu yǒu huā yuán ， zhù qǐ lái yí dìng hěn shū fú 。
en: Some houses have gardens in their front and backyards, and they must be comfortable.

zh: 我在市場買了漂亮的花盆，可是還不知道種什麼植物比較好。
py: wǒ zài shì chǎng mǎi le piào liàng de huā pén ， kě shì hái bù zhī dào zhǒng shén me zhí wù bǐ jiào hǎo 。
en: I bought a beautiful flowerpot at the market, but I don't know what plants are better.

zh: 阿溫對花草很有興趣，不論生長在平原或山地的，他都叫得出名字來。
py: ā wēn duì huā cǎo hěn yǒu xìng qù ， bù lùn shēng zhǎng zài píng yuán huò shān dì de ， tā dōu jiào dé chū míng zì lái 。
en: Win is interested in herbs, whether they grow up in the plains or in the mountains, and he's got a name.

zh: 那個農村裡有個小農場，他們生產的鮮奶冰淇淋非常好吃。
py: nà gè nóng cūn lǐ yǒu gè xiǎo nóng chǎng ， tā men shēng chǎn de xiān nǎi bīng qí lín fēi cháng hǎo chī 。
en: There's a small farm in that farm where they produce very good milk and ice cream.

zh: 每次我受不了工作壓力時，就會到湖邊散步，看到平靜的湖水，心裡就會平靜下來。
py: měi cì wǒ shòu bù liǎo gōng zuò yā lì shí ， jiù huì dào hú biān sàn bù ， kàn dào píng jìng de hú shuǐ ， xīn lǐ jiù huì píng jìng xià lái 。
en: Every time I can't stand the pressure of my work, I walk to the lake, see the calm water, and my heart calms down.

zh: 哎喲，已經半夜一點多了！我們就別再加班寫產品計畫了，等明天再繼續吧！
py: āi yō ， yǐ jīng bàn yè yī diǎn duō le ！ wǒ men jiù bié zài jiā bān xiě chǎn pǐn jì huà le ， děng míng tiān zài jì xù ba ！
en: It's after 1:00 in the middle of the night! Let's stop working on the product plan and start tomorrow!

zh: 緊張的時候試著慢慢呼吸，吸一口氣，再慢慢呼出來，可以讓你輕鬆一點兒。
py: jǐn zhāng de shí hòu shì zhù màn màn hū xī ， xī yī kǒu qì ， zài màn màn hū chū lái ， kě yǐ ràng nǐ qīng sōng yī diǎn ér 。
en: Try to breathe slowly when you're nervous, take a breath and exhale slowly, so you can relax a little bit.

zh: 曾經失去一切的人，更懂得愛惜現在擁有的一切。
py: céng jīng shī qù yī qiè de rén ， gèng dǒng de ài xī xiàn zài yōng yǒu de yī qiè 。
en: Those who have lost everything know better what they have now.

zh: 有人說好看的人像花瓶，好看卻沒有用，這句話我完全不同意。
py: yǒu rén shuō hǎo kàn de rén xiàng huā píng ， hǎo kàn què méi yǒu yòng ， zhè jù huà wǒ wán quán bù tóng yì 。
en: I totally disagree with people who say they look good like vases, but they look good but they don't work.

zh: 自己做的肥皂用起來比較安心，也能選擇自己喜歡的氣味。
py: zì jǐ zuò de féi zào yòng qǐ lái bǐ jiào ān xīn ， yě néng xuǎn zé zì jǐ xǐ huān de qì wèi 。
en: The soap that you make is easier to use and you can choose the smell you like.

zh: 那道菜一點兒都不鹹，我猜或許是忘了放鹽巴。
py: nà dào cài yī diǎn ér dōu bù xián ， wǒ cāi huò xǔ shì wàng le fàng yán bā 。
en: It's not stale at all. I guess I forgot to put salt on it.

zh: 你彈吉他彈得真不錯，如果你願意教我，我想跟你學。
py: nǐ dàn jí tā dàn dé zhēn bù cuò ， rú guǒ nǐ yuàn yì jiào wǒ ， wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ xué 。
en: You're a good guitar player. If you'd like to teach me, I'd like to learn from you.

zh: 我國四十歲以下的單身女性人數，比去年增加了百分之十。
py: wǒ guó sì shí suì yǐ xià de dān shēn nǚ xìng rén shù ， bǐ qù nián zēng jiā le bǎi fēn zhī shí 。
en: The number of single women under the age of 40 in my country is 10 percent higher than last year.

zh: 根據目前科學研究的資料，女性與男性在能力、態度和行為等方面的差異都非常小。
py: gēn jù mù qián kē xué yán jiū de zī liào ， nǚ xìng yǔ nán xìng zài néng lì 、 tài dù hé xíng wèi děng fāng miàn de chà yì dōu fēi cháng xiǎo 。
en: According to current scientific research, there are very few differences between women and men in terms of competence, attitude and behaviour.

zh: 小王追求祝小姐好幾年了，不過祝小姐一直只把她當好友。
py: xiǎo wáng zhuī qiú zhù xiǎo jiě hǎo jǐ nián le ， bù guò zhù xiǎo jiě yì zhí zhǐ bǎ tā dāng hǎo yǒu 。
en: He's been after her for years, but she's always been her best friend.

zh: 錢先生買了一只上百萬的鑽石戒指，當成跟女友求婚的禮物。
py: qián xiān shēng mǎi le yī zhī shàng bǎi wàn de zuān shí jiè zhǐ ， dāng chéng gēn nǚ yǒu qiú hūn de lǐ wù 。
en: Mr. Money bought a million-dollar diamond ring as a gift to propose to his girlfriend.

zh: 電視臺播出的娛樂節目多半是唱歌跳舞的表演，能讓觀眾心情愉快。
py: diàn shì tái bō chū de yú lè jié mù duō bàn shì chàng gē tiào wǔ de biǎo yǎn ， néng ràng guān zhòng xīn qíng yú kuài 。
en: Most entertainment shows broadcast on TV are singing and dancing performances that make the audience happy.

zh: 路教授最近發表的這套跟人體大腦有關的理論，令其他科學家很感興趣。
py: lù jiào shòu zuì jìn fā biǎo de zhè tào gēn rén tǐ dà nǎo yǒu guān de lǐ lùn ， lìng qí tā kē xué jiā hěn gǎn xìng qù 。
en: Professor Lu recently published this theory about the human brain, which is of interest to other scientists.

zh: 有時候只要什麼都不想，好好睡一覺，就能讓人們紓壓。
py: yǒu shí hòu zhǐ yào shén me dōu bù xiǎng ， hǎo hǎo shuì yī jué ， jiù néng ràng rén men shū yā 。
en: Sometimes when you don't want anything, you get a good night's sleep.

zh: 時間有時能消除煩惱，不能解決的事就暫時放在一邊吧。
py: shí jiān yǒu shí néng xiāo chú fán nǎo ， bù néng jiě jué de shì jiù zàn shí fàng zài yī biān ba 。
en: Time can be used to sort things out, so let's put things aside for a while.

zh: A:你說自己沒有想做的事，難道你沒有夢想嗎？ B:我只想簡單過生活，再說，沒有夢想難道不行嗎？
py: A: nǐ shuō zì jǐ méi yǒu xiǎng zuò de shì ， nán dào nǐ méi yǒu mèng xiǎng ma ？ B: wǒ zhǐ xiǎng jiǎn dān guò shēng huó ， zài shuō ， méi yǒu mèng xiǎng nán dào bù xíng ma ？
en: A: Have you not dreamed of what you say you do not want? B: I just want to live a simple life, and why not?

zh: 我常跟電腦下棋，因為想玩就玩，不必擔心時間早晚。
py: wǒ cháng gēn diàn nǎo xià qí ， yīn wèi xiǎng wán jiù wán ， bù bì dān xīn shí jiān zǎo wǎn 。
en: I used to play chess with computers because I wanted to play, so I didn't have to worry about time or time.

zh: 每個人都得經驗老病死，這些都是自然發生，避免不了的。
py: měi gè rén dōu dé jīng yàn lǎo bìng sǐ ， zhè xiē dōu shì zì rán fā shēng ， bì miǎn bù liǎo de 。
en: Everyone has to die of old disease. It happens naturally. It can't be avoided.

zh: 這一盤棋你下得真好，你一定花了很多工夫研究。
py: zhè yī pán qí nǐ xià dé zhēn hǎo ， nǐ yí dìng huā le hěn duō gōng fu yán jiū 。
en: You're doing a great game of chess. You must have done a lot of research.

zh: 昨天電視臺的氣象報告說今天會下雨，果然一大早就下起雨來了。
py: zuó tiān diàn shì tái de qì xiàng bào gào shuō jīn tiān huì xià yǔ ， guǒ rán yī dà zǎo jiù xià qǐ yǔ lái le 。
en: Yesterday's air report on TV said it's going to rain today, and it's going to rain early in the morning.

zh: 看見有困難的人們，有能力的話就得想辦法幫助他們，不應該不理他們。
py: kàn jiàn yǒu kùn nán de rén men ， yǒu néng lì de huà jiù dé xiǎng bàn fǎ bāng zhù tā men ， bù yīng gāi bù lǐ tā men 。
en: If you see those in need, you must find a way to help them, not to ignore them.

zh: 一失眠就吃藥不是好辦法，最好跟醫生談談，試著找出原因。
py: yī shī mián jiù chī yào bú shì hǎo bàn fǎ ， zuì hǎo gēn yī shēng tán tán ， shì zhù zhǎo chū yuán yīn 。
en: It's not a good idea to take pills when you're not asleep. It's better to talk to the doctor and try to find out why.

zh: 我沒有帶大門的鑰匙，不得不攀牆進去。
py: wǒ méi yǒu dài dà mén de yào shi ， bù dé bù pān qiáng jìn qù 。
en: I didn't have the key to the door. I had to climb in.

zh: 今天海邊的浪不大，不適合去衝浪。
py: jīn tiān hǎi biān de làng bù dà ， bù shì hé qù chōng làng 。
en: The waves on the beach today are small and not suitable for surfing.

zh: 開會時他遲到了，只好悄悄地坐在會議室後面。
py: kāi huì shí tā chí dào le ， zhǐ hǎo qiāo qiāo dì zuò zài huì yì shì hòu miàn 。
en: He was late for the meeting and had to sit quietly behind the meeting room.

zh: 自殺或許能令個人不再受到痛苦，但卻把痛苦留給了身邊的人。
py: zì shā huò xǔ néng lìng gè rén bù zài shòu dào tòng kǔ ， dàn què bǎ tòng kǔ liú gěi le shēn biān de rén 。
en: Suicide may stop a person from suffering, but it is left to those around.

zh: 我愛看漫畫，在漫畫裡可以看見許多人們還沒實現的夢想。
py: wǒ ài kàn màn huà ， zài màn huà lǐ kě yǐ kàn jiàn xǔ duō rén men hái méi shí xiàn de mèng xiǎng 。
en: I love comics, and in them I see dreams that people have yet to realize.

zh: 喜劇中的男女主角，不論相處過程中碰到多少挫折，結局總是快樂又幸福的。
py: xǐ jù zhōng de nán nǚ zhǔ jué ， bù lùn xiāng chù guò chéng zhōng pèng dào duō shǎo cuò zhé ， jié jú zǒng shì kuài lè yòu xìng fú de 。
en: The leading men and women in comedy always end up happy and happy, no matter how many setbacks they encounter in each other's lives.

zh: 考完試以後，我們去海洋公園開開心心地玩一場吧。
py: kǎo wán shì yǐ hòu ， wǒ men qù hǎi yáng gōng yuán kāi kāi xīn xīn dì wán yī chǎng ba 。
en: After the test, let's go to Ocean Park and have a good time.

zh: 露營時我沒帶枕頭，只好把背包當作枕頭，睡起來挺不舒服的。
py: lù yíng shí wǒ méi dài zhěn tóu ， zhǐ hǎo bǎ bēi bāo dāng zuò zhěn tóu ， shuì qǐ lái tǐng bù shū fú de 。
en: I didn't bring a pillow when I was camping, so I used my backpack as a pillow and I didn't sleep well.

zh: 他本來是一滴酒都不碰的人，你就別再叫他喝了。
py: tā běn lái shì yī dī jiǔ dōu bù pèng de rén ， nǐ jiù bié zài jiào tā hē le 。
en: He's the one who hasn't touched a drop of wine, so don't tell him to drink it.

zh: 我曾經在賣精油的商店服務過一段時間。
py: wǒ céng jīng zài mài jīng yóu de shāng diàn fú wù guò yī duàn shí jiān 。
en: I've been working for a while in a store selling oil.

zh: 在天氣好的夜晚，星光看起來更加浪漫。
py: zài tiān qì hǎo de yè wǎn ， xīng guāng kàn qǐ lái gèng jiā làng màn 。
en: On good weather nights, starlight looks more romantic.

zh: 為了拍跟武術有關的電影，那位美國明星到中國學習了半年的中國功夫。
py: wèi le pāi gēn wǔ shù yǒu guān de diàn yǐng ， nà wèi měi guó míng xīng dào zhōng guó xué xí le bàn nián de zhōng guó gōng fu 。
en: To make a film about martial arts, the American star went to China to learn Chinese kung fu for six months.

zh: 一般來說，到舞廳跳舞的多數是年輕人。
py: yì bān lái shuō ， dào wǔ tīng tiào wǔ de duō shù shì nián qīng rén 。
en: Generally speaking, the majority of dancing in dance halls are young people.

zh: 這場籃球比賽我們贏了對方二十分，真是太痛快了。
py: zhè chǎng lán qiú bǐ sài wǒ men yíng le duì fāng èr shí fēn ， zhēn shì tài tòng kuài le 。
en: We won 20 points against each other in this basketball game. It's a real pain in the ass.

zh: 我聽見有人在敲門，你去看看是誰來了。
py: wǒ tīng jiàn yǒu rén zài qiāo mén ， nǐ qù kàn kàn shì shuí lái le 。
en: I heard someone knocking on the door. Go see who's coming.

zh: 他做運動時手甩得太用力，把手錶都甩得飛出去了。
py: tā zuò yùn dòng shí shǒu shuǎi dé tài yòng lì ， bǎ shǒu biǎo dōu shuǎi dé fēi chū qù le 。
en: When he was in sports, he threw his hand too hard, and his watch flew out.

zh: 我的朋友會理頭髮，為了省錢我們常常去找他。
py: wǒ de péng yǒu huì lǐ tóu fà ， wèi le shěng qián wǒ men cháng cháng qù zhǎo tā 。
en: My friend would cut his hair, and we used to go to him to save money.

zh: 以前學校規定女學生的髮型都要一樣，而且長度不能超過耳朵。
py: yǐ qián xué xiào guī dìng nǚ xué shēng de fà xíng dōu yào yī yàng ， ér qiě zhǎng dù bù néng chāo guò ěr duǒ 。
en: In the past, the school had established that female students had the same hairstyle and that they could not be longer than their ears.

zh: 他的中文能力已達到相當好的水準，在臺灣念研究所沒問題。
py: tā de zhōng wén néng lì yǐ dá dào xiāng dāng hǎo de shuǐ zhǔn ， zài tái wān niàn yán jiū suǒ méi wèn tí 。
en: His Chinese skills have reached a very good level, and his studies in Taiwan will be fine.

zh: 每年安排一段時間去旅行，說不定能帶給你更豐富的生活。
py: měi nián ān pái yī duàn shí jiān qù lǚ xíng ， shuō bù dìng néng dài gěi nǐ gèng fēng fù de shēng huó 。
en: We'll arrange a trip every year, and maybe it'll bring you a better life.

zh: 我們無法控制別人的行為，卻能夠改變自己的想法。
py: wǒ men wú fǎ kòng zhì bié rén de xíng wèi ， què néng gòu gǎi biàn zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ 。
en: We can't control what others do, but we can change our minds.

zh: 公司上頭要求小張一個人完成任務，同事們都認為有點兒勉強。
py: gōng sī shàng tóu yāo qiú xiǎo zhāng yī gè rén wán chéng rèn wù ， tóng shì men dōu rèn wèi yǒu diǎn ér miǎn qiáng 。
en: The company's superiors called for a small man to do the job, and colleagues felt a little reluctant.

zh: 你不需要事事都跟別人做比較，自己過得輕鬆愉快就好。
py: nǐ bù xū yào shì shì dōu gēn bié rén zuò bǐ jiào ， zì jǐ guò dé qīng sōng yú kuài jiù hǎo 。
en: You don't need to compare things with others. You just have to be comfortable.

zh: 你既然把工廠交給他，就得放手讓他去管理。
py: nǐ jì rán bǎ gōng chǎng jiāo gěi tā ， jiù dé fàng shǒu ràng tā qù guǎn lǐ 。
en: You give him the factory, you have to let him run it.

zh: 如果遇到無法處理的心理問題，最好請專業人員來輔導。
py: rú guǒ yù dào wú fǎ chù lǐ de xīn lǐ wèn tí ， zuì hǎo qǐng zhuān yè rén yuán lái fǔ dǎo 。
en: If there are mental problems that can't be dealt with, it's better to have professional staff to direct them.

zh: 從小時候起，他的第一志願就是當一位保護國家的軍人。
py: cóng xiǎo shí hòu qǐ ， tā de dì yī zhì yuàn jiù shì dāng yī wèi bǎo hù guó jiā de jūn rén 。
en: As a child, his first wish was to be a soldier to protect his country.

zh: 新員工在經過專門的訓練後，都已能使用工廠各種生產機器。
py: xīn yuán gōng zài jīng guò zhuān mén de xùn liàn hòu ， dōu yǐ néng shǐ yòng gōng chǎng gè zhǒng shēng chǎn jī qì 。
en: After special training, new workers have been able to use all kinds of manufacturing machines at the factory.

zh: 林老師是我的高中導師，在學習上也是影響我最深的人。
py: lín lǎo shī shì wǒ de gāo zhōng dǎo shī ， zài xué xí shàng yě shì yǐng xiǎng wǒ zuì shēn de rén 。
en: Mr. Lin is my high school teacher, and he's my deepest student.

zh: 每次有人拜託他幫忙，他都沒拒絕過，因此大家都說他是「好好先生」(yes-man)。
py: měi cì yǒu rén bài tuō tā bāng máng ， tā dōu méi jù jué guò ， yīn cǐ dà jiā dōu shuō tā shì 「 hǎo hǎo xiān shēng 」(yes-man)。
en: Every time he was asked to help, he never refused, so everyone said he was a "good man" (yes-man).

zh: 在照顧及教育孩子上，父母都具有相同的法律義務。
py: zài zhào gù jí jiào yù hái zi shàng ， fù mǔ dōu jù yǒu xiāng tóng de fǎ lǜ yì wù 。
en: Parents have the same legal obligations in the care and education of their children.

zh: 我從沒去過澳洲，無法想像那裡的景色有多美。
py: wǒ cóng méi qù guò ào zhōu ， wú fǎ xiǎng xiàng nà lǐ de jǐng sè yǒu duō měi 。
en: I've never been to Australia. I can't imagine how beautiful it is.

zh: 本地社區的房子常被好奇的觀光客破壞，令人們十分不滿。
py: běn dì shè qū de fáng zi cháng bèi hào qí de guān guāng kè pò huài ， lìng rén men shí fēn bù mǎn 。
en: Houses in the local community are often destroyed by curious tourists, which is very disheartening.

zh: 在指導演員的表達方式上，這位導演的經驗相當豐富。
py: zài zhǐ dǎo yǎn yuán de biǎo dá fāng shì shàng ， zhè wèi dǎo yǎn de jīng yàn xiāng dāng fēng fù 。
en: The director has a lot of experience in the way the director speaks.

zh: 如果想當語言教師，得先考取教師證書，將來找工作較順利。
py: rú guǒ xiǎng dāng yǔ yán jiào shī ， dé xiān kǎo qǔ jiào shī zhèng shū ， jiāng lái zhǎo gōng zuò jiào shùn lì 。
en: If you want to be a language teacher, you must first get a teacher's certificate, and you will find a better job.

zh: 有時一個人的前途無法先規劃好，必須自己創造。
py: yǒu shí yī gè rén de qián tú wú fǎ xiān guī huà hǎo ， bì xū zì jǐ chuàng zào 。
en: Sometimes a person's future cannot be planned first and must be created on his own.

zh: 有些事明明不對，卻因沒人敢說，久了以後就被社會接受了。
py: yǒu xiē shì míng míng bù duì ， què yīn méi rén gǎn shuō ， jiǔ le yǐ hòu jiù bèi shè huì jiē shòu le 。
en: Some things were wrong, but no one dared to say that they were accepted by society after a long time.

zh: 部分大學科系對學生成績的要求非常高，畢業條件也較嚴格。
py: bù fèn dà xué kē xì duì xué shēng chéng jī de yāo qiú fēi cháng gāo ， bì yè tiáo jiàn yě jiào yán gé 。
en: Some university faculties have very high performance requirements and strict graduation conditions.

zh: 花蓮太魯閣的確很漂亮，難怪每年都吸引許多觀光客去參觀。
py: huā lián tài lǔ gé de què hěn piào liàng ， nán guài měi nián dōu xī yǐn xǔ duō guān guāng kè qù cān guān 。
en: It's really pretty, no wonder it attracts a lot of tourists every year.

zh: 夏天在海灘上踏著浪散步，是一件非常享受的事。
py: xià tiān zài hǎi tān shàng tà zhù làng sàn bù ， shì yī jiàn fēi cháng xiǎng shòu de shì 。
en: It's a great pleasure to walk on the beach in the summer.

zh: 當你面臨困難或挑戰時，也正是表現個人智慧與能力的最佳時刻。
py: dāng nǐ miàn lín kùn nán huò tiāo zhàn shí ， yě zhèng shì biǎo xiàn gè rén zhì huì yǔ néng lì de zuì jiā shí kè 。
en: When you face difficulties or challenges, it is also the best time to demonstrate your personal wisdom and abilities.

zh: 在意外的發生原因沒查清楚之前，別隨便冤枉任何人。
py: zài yì wài de fā shēng yuán yīn méi chá qīng chǔ zhī qián ， bié suí biàn yuān wǎng rèn hé rén 。
en: Let no one be wronged until the reasons for the accident have been clearly identified.

zh: 你正好說出了我的心裡話，真是我的知心好友。
py: nǐ zhèng hǎo shuō chū le wǒ de xīn lǐ huà ， zhēn shì wǒ de zhī xīn hǎo yǒu 。
en: You've said exactly what I think you're saying. You're a good friend of mine.

zh: 伯父的孩子是對雙胞胎，不只是樣子，連說話的聲音都像。
py: bó fù de hái zi shì duì shuāng bāo tāi ， bù zhǐ shì yàng zi ， lián shuō huà de shēng yīn dōu xiàng 。
en: Uncle's kids are twins, not just twins, they even sound like talking.

zh: 自從去年伯母退休後，就帶著伯父到處去旅行了。
py: zì cóng qù nián bó mǔ tuì xiū hòu ， jiù dài zhù bó fù dào chù qù lǚ xíng le 。
en: Since she retired last year, she's been traveling with her uncle.

zh: 假如失去了人民的信心與支持，國家也會變得不安定。
py: jiǎ rú shī qù le rén mín de xìn xīn yǔ zhī chí ， guó jiā yě huì biàn dé bù ān dìng 。
en: If the confidence and support of the people are lost, the country will also become unstable.

zh: 我們應該培養獨立思考的能力，別被身邊各種訊息左右。
py: wǒ men yīng gāi péi yǎng dú lì sī kǎo de néng lì ， bié bèi shēn biān gè zhǒng xùn xī zuǒ yòu 。
en: We should develop the capacity to think independently and not be influenced by the various messages around us.

zh: 他今天去傳統市場買菜，特別做了拿手菜招待好友。
py: tā jīn tiān qù chuán tǒng shì chǎng mǎi cài ， tè bié zuò le ná shǒu cài zhāo dài hǎo yǒu 。
en: He went to the traditional market today to buy food, especially for his friends.

zh: 有些國家機場對攜帶物品的規定很嚴，出國前最好了解清楚。
py: yǒu xiē guó jiā jī chǎng duì xié dài wù pǐn de guī dìng hěn yán ， chū guó qián zuì hǎo liǎo jiě qīng chǔ 。
en: Some national airports have strict regulations on carrying items, which should be clear before leaving the country.

zh: 他一有不順心的事，就會嘮叨個沒完，有時真讓人受不了。
py: tā yī yǒu bù shùn xīn de shì ， jiù huì láo dāo gè méi wán ， yǒu shí zhēn ràng rén shòu bù liǎo 。
en: As soon as something goes wrong, he talks about it. Sometimes it's unbearable.

zh: 到外面做了丟人的事，自己和家人也會覺得丟臉。
py: dào wài miàn zuò le diū rén de shì ， zì jǐ hé jiā rén yě huì jué dé diū liǎn 。
en: If you do something embarrassing outside, you'll be ashamed of yourself and your family.

zh: 如果真心愛對方，就不必在乎對方的樣子與生活背景。
py: rú guǒ zhēn xīn ài duì fāng ， jiù bù bì zài hū duì fāng de yàng zi yǔ shēng huó bèi jǐng 。
en: If you really love each other, you don't have to care about each other's face and background.

zh: 在處理那位顧客的問題上，餐廳的態度真令我失望。
py: zài chù lǐ nà wèi gù kè de wèn tí shàng ， cān tīng de tài dù zhēn lìng wǒ shī wàng 。
en: I'm disappointed in the restaurant's attitude in dealing with the customer's problems.

zh: 申請留學的過程中，最讓人操心的可能就是寫讀書計畫了。
py: shēn qǐng liú xué de guò chéng zhōng ， zuì ràng rén cāo xīn de kě néng jiù shì xiě dú shū jì huà le 。
en: The most worrying part of the process of applying to study abroad is to write a book project.

zh: 我想了許多辦法去達成公司的目標，卻還是得不到主管的支持。
py: wǒ xiǎng le xǔ duō bàn fǎ qù dá chéng gōng sī de mù biāo ， què hái shì dé bú dào zhǔ guǎn de zhī chí 。
en: I've come up with a lot of ways to reach the goals of the company, but I still don't have the support of my supervisor.

zh: 如果說能回到過去，我最想放下工作，追求自己的興趣。
py: rú guǒ shuō néng huí dào guò qù ， wǒ zuì xiǎng fàng xià gōng zuò ， zhuī qiú zì jǐ de xìng qù 。
en: If I can go back to the past, I'd like to drop my job and pursue my interests.

zh: 在古代，國王所說的話是絕對的，也是最高的命令。
py: zài gǔ dài ， guó wáng suǒ shuō de huà shì jué duì de ， yě shì zuì gāo de mìng lìng 。
en: In ancient times, the king's words were absolute and supreme.

zh: 國王命下面的人死，那些人就非死不可。
py: guó wáng mìng xià miàn de rén sǐ ， nà xiē rén jiù fēi sǐ bù kě 。
en: Those who are under the king's command must die.

zh: 每次當我們在學習華語上遇到困難，老師總是耐心地教導大家。
py: měi cì dāng wǒ men zài xué xí huá yǔ shàng yù dào kùn nán ， lǎo shī zǒng shì nài xīn dì jiào dǎo dà jiā 。
en: Every time we encounter difficulties in learning Chinese, teachers are patient in teaching people.

zh: 好的開始是成功的一半，第一步往往最重要。
py: hǎo de kāi shǐ shì chéng gōng de yí bàn ， dì yī bù wǎng wǎng zuì zhòng yào 。
en: Good start is half of success, and the first step is often the most important.

zh: 這次座談會邀請了各領域的人們，主要目的是對國內的地方建設提一些建議。
py: zhè cì zuò tán huì yāo qǐng le gè lǐng yù de rén men ， zhǔ yào mù dì shì duì guó nèi de dì fāng jiàn shè tí yī xiē jiàn yì 。
en: The meeting, which brought together people from all fields, was aimed primarily at providing advice on local construction in the country.

zh: 我逛街時經過了一排小吃攤，就買幾樣回來當作宵夜。
py: wǒ guàng jiē shí jīng guò le yī pái xiǎo chī tān ， jiù mǎi jǐ yàng huí lái dāng zuò xiāo yè 。
en: When I went shopping, I went through a row of snacks and I bought some for dinner.

zh: 妳去面試時稍微化妝一下，是一種禮貌。
py: nǐ qù miàn shì shí shāo wēi huà zhuāng yī xià ， shì yī zhǒng lǐ mào 。
en: It's polite for you to put on a little makeup when you go to the interview.

zh: 經過我的說明，他反而有些糊塗了，看來我的解釋不太清楚。
py: jīng guò wǒ de shuō míng ， tā fǎn ér yǒu xiē hú tú le ， kàn lái wǒ de jiě shì bù tài qīng chǔ 。
en: After my instructions, he was a little confused, and I didn't seem to explain it very clearly.

zh: 為了發展個人事業而放下學業，多數人是很難做到的。
py: wèi le fā zhǎn gè rén shì yè ér fàng xià xué yè ， duō shù rén shì hěn nán zuò dào de 。
en: It is difficult for most people to put aside their studies in order to develop a human life.

zh: 去旅行的話，我有法子讓你用最少的預算擁有最豐富的行程。
py: qù lǚ xíng de huà ， wǒ yǒu fǎ zi ràng nǐ yòng zuì shǎo de yù suàn yōng yǒu zuì fēng fù de xíng chéng 。
en: If you go on a trip, I've got a way to get you the richest trip with a minimum budget.

zh: 小王的閱讀報告寫得很精彩，連教授都在課堂上當面誇獎他。
py: xiǎo wáng de yuè dú bào gào xiě dé hěn jīng cǎi ， lián jiào shòu dōu zài kè táng shàng dāng miàn kuā jiǎng tā 。
en: Wang's reading report was excellent, and even the professor praised him in front of the class.

zh: 除非別人願意，否則你不該強迫其他人全按你的意見做事。
py: chú fēi bié rén yuàn yì ， fǒu zé nǐ bù gāi qiáng pò qí tā rén quán àn nǐ de yì jiàn zuò shì 。
en: You shouldn't force anyone to do anything you want unless someone else wants to do it.

zh: 根據手機公司的分析，明年大尺寸手機的市場需求會提高五倍以上。
py: gēn jù shǒu jī gōng sī de fēn xī ， míng nián dà chǐ cùn shǒu jī de shì chǎng xū qiú huì tí gāo wǔ bèi yǐ shàng 。
en: According to the company's analysis, the market demand for large-scale mobile phones will increase more than fivefold next year.

zh: 最近酒後開車的車禍新聞越來越多，政府得好好處罰這些人。
py: zuì jìn jiǔ hòu kāi chē de chē huò xīn wén yuè lái yuè duō ， zhèng fǔ dé hǎo hǎo chù fá zhè xiē rén 。
en: Recently, more and more car accidents have been reported, and the government has had to punish these people.

zh: 我跟他的個性、想法都合得來，就是飲食習慣合不來。
py: wǒ gēn tā de gè xìng 、 xiǎng fǎ dōu hé dé lái ， jiù shì yǐn shí xí guàn hé bù lái 。
en: I fit in with his personality, his ideas, his eating habits.

zh: 這家醫院的規定一條又一條的，看得我眼睛都累了。
py: zhè jiā yī yuàn de guī dìng yī tiáo yòu yī tiáo de ， kàn dé wǒ yǎn jīng dōu lèi le 。
en: The hospital's rules are one by one, and my eyes are tired.

zh: 外面風大，最好穿件外套出門，免得感冒了。
py: wài miàn fēng dà ， zuì hǎo chuān jiàn wài tào chū mén ， miǎn de gǎn mào le 。
en: It's windy out there. Better wear a coat before you catch a cold.

zh: 教授學生做人的道理與教授知識同樣重要。
py: jiào shòu xué shēng zuò rén de dào lǐ yǔ jiào shòu zhī shí tóng yàng zhòng yào 。
en: The teaching of students as human beings is as important as their knowledge.

zh: 經過兩段不幸的感情生活，那位女士對愛情已失去了信心。
py: jīng guò liǎng duàn bù xìng de gǎn qíng shēng huó ， nà wèi nǚ shì duì ài qíng yǐ shī qù le xìn xīn 。
en: After two unfortunate relationships, the woman lost her faith in love.

zh: 我爸爸認為我們這一代做事不夠積極，缺少耐心。
py: wǒ bà bà rèn wèi wǒ men zhè yí dài zuò shì bù gòu jī jí ， quē shǎo nài xīn 。
en: My father believes that our generation is not sufficiently active and impatient.

zh: 當父母的總是希望子女將來能有成就，過著幸福的日子。
py: dāng fù mǔ de zǒng shì xī wàng zǐ nǚ jiāng lái néng yǒu chéng jiù ， guò zhù xìng fú de rì zi 。
en: Parents always want their children to be successful and to live happily ever after.

zh: 要想成為成功的上班族，一切就得照規矩來。
py: yào xiǎng chéng wèi chéng gōng de shàng bān zú ， yī qiè jiù dé zhào guī jǔ lái 。
en: To be a successful worker, everything has to be done according to the rules.

zh: 他只是開個小玩笑而已，你何必那麼在乎呢？
py: tā zhǐ shì kāi gè xiǎo wán xiào ér yǐ ， nǐ hé bì nà me zài hū ne ？
en: He's just making a little joke. Why do you care?

zh: 為了使客戶安心使用，我們公司產品訂了嚴格的生產標準。
py: wèi le shǐ kè hù ān xīn shǐ yòng ， wǒ men gōng sī chǎn pǐn dìng le yán gé de shēng chǎn biāo zhǔn 。
en: In order to reassure our clients, we have strict production standards for our products.

zh: 一小部分人引起的戰爭使人民付出了相當大的代價。
py: yī xiǎo bù fèn rén yǐn qǐ de zhàn zhēng shǐ rén mín fù chū le xiāng dāng dà de dài jià 。
en: The war caused by a small number of people has cost the people quite a lot.

zh: 嬰兒學說話時，身邊的人說什麼，他們就會照著說。
py: yīng ér xué shuō huà shí ， shēn biān de rén shuō shén me ， tā men jiù huì zhào zhù shuō 。
en: When the baby learns to speak, the people around him say what they say.

zh: 學習外國語言時最好能找位專業的老師，好改正自己的錯誤。
py: xué xí wài guó yǔ yán shí zuì hǎo néng zhǎo wèi zhuān yè de lǎo shī ， hǎo gǎi zhèng zì jǐ de cuò wù 。
en: When studying foreign languages, it is best to find a professional teacher to correct his own mistakes.

zh: 經過那次任務教訓後，小周做事就變得更加小心了。
py: jīng guò nà cì rèn wù jiào xùn hòu ， xiǎo zhōu zuò shì jiù biàn dé gèng jiā xiǎo xīn le 。
en: After that mission, Cho became more careful.

zh: 她愛好化妝、穿名牌服裝，目的是希望別人讚美她。
py: tā ài hǎo huà zhuāng 、 chuān míng pái fú zhuāng ， mù dì shì xī wàng bié rén zàn měi tā 。
en: She likes to put on makeup and wear brand-name clothes in order to hope that others will praise her.

zh: 他來臺灣主要是想了解當地風俗，此外也想學習一點兒華語。
py: tā lái tái wān zhǔ yào shì xiǎng liǎo jiě dāng dì fēng sú ， cǐ wài yě xiǎng xué xí yī diǎn ér huá yǔ 。
en: He came to Taiwan mainly to learn about local customs and learn a little Chinese.

zh: 不要僅根據表面來判斷一個人或一件事，得花時間深入瞭解。
py: bú yào jǐn gēn jù biǎo miàn lái pàn duàn yī gè rén huò yī jiàn shì ， dé huā shí jiān shēn rù liǎo jiě 。
en: Don't judge a person or one thing from the surface alone. It takes time to get to the bottom of it.

zh: 這家公司的工作條件和待遇都不錯，吸引不少年輕人來面試。
py: zhè jiā gōng sī de gōng zuò tiáo jiàn hé dài yù dōu bù cuò ， xī yǐn bù shǎo nián qīng rén lái miàn shì 。
en: The company has good working conditions and treatments and attracts a lot of young people to interview.

zh: 亞洲地區發生了嚴重的流行病，使人民受到相當大的生活壓力。
py: yà zhōu dì qū fā shēng le yán zhòng de liú xíng bìng ， shǐ rén mín shòu dào xiāng dāng dà de shēng huó yā lì 。
en: The Asian region has experienced a severe epidemic that has put people under considerable strain in their lives.

zh: 亞洲地區發生了戰爭，使人民生活上所受的的壓力相當大。
py: yà zhōu dì qū fā shēng le zhàn zhēng ， shǐ rén mín shēng huó shàng suǒ shòu de de yā lì xiāng dāng dà 。
en: Wars have taken place in Asia, putting considerable strain on people's lives.

zh: 他相當迷那位明星，因此不管穿的用的都模仿他。
py: tā xiāng dāng mí nà wèi míng xīng ， yīn cǐ bù guǎn chuān de yòng de dōu mó fǎng tā 。
en: He's pretty fascinated with the star, so he imitates him with whatever he wears.

zh: 有些國家的傳統戲劇常利用影子和燈光效果來表演。
py: yǒu xiē guó jiā de chuán tǒng xì jù cháng lì yòng yǐng zi hé dēng guāng xiào guǒ lái biǎo yǎn 。
en: In some countries, traditional theatres often use shadow and light to perform.

zh: 做事不順利時別只想著逃避，得好好面對才行。
py: zuò shì bù shùn lì shí bié zhǐ xiǎng zhù táo bì ， dé hǎo hǎo miàn duì cái xíng 。
en: Don't try to escape when things don't go well. You have to deal with them.

zh: 他去當環保志工是為了保護自然環境，也是為了培養耐心。
py: tā qù dāng huán bǎo zhì gōng shì wèi le bǎo hù zì rán huán jìng ， yě shì wèi le péi yǎng nài xīn 。
en: He went to work as an environmental volunteer to protect the natural environment and to foster patience.

zh: 那個小孩跑得太快，一不小心就跌倒了。
py: nà gè xiǎo hái pǎo dé tài kuài ， yí bù xiǎo xīn jiù diē dǎo le 。
en: The kid ran too fast and fell.

zh: 根據美國某項研究資料，青少年因腦震盪而被送到醫院的意外中，超過一半是因為激烈運動引起的。
py: gēn jù měi guó mǒu xiàng yán jiū zī liào ， qīng shào nián yīn nǎo zhèn dàng ér bèi sòng dào yī yuàn de yì wài zhōng ， chāo guò yí bàn shì yīn wèi jī liè yùn dòng yǐn qǐ de 。
en: According to a study in the United States, more than half of the accidents in which young people are taken to hospitals because of concussions are caused by intense activity.

zh: 根據手術的種類，病人在動手術前能吃的食物也不太相同。
py: gēn jù shǒu shù de zhǒng lèi ， bìng rén zài dòng shǒu shù qián néng chī de shí wù yě bù tài xiāng tóng 。
en: Depending on the type of operation, the food that a patient can eat before surgery is different.

zh: 他的頭部被棒球打中並當場昏迷，還好幾分鐘後就醒過來了。
py: tā de tóu bù bèi bàng qiú dǎ zhòng bìng dāng chǎng hūn mí ， hái hǎo jǐ fēn zhōng hòu jiù xǐng guò lái le 。
en: He was hit in the head with a baseball bat and was unconscious in the act. He woke up a few minutes later.

zh: 張小姐很膽小，看到車禍現場有人流了很多血，當場就昏倒了。
py: zhāng xiǎo jiě hěn dǎn xiǎo ， kàn dào chē huò xiàn chǎng yǒu rén liú le hěn duō xuè ， dāng chǎng jiù hūn dào le 。
en: Miss Zhang was scared, and when she saw a lot of blood on the scene of the car accident, she fainted.

zh: 一個人不管多有錢、多有地位，過世之後什麼也帶不走。
py: yī gè rén bù guǎn duō yǒu qián 、 duō yǒu dì wèi ， guò shì zhī hòu shén me yě dài bù zǒu 。
en: No matter how rich and powerful a person may be, nothing can be taken away from him after his death.

zh: 總統到地震災區慰問災民，並保證會協助他們恢復正常的生活。
py: zǒng tǒng dào dì zhèn zāi qū wèi wèn zāi mín ， bìng bǎo zhèng huì xié zhù tā men huī fù zhèng cháng de shēng huó 。
en: The President went to the earthquake area to comfort the victims and promised to help them get back to normal life.

zh: 現在去醫院拿藥，藥袋上都會把藥方及使用方式寫得很清楚。
py: xiàn zài qù yī yuàn ná yào ， yào dài shàng dōu huì bǎ yào fāng jí shǐ yòng fāng shì xiě dé hěn qīng chǔ 。
en: Now go to the hospital to get the medicine, and the medicine bag will be clear about the medicine and how it's used.

zh: 那個病人不知道中了哪一種毒，不僅皮膚變黑，也昏迷好幾天了。
py: nà gè bìng rén bù zhī dào zhōng le nǎ yī zhǒng dú ， bù jǐn pí fū biàn hēi ， yě hūn mí hǎo jǐ tiān le 。
en: The patient did not know what kind of poison had been hit, not only had his skin blackened, but had been unconscious for several days.

zh: 有些事忍耐一下就過去了，什麼都想以吵架的方式解決，遲早會出事的。
py: yǒu xiē shì rěn nài yī xià jiù guò qù le ， shén me dōu xiǎng yǐ chǎo jià de fāng shì jiě jué ， chí zǎo huì chū shì de 。
en: Some things go away with patience, everything wants to be settled by a fight, and something will happen sooner or later.

zh: 對我來說，食物營養不營養無所謂，只要好吃就行了。
py: duì wǒ lái shuō ， shí wù yíng yǎng bù yíng yǎng wú suǒ wèi ， zhǐ yào hǎo chī jiù xíng le 。
en: For me, it doesn't matter if the food is not nutritious, as long as it's good.

zh: 要是你擔心營養不夠的話，吃點兒維他命對身體健康會有幫助的。
py: yào shì nǐ dān xīn yíng yǎng bù gòu de huà ， chī diǎn ér wéi tā mìng duì shēn tǐ jiàn kāng huì yǒu bāng zhù de 。
en: If you're worried about lack of nutrition, it's good for your health to have some vitamins.

zh: 當外科醫生不容易，不僅要有手術的專業能力，體力也得夠好。
py: dāng wài kē yī shēng bù róng yì ， bù jǐn yào yǒu shǒu shù de zhuān yè néng lì ， tǐ lì yě dé gòu hǎo 。
en: Being a surgeon is not easy, not only does it require a professional ability to operate, but it also has to be strong enough.

zh: 這家醫院的內科有最新設備，因此成為許多病人的第一選擇。
py: zhè jiā yī yuàn de nèi kē yǒu zuì xīn shè bèi ， yīn cǐ chéng wèi xǔ duō bìng rén de dì yī xuǎn zé 。
en: The hospital's internal medicine is state-of-the-art and is therefore the first option for many patients.

zh: A:幸虧有你的建議，投資計畫才有很好的結果，真是多謝你了？ B:哪裡哪裡，都是你自己努力得到的成果，要謝就謝你自己吧！
py: A: xìng kuī yǒu nǐ de jiàn yì ， tóu zī jì huà cái yǒu hěn hǎo de jié guǒ ， zhēn shì duō xiè nǐ le ？ B: nǎ lǐ nǎ lǐ ， dōu shì nǐ zì jǐ nǔ lì dé dào de chéng guǒ ， yào xiè jiù xiè nǐ zì jǐ ba ！
en: A: Thank you very much for the good results of the investment plan, thanks to your advice. B: Thank you for everything you've worked for.

zh: 他第一次嘗試滑雪，跌了好幾次，好不容易才學會。
py: tā dì yī cì cháng shì huá xuě ， diē le hǎo jǐ cì ， hǎo bù róng yì cái xué huì 。
en: He tried skiing for the first time and fell several times before learning.

zh: 醫生說，要是睡前喝了太多水，早上起來時臉就會有點兒腫。
py: yī shēng shuō ， yào shì shuì qián hē le tài duō shuǐ ， zǎo shàng qǐ lái shí liǎn jiù huì yǒu diǎn ér zhǒng 。
en: The doctor said that if you drank too much water before sleeping, your face would get a little swollen in the morning.

zh: 像足球、籃球那樣激烈的運動，常讓運動員的小腿、手、腳受傷。
py: xiàng zú qiú 、 lán qiú nà yàng jī liè de yùn dòng ， cháng ràng yùn dòng yuán de xiǎo tuǐ 、 shǒu 、 jiǎo shòu shāng 。
en: Heated sports like football and basketball often hurt athletes' calves, hands and feet.

zh: 台灣這場地震的規模很大，使許多人受輕傷、重傷。
py: tái wān zhè chǎng dì zhèn de guī mó hěn dà ， shǐ xǔ duō rén shòu qīng shāng 、 zhòng shāng 。
en: The magnitude of the earthquake in Taiwan was so large that many people were lightly injured and badly injured.

zh: 當我聽到被公司錄取的消息時，還以為是做夢，忍不住用力捏了自己一下。
py: dāng wǒ tīng dào bèi gōng sī lù qǔ de xiāo xī shí ， hái yǐ wèi shì zuò mèng ， rěn bú zhù yòng lì niē le zì jǐ yī xià 。
en: When I heard about the company, I thought it was a dream and I had to squeeze myself.

zh: 奶奶養了幾隻雞，每天早上習慣抓兩把玉米餵牠們。
py: nǎi nǎi yǎng le jǐ zhī jī ， měi tiān zǎo shàng xí guàn zhuā liǎng bǎ yù mǐ wèi tā men 。
en: Grandma had a couple of chickens and used to grab two corns every morning to feed them.

zh: 早上在草地上散步，突然看見一條蛇經過，害得我一直流冷汗。
py: zǎo shàng zài cǎo dì shàng sàn bù ， tū rán kàn jiàn yī tiáo shé jīng guò ， hài dé wǒ yì zhí liú lěng hàn 。
en: And he walked in the morning on the grass, and suddenly he saw a snake passing by, causing me to sweat coldly.

zh: 對夏天一活動汗就流個不停的女性來說，化妝實在是件麻煩事。
py: duì xià tiān yī huó dòng hàn jiù liú gè bù tíng de nǚ xìng lái shuō ， huà zhuāng shí zài shì jiàn má fán shì 。
en: For a woman who sweats all the time in the summer, makeup is a problem.

zh: 軍人接到任務時，不管多麼危險都得努力完成。
py: jūn rén jiē dào rèn wù shí ， bù guǎn duō me wēi xiǎn dōu dé nǔ lì wán chéng 。
en: Military personnel, however dangerous they may be, have to try to accomplish their task.

zh: 科學家在他的時代所努力的結果，都可能會在未來開花結果。
py: kē xué jiā zài tā de shí dài suǒ nǔ lì de jié guǒ ， dōu kě néng huì zài wèi lái kāi huā jié guǒ 。
en: The results of the scientists' efforts in his time are likely to flourish in the future.

zh: 在中國北方，所謂的「大夫」就是醫師，做的是替人醫病的工作。
py: zài zhōng guó běi fāng ， suǒ wèi de 「 dà fū 」 jiù shì yī shī ， zuò de shì tì rén yī bìng de gōng zuò 。
en: In the north of China, the so-called "doctor" is a doctor who works for people who are sick.

zh: 好餐廳的第一條件就是保持乾淨，讓客人有舒適的環境。
py: hǎo cān tīng de dì yī tiáo jiàn jiù shì bǎo chí qián jìng ， ràng kè rén yǒu shū shì de huán jìng 。
en: The first element of a good restaurant is to keep it clean so that the guests can have a comfortable environment.

zh: 當別人遇到不愉快的事時，應該避免說些刺激他的話。
py: dāng bié rén yù dào bù yú kuài de shì shí ， yīng gāi bì miǎn shuō xiē cì jī tā de huà 。
en: When people encounter unpleasant things, they should refrain from provoking him.

zh: 他手上有傷，醫師建議他三日以內不要碰水，以免感染。
py: tā shǒu shàng yǒu shāng ， yī shī jiàn yì tā sān rì yǐ nèi bú yào pèng shuǐ ， yǐ miǎn gǎn rǎn 。
en: He had injuries on his hands and the doctor advised him not to touch the water for three days in order to avoid infection.

zh: 有的小朋友很討厭打針，一看見護理師拿針筒(medical syringe)的樣子就哭了。
py: yǒu de xiǎo péng yǒu hěn tǎo yàn dǎ zhēn ， yī kàn jiàn hù lǐ shī ná zhēn tǒng (medical syringe) de yàng zi jiù kū le 。
en: Some kids hated needles and cried as soon as they saw the nurse holding the syringe.

zh: 我的裙子破了個洞，還好室友有針和線，幫我補了起來。
py: wǒ de qún zi pò le gè dòng ， hái hǎo shì yǒu yǒu zhēn hé xiàn ， bāng wǒ bǔ le qǐ lái 。
en: I broke a hole in my dress, but my roommate had needles and threads to fix.

zh: 今天上健康教育課時，老師在教室裡掛了一張人體血管圖。
py: jīn tiān shàng jiàn kāng jiào yù kè shí ， lǎo shī zài jiào shì lǐ guà le yī zhāng rén tǐ xuè guǎn tú 。
en: Today, in the course of health education, the teacher hangs a human vein in the classroom.

zh: 那個甜點的顏色像鮮血一樣，讓我嚇了一跳。
py: nà gè tián diǎn de yán sè xiàng xiān xuè yī yàng ， ràng wǒ xià le yī tiào 。
en: The color of the dessert was like blood, and it scared me.

zh: 大多數的模特兒都是腿長腰細的，穿什麼服裝都好看。
py: dà duō shù de mó tè ér dōu shì tuǐ zhǎng yāo xì de ， chuān shén me fú zhuāng dōu hǎo kàn 。
en: Most of the models have legs and legs. They look good in any suit.

zh: 坐火車時，一旁的旅客不停地講電話，吵得我受不了。
py: zuò huǒ chē shí ， yī páng de lǚ kè bù tíng dì jiǎng diàn huà ， chǎo dé wǒ shòu bù liǎo 。
en: When I was on the train, the passengers on the side kept talking on the phone, and I couldn't stand the noise.

zh: 今天光是整理前院的花草樹木就讓我累得要命，只好明天再整理後院了。
py: jīn tiān guāng shì zhěng lǐ qián yuàn de huā cǎo shù mù jiù ràng wǒ lèi dé yào mìng ， zhǐ hǎo míng tiān zài zhěng lǐ hòu yuàn le 。
en: I'm tired of cleaning the garden trees in the front yard alone today, so I'll have to clean up the backyard tomorrow.

zh: 談生意時千萬別打斷客戶的話，不然做生意的機會很可能就斷了。
py: tán shēng yì shí qiān wàn bié dǎ duàn kè hù de huà ， bù rán zuò shēng yì de jī huì hěn kě néng jiù duàn le 。
en: Don't interrupt your clients when you talk about business, otherwise the chances of doing business are likely to be broken.

zh: 我買了一個機器，不但能幫我量體重，還能量身高。
py: wǒ mǎi le yī gè jī qì ， bù dàn néng bāng wǒ liàng tǐ zhòng ， hái néng liàng shēn gāo 。
en: I bought a machine that not only weighs me, but also heights.

zh: 動物的體溫不見得都是不變的，像蛇的體溫就隨著環境而變。
py: dòng wù de tǐ wēn bù jiàn dé dōu shì bù biàn de ， xiàng shé de tǐ wēn jiù suí zhù huán jìng ér biàn 。
en: The temperature of animals remains constant, and the temperature of snakes changes with the environment.

zh: 醫師要我到廁所大便，再拿一點兒放在盒子送去檢查。
py: yī shī yào wǒ dào cè suǒ dà biàn ， zài ná yī diǎn ér fàng zài hé zi sòng qù jiǎn chá 。
en: The doctor asked me to take a shit in the toilet and put some in the box for a check.

zh: 想小便的時候千萬別忍耐，否則對健康的影響相當大。
py: xiǎng xiǎo biàn de shí hòu qiān wàn bié rěn nài ， fǒu zé duì jiàn kāng de yǐng xiǎng xiāng dāng dà 。
en: Don't take it when you want to pee, or it'll have a huge impact on health.

zh: 媽媽發現嬰兒尿得整件內褲都是尿，就幫他換了新的。
py: mā mā fā xiàn yīng ér niào dé zhěng jiàn nèi kù dōu shì niào ， jiù bāng tā huàn le xīn de 。
en: Mom found out that the baby peed all over his underwear and changed it.

zh: 黃媽媽感冒那幾天，她女兒每天煮粥給她吃，真是懂事。
py: huáng mā mā gǎn mào nà jǐ tiān ， tā nǚ ér měi tiān zhǔ zhōu gěi tā chī ， zhēn shì dǒng shì 。
en: The days when Huang's mother had a cold, her daughter cooks her porridge every day.

zh: 我最近皮膚又紅又癢，暫時不能吃太辣或太鹹的食物。
py: wǒ zuì jìn pí fū yòu hóng yòu yǎng ， zàn shí bù néng chī tài là huò tài xián de shí wù 。
en: I haven't been able to eat too hot or too salty for a while.

zh: 貓很享受抓癢，但要是你抓錯地方或方式不對，反而會使貓發脾氣。
py: māo hěn xiǎng shòu zhuā yǎng ， dàn yào shì nǐ zhuā cuò dì fāng huò fāng shì bù duì ， fǎn ér huì shǐ māo fā pí qì 。
en: Cats enjoy scratching, but if you catch the wrong place or the wrong way, they get angry.

zh: 他正在修改明天要交出去的計畫，你別去打擾他。
py: tā zhèng zài xiū gǎi míng tiān yào jiāo chū qù de jì huà ， nǐ bié qù dǎ rǎo tā 。
en: He's revising the plan to be handed over tomorrow. Don't bother him.

zh: 商品想賣得好，就得準備一筆廣告費，多多宣傳。
py: shāng pǐn xiǎng mài dé hǎo ， jiù dé zhǔn bèi yī bǐ guǎng gào fèi ， duō duō xuān chuán 。
en: If the goods are to be sold well, we'll have to prepare a bill for advertising more.

zh: 他現在的身體狀況很糟，請暫時先別去探他的病。
py: tā xiàn zài de shēn tǐ zhuàng kuàng hěn zāo ， qǐng zàn shí xiān bié qù tàn tā de bìng 。
en: He's in bad health. Please don't visit him for a while.

zh: 開車時千萬別把頭探出車窗外，以免發生危險。
py: kāi chē shí qiān wàn bié bǎ tóu tàn chū chē chuāng wài ， yǐ miǎn fā shēng wēi xiǎn 。
en: Keep your head out of the window while you're driving, so that there is no danger.

zh: 水災過後應立刻打掃環境，才能降低傳染病流行的機會。
py: shuǐ zāi guò hòu yīng lì kè dǎ sǎo huán jìng ， cái néng jiàng dī chuán rǎn bìng liú xíng de jī huì 。
en: It is important to clean up the environment immediately after the floods in order to reduce the prevalence of the disease.

zh: 有些病頭幾個月的症狀不明顯，得做進一步的檢查才能確定。
py: yǒu xiē bìng tóu jǐ gè yuè de zhèng zhuàng bù míng xiǎn ， dé zuò jìn yī bù de jiǎn chá cái néng què dìng 。
