en: The symptoms of some of the patients for several months are not obvious and will have to be examined further before they can be identified.

zh: 那位教授提供病毒給軍隊使用，有些人認為他應該出來道歉。
py: nà wèi jiào shòu tí gōng bìng dú gěi jūn duì shǐ yòng ， yǒu xiē rén rèn wèi tā yīng gāi chū lái dào qiàn 。
en: The professor offered the virus to be used by the army, and some thought he should come out and apologize.

zh: 這次傳染病的病毒很厲害，出門得戴著口罩，免得被傳染。
py: zhè cì chuán rǎn bìng de bìng dú hěn lì hài ， chū mén dé dài zhù kǒu zhào ， miǎn de bèi chuán rǎn 。
en: The virus was very powerful and had to wear a mask to get out of the house before it got infected.

zh: 學校的布告欄總是隨著季節改變而有不同的設計。
py: xué xiào de bù gào lán zǒng shì suí zhù jì jié gǎi biàn ér yǒu bù tóng de shè jì 。
en: School bulletin boards are always designed differently as the seasons change.

zh: 公司的布告上貼著超市打折活動的廣告，感覺真的很怪。
py: gōng sī de bù gào shàng tiē zhù chāo shì dǎ zhé huó dòng de guǎng gào ， gǎn jué zhēn de hěn guài 。
en: It's really weird that the company's bulletins are ads with supermarket discounts.

zh: 公司的工作須知訂得非常詳細，不過從來沒有員工仔細看完。
py: gōng sī de gōng zuò xū zhī dìng dé fēi cháng xiáng xì ， bù guò cóng lái méi yǒu yuán gōng zǎi xì kàn wán 。
en: The company's work has to be very detailed, but it has never been done with staff.

zh: 開會前經理要求大家勿開手機，專心討論會議內容。
py: kāi huì qián jīng lǐ yāo qiú dà jiā wù kāi shǒu jī ， zhuān xīn tǎo lùn huì yì nèi róng 。
en: Before the meeting, the manager asked everyone not to turn on their cell phones and to focus on the content of the meeting.

zh: 帶孩子到餐廳用餐，得提醒他們別到處奔跑，免得跌倒。
py: dài hái zi dào cān tīng yòng cān ， dé tí xǐng tā men bié dào chù bēn pǎo ， miǎn de diē dǎo 。
en: Take the children to the dining room and remind them not to run around before they fall.

zh: 為了人民的健康，許多國家都禁止進口受到環境汙染的農產品。
py: wèi le rén mín de jiàn kāng ， xǔ duō guó jiā dōu jìn zhǐ jìn kǒu shòu dào huán jìng wū rǎn de nóng chǎn pǐn 。
en: For the sake of the health of the people, many countries prohibit imports of environmentally contaminated agricultural products.

zh: 那家工廠排出的黑煙不只氣味難聞，更可怕的是可能對肺部造成傷害。
py: nà jiā gōng chǎng pái chū de hēi yān bù zhǐ qì wèi nán wén ， gèng kě pà de shì kě néng duì fèi bù zào chéng shāng hài 。
en: The black smoke from that factory was not only smelly, it was even more terrible that it could cause damage to the lungs.

zh: 對科學家或藝術家來說，提供他們一個不受限制的工作環境是很重要的。
py: duì kē xué jiā huò yì shù jiā lái shuō ， tí gōng tā men yī gè bù shòu xiàn zhì de gōng zuò huán jìng shì hěn zhòng yào de 。
en: For scientists or artists, it is important to provide them with an unrestricted working environment.

zh: 父母要求孩子不論在任何情況都不許騙人。
py: fù mǔ yāo qiú hái zi bù lùn zài rèn hé qíng kuàng dōu bù xǔ piàn rén 。
en: The parents demanded that children should not lie under any circumstances.

zh: 如果你亂吃垃圾食品，就算按時運動，體重也很難減輕。
py: rú guǒ nǐ luàn chī lā jī shí pǐn ， jiù suàn àn shí yùn dòng ， tǐ zhòng yě hěn nán jiǎn qīng 。
en: If you eat junk food, it's hard to lose weight even if you move on time.

zh: 個人在使用各式各樣的網路服務時，也應該注意隱私問題。
py: gè rén zài shǐ yòng gè shì gè yàng de wǎng lù fú wù shí ， yě yīng gāi zhù yì yǐn sī wèn tí 。
en: When using a variety of Internet services, individuals should also be aware of privacy issues.

zh: 當我難過的時候，最需要的是家人與好友的安慰。
py: dāng wǒ nán guò de shí hòu ， zuì xū yào de shì jiā rén yǔ hǎo yǒu de ān wèi 。
en: When I'm sad, what I need most is the comfort of family and friends.

zh: 隨著空氣被汙染的情況越來越嚴重，得到癌症的機會也增加了。
py: suí zhù kōng qì bèi wū rǎn de qíng kuàng yuè lái yuè yán zhòng ， dé dào ái zhèng de jī huì yě zēng jiā le 。
en: As the air gets contaminated, access to cancer increases.

zh: 這位外科醫師不僅很會開刀，對病人也很有耐心。
py: zhè wèi wài kē yī shī bù jǐn hěn huì kāi dāo ， duì bìng rén yě hěn yǒu nài xīn 。
en: This surgeon is not only good at opening up, but also patient.

zh: 我好友都已結婚了，什麼時候才換我辦喜事，請大家喝喜酒？
py: wǒ hǎo yǒu dōu yǐ jié hūn le ， shén me shí hòu cái huàn wǒ bàn xǐ shì ， qǐng dà jiā hē xǐ jiǔ ？
en: My friends are married. When will I have a wedding?

zh: 聽說那位新郎在事業上很有成就，況且優點也不少，跟他結婚的女人應該很幸福。
py: tīng shuō nà wèi xīn láng zài shì yè shàng hěn yǒu chéng jiù ， kuàng qiě yōu diǎn yě bù shǎo ， gēn tā jié hūn de nǚ rén yīng gāi hěn xìng fú 。
en: I heard that the groom had been very successful in his career and had been very good, and that the woman he married should be happy.

zh: 客人都抵達婚禮現場了，新娘卻還沒開始化妝，太誇張了！
py: kè rén dōu dǐ dá hūn lǐ xiàn chǎng le ， xīn niáng què hái méi kāi shǐ huà zhuāng ， tài kuā zhāng le ！
en: The guests arrived at the wedding, but the bride hasn't started wearing makeup. It's exaggerating!

zh: 旗袍是華人最有特色的服裝之一，我想訂一套屬於我的旗袍。
py: qí páo shì huá rén zuì yǒu tè sè de fú zhuāng zhī yī ， wǒ xiǎng dìng yī tào shǔ yú wǒ de qí páo 。
en: It's one of China's most distinctive costumes, and I'd like to order one for me.

zh: 在臺灣，目前已被發現的蝴蝶大約有三百七十種以上。
py: zài tái wān ， mù qián yǐ bèi fā xiàn de hú dié dà yuē yǒu sān bǎi qī shí zhǒng yǐ shàng 。
en: In Taiwan, there are currently more than 370 kinds of butterflies found.

zh: 阿里山上的樹木又高又粗，好幾棵樹木的年齡都超過一千年了。
py: ā lǐ shān shàng de shù mù yòu gāo yòu cū ， hǎo jǐ kē shù mù de nián líng dōu chāo guò yī qiān nián le 。
en: The trees on Mount Ali are tall and thick, and several trees are over a thousand years old.

zh: 我大哥去年娶了英國太太，我們都好喜歡這位美麗的大嫂。
py: wǒ dà gē qù nián qǔ le yīng guó tài tài ， wǒ men dōu hǎo xǐ huān zhè wèi měi lì de dà sǎo 。
en: My brother married a British wife last year, and we all loved this beautiful sister-in-law.

zh: 王媽媽一直把媳婦當作自己的女兒，當他們家的媳婦真幸福。
py: wáng mā mā yì zhí bǎ xí fù dāng zuò zì jǐ de nǚ ér ， dāng tā men jiā de xí fù zhēn xìng fú 。
en: His mother had always treated her as her daughter-in-law and was happy to be the daughter-in-law of her family.

zh: 我好友昨天和女朋友分手了，這幾天心情很糟，我得去安慰安慰他。
py: wǒ hǎo yǒu zuó tiān hé nǚ péng yǒu fēn shǒu le ， zhè jǐ tiān xīn qíng hěn zāo ， wǒ dé qù ān wèi ān wèi tā 。
en: My friend broke up with his girlfriend yesterday. I was in a bad mood these days and I had to go and comfort him.

zh: 在自由戀愛的時代中，還是有人透過相親的方式來認識另一半。
py: zài zì yóu liàn ài de shí dài zhōng ， hái shì yǒu rén tòu guò xiāng qīn de fāng shì lái rèn shí lìng yí bàn 。
en: In the age of free love, someone knew the other half through a relationship.

zh: 我們全家都是信基督教的，不論教會舉辦什麼活動，我們都一定去參加。
py: wǒ men quán jiā dōu shì xìn jī dū jiào de ， bù lùn jiào huì jǔ bàn shén me huó dòng ， wǒ men dōu yí dìng qù cān jiā 。
en: We're all Christian. We're all going to any event at the church.

zh: 我同事下個月總算要和交往十年的女朋友結婚了，真是不容易啊！。
py: wǒ tóng shì xià gè yuè zǒng suàn yào hé jiāo wǎng shí nián de nǚ péng yǒu jié hūn le ， zhēn shì bù róng yì a ！。
en: It's not easy for my colleague to finally get married to a girlfriend who's been dating for 10 years next month.

zh: 以往在冬天才開的花，沒想到夏天就開了，大家都覺得很意外。
py: yǐ wǎng zài dōng tiān cái kāi de huā ， méi xiǎng dào xià tiān jiù kāi le ， dà jiā dōu jué dé hěn yì wài 。
en: The flowers that used to bloom in the winter, the summers, they all came as a surprise.

zh: 那位新郎的歲數比新娘大十五歲，可是兩人看起來一樣年輕。
py: nà wèi xīn láng de suì shù bǐ xīn niáng dà shí wǔ suì ， kě shì liǎng rén kàn qǐ lái yī yàng nián qīng 。
en: The groom was 15 years older than the bride, but the two looked just as young.

zh: 在華人社會中，見面時晚輩先問候長輩是應有的禮貌。
py: zài huá rén shè huì zhōng ， jiàn miàn shí wǎn bèi xiān wèn hòu zhǎng bèi shì yīng yǒu de lǐ mào 。
en: In Chinese society, it is a courtesy to greet elders at a later age.

zh: 他在國外旅行時因為簽證有問題，回國時間只好提前了。
py: tā zài guó wài lǚ xíng shí yīn wèi qiān zhèng yǒu wèn tí ， huí guó shí jiān zhǐ hǎo tí qián le 。
en: When he was travelling abroad, he had to go back early because of a visa problem.

zh: 王先生上週向他女友求婚，沒想到才過了幾天就訂婚了。
py: wáng xiān shēng shàng zhōu xiàng tā nǚ yǒu qiú hūn ， méi xiǎng dào cái guò le jǐ tiān jiù dìng hūn le 。
en: Mr. Wang proposed to his girlfriend last week, but it was only a few days before he was engaged.

zh: 不管未婚或者已婚的人，在現實生活中都有需要面對的問題。
py: bù guǎn wèi hūn huò zhě yǐ hūn de rén ， zài xiàn shí shēng huó zhōng dū yǒu xū yào miàn duì de wèn tí 。
en: Unmarried or married persons have problems to face in real life.

zh: 戴小姐的父母對婚禮相當重視，連喜帖都是他們親自設計的。
py: dài xiǎo jiě de fù mǔ duì hūn lǐ xiāng dāng zhòng shì ， lián xǐ tiě dōu shì tā men qīn zì shè jì de 。
en: Miss Tai's parents attached great importance to the wedding, and even the wedding was designed by them themselves.

zh: 開學典禮時校長所演講的內容又短又精彩，讓我印象很深。
py: kāi xué diǎn lǐ shí xiào zhǎng suǒ yǎn jiǎng de nèi róng yòu duǎn yòu jīng cǎi ， ràng wǒ yìn xiàng hěn shēn 。
en: I was impressed by the short and excellent speech given by the headmaster at the opening ceremony.

zh: 最近賣的新飲料很有特色，所以光臨我們店的客人越來越多。
py: zuì jìn mài de xīn yǐn liào hěn yǒu tè sè ， suǒ yǐ guāng lín wǒ men diàn de kè rén yuè lái yuè duō 。
en: The new drinks that have recently been sold are very special, so more and more customers come to our store.

zh: 要是你不能喝酒，跟客戶乾杯時可以用茶代替酒。
py: yào shì nǐ bù néng hē jiǔ ， gēn kè hù qián bēi shí kě yǐ yòng chá dài tì jiǔ 。
en: If you can't drink, you can drink with a client instead of tea.

zh: 他順利當上那家大飯店的廚師後，好多朋友都打電話祝賀他。
py: tā shùn lì dāng shàng nà jiā dà fàn diàn de chú shī hòu ， hǎo duō péng yǒu dōu dǎ diàn huà zhù hè tā 。
en: A lot of friends called to congratulate him when he became a chef at that big restaurant.

zh: 李媽媽把寶寶每天的生活都記錄下來，寫成一篇篇的日記。
py: lǐ mā mā bǎ bǎo bǎo měi tiān de shēng huó dōu jì lù xià lái ， xiě chéng yī piān piān de rì jì 。
en: Mama Lee wrote the baby's life every day into a diary.

zh: 夫妻之間要是缺少了愛情，日子就比較難過下去。
py: fū qī zhī jiān yào shì quē shǎo le ài qíng ， rì zi jiù bǐ jiào nán guò xià qù 。
en: A lack of love between husband and wife makes life more difficult.

zh: 這個背包在設計上沒什麼特色，只是印了某位明星隨手畫的圖，沒想到就要賣上萬元，實在有點兒誇張。
py: zhè gè bēi bāo zài shè jì shàng méi shén me tè sè ， zhǐ shì yìn le mǒu wèi míng xīng suí shǒu huà de tú ， méi xiǎng dào jiù yào mài shàng wàn yuán ， shí zài yǒu diǎn ér kuā zhāng 。
en: The backpack, which had no features in the design, was just a picture drawn by a certain star and had no idea that it would be sold for tens of thousands of dollars, which was a bit of an exaggeration.

zh: 這個角色一直找不到合適的演員，幸好那位明星點頭答應演出，否則影片就拍不成了。
py: zhè gè jué sè yì zhí zhǎo bú dào hé shì de yǎn yuán ， xìng hǎo nà wèi míng xīng diǎn tóu dá yīng yǎn chū ， fǒu zé yǐng piàn jiù pāi bù chéng le 。
en: The role has never found the right actor, and it's a good thing the star nods to the show, or the film won't work.

zh: 經過血液檢查，人們就可以知道自己的血型。
py: jīng guò xuè yè jiǎn chá ， rén men jiù kě yǐ zhī dào zì jǐ de xuè xíng 。
en: After a blood check, people know their blood type.

zh: 新型筆電銷售時價格通常比較貴，有時倒不如買符合個人需要的舊型筆電。
py: xīn xíng bǐ diàn xiāo shòu shí jià gé tōng cháng bǐ jiào guì ， yǒu shí dào bù rú mǎi fú hé gè rén xū yào de jiù xíng bǐ diàn 。
en: New types of pen sales are usually more expensive and sometimes less expensive than buying old ones that meet personal needs.

zh: 王伯伯為兒子辦喜事，擺了五十桌喜酒，熱鬧極了。
py: wáng bó bo wèi ér zi bàn xǐ shì ， bǎi le wǔ shí zhuō xǐ jiǔ ， rè nào jí le 。
en: Uncle Wang gave his son a wedding and set up 50 tables for the wedding.

zh: 這只箱子是以前奶奶留給我的，對我來說是很珍貴的禮物。
py: zhè zhǐ xiāng zi shì yǐ qián nǎi nǎi liú gěi wǒ de ， duì wǒ lái shuō shì hěn zhēn guì de lǐ wù 。
en: This case, which my grandmother left me, is a precious gift to me.

zh: 鑽石因為無法大量出產，所以才變得珍貴。
py: zuān shí yīn wèi wú fǎ dà liàng chū chǎn ， suǒ yǐ cái biàn dé zhēn guì 。
en: Diamonds are precious because they cannot be produced in large quantities.

zh: 那只鑽石戒指的設計極有特色，很適合當作婚戒(wedding ring)。
py: nà zhǐ zuān shí jiè zhǐ de shè jì jí yǒu tè sè ， hěn shì hé dāng zuò hūn jiè (wedding ring)。
en: The diamond ring was designed in such a special way that it could be considered a wedding ring.

zh: 他上班時常戴著一副黑色眼鏡，那副樣子總是讓我忘不了。
py: tā shàng bān shí cháng dài zhù yī fù hēi sè yǎn jìng ， nà fù yàng zi zǒng shì ràng wǒ wàng bù liǎo 。
en: He used to wear a black pair of glasses at work, which never made me forget.

zh: 你那一付筷子剛剛掉到地上弄髒了，我再幫你換一付新的。
py: nǐ nà yī fù kuài zi gāng gāng diào dào dì shàng nòng zāng le ， wǒ zài bāng nǐ huàn yī fù xīn de 。
en: Your chopstick just fell on the floor and got dirty. I'll get you a new one.

zh: 錢小姐戴的那副耳環就像星光一樣美麗，聽說那是祖母留給她的回憶。
py: qián xiǎo jiě dài de nà fù ěr huán jiù xiàng xīng guāng yī yàng měi lì ， tīng shuō nà shì zǔ mǔ liú gěi tā de huí yì 。
en: Miss Money's earrings are as beautiful as starlights, and they say they're memories of her grandmother.

zh: 老謝溫柔體貼、聰明英俊，符合我結婚對象的條件，因此我答應嫁給他。
py: lǎo xiè wēn róu tǐ tiē 、 cōng míng yīng jùn ， fú hé wǒ jié hūn duì xiàng de tiáo jiàn ， yīn cǐ wǒ dá yīng jià gěi tā 。
en: Old Xie was gentle, smart and handsome and fulfilled the terms of my marriage, so I promised to marry him.

zh: 按照中國的傳統觀念，女人未嫁時得聽父親的話，嫁了人之後就得聽丈夫的。
py: àn zhào zhōng guó de chuán tǒng guān niàn ， nǚ rén wèi jià shí dé tīng fù qīn de huà ， jià le rén zhī hòu jiù dé tīng zhàng fū de 。
en: According to Chinese tradition, a woman has to listen to her father when she is not married and to her husband when she is married.

zh: 她想嫁給有錢人家(rénjiā)是她自己的事，你幹嘛管人家(rénjia)的事？
py: tā xiǎng jià gěi yǒu qián rén jiā (rénjiā) shì tā zì jǐ de shì ， nǐ gàn ma guǎn rén jiā (rénjia) de shì ？
en: Why do you care if she wants to marry someone who's rich?

zh: 幸福的婚姻不僅需要觀念的溝通，更需要感情的交流。
py: xìng fú de hūn yīn bù jǐn xū yào guān niàn de gōu tōng ， gèng xū yào gǎn qíng de jiāo liú 。
en: A happy marriage requires more than just visual communication, and more emotional communication.

zh: 我喜歡陪家人到公園的草地上野餐，氣氛溫暖又歡喜。
py: wǒ xǐ huān péi jiā rén dào gōng yuán de cǎo dì shàng yě cān ， qì fēn wēn nuǎn yòu huān xǐ 。
en: I like to go with my family to the lawn picnics in the park, warm and cheerful.

zh: 我去臺灣朋友家吃飯時，他的家人不斷夾菜給我，讓我很不好意思。
py: wǒ qù tái wān péng yǒu jiā chī fàn shí ， tā de jiā rén bù duàn jiā cài gěi wǒ ， ràng wǒ hěn bù hǎo yì sī 。
en: When I went to a friend's house in Taiwan to eat, his family kept giving me the groceries, which made me feel bad.

zh: 這桌喜酒有很多海鮮，但我只能吃魚，其他種類的海鮮都會讓我皮膚紅腫(inflamed)。
py: zhè zhuō xǐ jiǔ yǒu hěn duō hǎi xiān ， dàn wǒ zhǐ néng chī yú ， qí tā zhǒng lèi de hǎi xiān dōu huì ràng wǒ pí fū hóng zhǒng (inflamed)。
en: There's plenty of seafood in this table, but I can only eat fish. Other kinds of seafood make my skin red.

zh: 我的白髮隨著年齡越來越多了，我想找一天去染頭髮。
py: wǒ de bái fà suí zhù nián líng yuè lái yuè duō le ， wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī tiān qù rǎn tóu fà 。
en: My gray hair gets older and older, and I want to dye my hair one day.

zh: 鵝一看到陌生人就會大叫，所以鄉村裡有人把鵝當成狗來看家(kānjiā， to guard the house)。
py: é yī kàn dào mò shēng rén jiù huì dà jiào ， suǒ yǐ xiāng cūn lǐ yǒu rén bǎ é dāng chéng gǒu lái kān jiā (kānjiā， to guard the house)。
en: When a goose sees a stranger, it screams, so some people in the country treat it as a dog (kānjiā, to guard the house).

zh: 開車去喝喜酒的人碰到敬酒時最好拒絕，免得回家路上發生意外。
py: kāi chē qù hē xǐ jiǔ de rén pèng dào jìng jiǔ shí zuì hǎo jù jué ， miǎn de huí jiā lù shàng fā shēng yì wài 。
en: Those who drive to drink are better advised to refuse their toasts before an accident occurs on their way home.

zh: 現代的口紅不僅使用方便，在顏色上也有不少變化。
py: xiàn dài de kǒu hóng bù jǐn shǐ yòng fāng biàn ， zài yán sè shàng yě yǒu bù shǎo biàn huà 。
en: Modern lipstick is not only easy to use, it has also changed in colours.

zh: 麵包如果不想烤得太乾，可以在烤前噴點兒水。
py: miàn bāo rú guǒ bù xiǎng kǎo dé tài qián ， kě yǐ zài kǎo qián pēn diǎn ér shuǐ 。
en: If you don't want to bake too dry, you can spray some water before.

zh: 每次到了新年，華人就會在門前放鞭炮，好好地熱鬧一番。
py: měi cì dào le xīn nián ， huá rén jiù huì zài mén qián fàng biān pào ， hǎo hǎo dì rè nào yī fān 。
en: Every time in New Year's, the Chinese put firecrackers in front of the door and have a good time.

zh: 我們公司的大型宴會活動，一向是宣傳部門負責處理的。
py: wǒ men gōng sī de dà xíng yàn huì huó dòng ， yí xiàng shì xuān chuán bù mén fù zé chù lǐ de 。
en: Our company's big party is always handled by the propaganda department.

zh: 一般來說，參加正式活動都得好好打扮，服裝也應該講究。
py: yì bān lái shuō ， cān jiā zhèng shì huó dòng dōu dé hǎo hǎo dǎ bàn ， fú zhuāng yě yīng gāi jiǎng jiū 。
en: In general, it is necessary to get dressed and dress properly.

zh: A:那所大學雖然相當著名，但我國政府不承認他們的學位(academic degree)。B:許多國家都承認那所大學的學位，貴國哪裡有不承認的道理？
py: A: nà suǒ dà xué suī rán xiāng dāng zhù míng ， dàn wǒ guó zhèng fǔ bù chéng rèn tā men de xué wèi (academic degree)。B: xǔ duō guó jiā dōu chéng rèn nà suǒ dà xué de xué wèi ， guì guó nǎ lǐ yǒu bù chéng rèn de dào lǐ ？
en: A: Although the university is well-known, our government does not recognize their degree (academic degree). B: Many countries recognize the university degree, and where does your country deny it?

zh: 想擁有一段百年好合的婚姻，除了真心的愛情之外，也應重視家庭的責任。
py: xiǎng yōng yǒu yī duàn bǎi nián hǎo hé de hūn yīn ， chú le zhēn xīn de ài qíng zhī wài ， yě yīng zhòng shì jiā tíng de zé rèn 。
en: In order to have a 100-year-old marriage, in addition to genuine love, the responsibility of the family should also be taken into account.

zh: 孩子：我玩電腦遊戲玩得正高興，你為什麼不讓我繼續玩？爸爸：得了！你玩到眼睛都紅了。去外面運動運動。
py: hái zi ： wǒ wán diàn nǎo yóu xì wán dé zhèng gāo xìng ， nǐ wèi shén me bù ràng wǒ jì xù wán ？ bà bà ： dé le ！ nǐ wán dào yǎn jīng dōu hóng le 。 qù wài miàn yùn dòng yùn dòng 。
en: Kid: I'm having a good time playing computer games. Why don't you let me keep playing? Dad: Come on, you've got red eyes. Go outside and exercise.

zh: A:江先生對父母很孝順，個性又溫柔，將來一定是好先生。B:這還用說嗎？要是妳對他有意思，就得早點兒行動喔！
py: A: jiāng xiān shēng duì fù mǔ hěn xiào shùn ， gè xìng yòu wēn róu ， jiāng lái yí dìng shì hǎo xiān shēng 。B: zhè hái yòng shuō ma ？ yào shì nǐ duì tā yǒu yì si ， jiù dé zǎo diǎn ér xíng dòng ō ！
en: A: Mr. Jiang is kind and gentle to his parents, and he must be a good man. B: Are you sure? If you're interested in him, you have to move early.

zh: 他贏了這次選舉只是運氣好罷了，其實他沒什麼能力。
py: tā yíng le zhè cì xuǎn jǔ zhǐ shì yùn qì hǎo bà le ， qí shí tā méi shén me néng lì 。
en: He won the election. He's just lucky, but he's not capable.

zh: 你想參加這項長跑比賽的話，可以到網站報名，登記之後會有人跟你聯絡。
py: nǐ xiǎng cān jiā zhè xiàng zhǎng pǎo bǐ sài de huà ， kě yǐ dào wǎng zhàn bào míng ， dēng jì zhī hòu huì yǒu rén gēn nǐ lián luò 。
en: If you want to take part in this long run, you can sign up for the website and someone will contact you when you register.

zh: 這次活動大家都化裝參加，要是你碰見我大概認不出我是誰。
py: zhè cì huó dòng dà jiā dōu huà zhuāng cān jiā ， yào shì nǐ pèng jiàn wǒ dà gài rèn bù chū wǒ shì shuí 。
en: I don't think I know who I am if you meet me.

zh: 如果有任何困難請別客氣，我很樂意幫你的忙。
py: rú guǒ yǒu rèn hé kùn nán qǐng bié kè qì ， wǒ hěn lè yì bāng nǐ de máng 。
en: If there's any trouble, don't mention it. I'd be happy to help you.

zh: 連經理很講話，開會時老是說個不停，別人都沒說話的分。
py: lián jīng lǐ hěn jiǎng huà ， kāi huì shí lǎo shì shuō gè bù tíng ， bié rén dōu méi shuō huà de fēn 。
en: Even the manager was very talkative, he was always talking and nobody was talking.

zh: 有人覺得留鬍子比較帥，我倒是覺得留了鬍子看起來比較老。
py: yǒu rén jué dé liú hú zi bǐ jiào shuài ， wǒ dǎo shì jué dé liú le hú zi kàn qǐ lái bǐ jiào lǎo 。
en: Some people think beards are nicer, but I think beards look older.

zh: 小周找到理想工作後，女友特地送了一條領帶當作禮物，還親手為他打領帶，祝賀他有個好的開始。
py: xiǎo zhōu zhǎo dào lǐ xiǎng gōng zuò hòu ， nǚ yǒu tè dì sòng le yī tiáo lǐng dài dāng zuò lǐ wù ， hái qīn shǒu wèi tā dǎ lǐng dài ， zhù hè tā yǒu gè hǎo de kāi shǐ 。
en: After Cho found the ideal job, her girlfriend gave him a tie as a gift and gave him a hand tie, congratulating him on a good start.

zh: 天氣這麼熱，你居然穿著一件大外套，不覺得不舒服嗎？
py: tiān qì zhè me rè ， nǐ jū rán chuān zhù yī jiàn dà wài tào ， bù jué dé bù shū fú ma ？
en: It's so hot, you're wearing a big coat. Don't you feel uncomfortable?

zh: 你別看她一臉害羞的樣子，在熟人面前她可是很開朗的。
py: nǐ bié kàn tā yī liǎn hài xiū de yàng zi ， zài shú rén miàn qián tā kě shì hěn kāi lǎng de 。
en: Don't look at her like she's shy. She's very open to acquaintances.

zh: 我的親戚是數學教授，每次我有這方面的問題就向他請教。
py: wǒ de qīn qī shì shù xué jiào shòu ， měi cì wǒ yǒu zhè fāng miàn de wèn tí jiù xiàng tā qǐng jiào 。
en: My relative is a math professor, and every time I have problems with that, I ask him.

zh: 有些女性懷孕時飲食習慣會有極大的改變，醫生說這是正常現象。
py: yǒu xiē nǚ xìng huái yùn shí yǐn shí xí guàn huì yǒu jí dà de gǎi biàn ， yī shēng shuō zhè shì zhèng cháng xiàn xiàng 。
en: Some women experience dramatic changes in their dietary habits during pregnancy, which according to doctors is a normal phenomenon.

zh: 人生短短幾十年，一輩子很快就過去了，因此應該活得精彩、過得有意義。
py: rén shēng duǎn duǎn jǐ shí nián ， yī bèi zi hěn kuài jiù guò qù le ， yīn cǐ yīng gāi huó dé jīng cǎi 、 guò dé yǒu yì yì 。
en: Life is only a few decades away, and life will soon pass, so it should be wonderful and meaningful.

zh: 看見別人事業很成功，除了羨慕以外，更要學習他的優點。
py: kàn jiàn bié rén shì yè hěn chéng gōng ， chú le xiàn mù yǐ wài ， gèng yào xué xí tā de yōu diǎn 。
en: Seeing someone else's career is a success, and in addition to envy, learning what he's good at.

zh: 在冬天的深夜裡，坐在溫暖的地毯上靜靜地看書是一種享受。
py: zài dōng tiān de shēn yè lǐ ， zuò zài wēn nuǎn de dì tǎn shàng jìng jìng dì kàn shū shì yī zhǒng xiǎng shòu 。
en: It is a pleasure to sit on a warm carpet in the middle of the winter to read in silence.

zh: 金小姐常利用假日，牽著家中那隻活潑的小黑狗到街上逛逛。
py: jīn xiǎo jiě cháng lì yòng jià rì ， qiān zhù jiā zhōng nà zhī huó pō de xiǎo hēi gǒu dào jiē shàng guàng guàng 。
en: Miss King used the holiday to take the live, black dog to the streets.

zh: 在公車上，看到年紀大的人應該讓位子請他們坐。
py: zài gōng chē shàng ， kàn dào nián jì dà de rén yīng gāi ràng wèi zi qǐng tā men zuò 。
en: On the bus, older people should be allowed to take their seats.

zh: 章小姐接觸電影表演工作不久，雖然還是新人，對表演技巧倒是掌握得挺好的。
py: zhāng xiǎo jiě jiē chù diàn yǐng biǎo yǎn gōng zuò bù jiǔ ， suī rán hái shì xīn rén ， duì biǎo yǎn jì qiǎo dǎo shì zhǎng wò dé tǐng hǎo de 。
en: Ms. Jang's work in the film show, although she's still new, is very good at performing skills.

zh: 故事中的女主角吻了白馬一下，白馬就變成了英俊的國王。
py: gù shì zhōng de nǚ zhǔ jué wěn le bái mǎ yī xià ， bái mǎ jiù biàn chéng le yīng jùn de guó wáng 。
en: The lead woman in the story kissed the white horse, and the white horse became a handsome king.

zh: 為了安全起見，颱風天到山區露營的行為是被嚴格禁止的。
py: wèi le ān quán qǐ jiàn ， tái fēng tiān dào shān qū lù yíng de xíng wèi shì bèi yán gé jìn zhǐ de 。
en: For the sake of safety, it is strictly prohibited to go camping in the mountains.

zh: 他想寫一本以各行各業人物當作題材的長篇小說。
py: tā xiǎng xiě yī běn yǐ gè xíng gè yè rén wù dāng zuò tí cái de zhǎng piān xiǎo shuō 。
en: He wants to write a long book on the topic of people from all walks of life.

zh: 我們公司因為業務需要，最近增加了不少人力。
py: wǒ men gōng sī yīn wèi yè wù xū yào ， zuì jìn zēng jiā le bù shǎo rén lì 。
en: Our company has recently increased its manpower due to business needs.

zh: 大多數投資專家都不敢保證在房屋市場一定能賺錢。
py: dà duō shù tóu zī zhuān jiā dōu bù gǎn bǎo zhèng zài fáng wū shì chǎng yí dìng néng zhuàn qián 。
en: Most investment experts are not sure they can make money in the housing market.

zh: 跟那位學者談話是種享受，能夠自由又自在地交換想法。
py: gēn nà wèi xué zhě tán huà shì zhǒng xiǎng shòu ， néng gòu zì yóu yòu zì zài dì jiāo huàn xiǎng fǎ 。
en: Talking to that scholar is a pleasure, a free exchange of ideas.

zh: 當你大學畢業，不再升學時，就得考慮就業問題了。
py: dāng nǐ dà xué bì yè ， bù zài shēng xué shí ， jiù dé kǎo lǜ jiù yè wèn tí le 。
en: When you graduate from college and you don't go to college, you have to think about going to work.

zh: 有能力的人就算不幸失業了，將來還是有許多機會等待著他。
py: yǒu néng lì de rén jiù suàn bù xìng shī yè le ， jiāng lái hái shì yǒu xǔ duō jī huì děng dài zhù tā 。
en: Even if the capable have unfortunately lost their jobs, there will be many opportunities to wait for him in the future.

zh: 這對夫婦打扮得相當講究，讓我對他們從事的行業很感興趣。
py: zhè duì fū fù dǎ bàn dé xiāng dāng jiǎng jiū ， ràng wǒ duì tā men cóng shì de xíng yè hěn gǎn xìng qù 。
en: It's quite a dress-up for the couple, and I'm interested in what they do.

zh: 天天說自己外行、不願嘗試的人，就無法更深入地瞭解世界。
py: tiān tiān shuō zì jǐ wài háng 、 bù yuàn cháng shì de rén ， jiù wú fǎ gēng shēn rù dì liǎo jiě shì jiè 。
en: Those who say they are amateurs and do not want to try will not be able to understand the world in greater depth.

zh: 公司不斷推銷新型電子產品，通常是為了刺激客戶購買。
py: gōng sī bù duàn tuī xiāo xīn xíng diàn zi chǎn pǐn ， tōng cháng shì wèi le cì jī kè hù gòu mǎi 。
en: Companies are constantly selling new electronic products, often to stimulate customers to buy them.

zh: 各行各業都有屬於自己的專業，無法比較誰高誰低。
py: gè xíng gè yè dōu yǒu shǔ yú zì jǐ de zhuān yè ， wú fǎ bǐ jiào shuí gāo shuí dī 。
en: Every industry has its own expertise, and it's impossible to compare it to the higher and the lower.

zh: 個性親切、大方，通常是從事服務業的最佳人才。
py: gè xìng qīn qiè 、 dà fāng ， tōng cháng shì cóng shì fú wù yè de zuì jiā rén cái 。
en: Personality and generosity are often the best people in the service industry.

zh: 那家報社非常細心，他們的文章從沒出現過一個錯字。
py: nà jiā bào shè fēi cháng xì xīn ， tā men de wén zhāng cóng méi chū xiàn guò yī gè cuò zì 。
en: The newspaper was very careful and their article never had a single wrong word.

zh: 公司如果關心客戶並達成他們的需求，對業務或多或少有好處。
py: gōng sī rú guǒ guān xīn kè hù bìng dá chéng tā men de xū qiú ， duì yè wù huò duō huò shǎo yǒu hǎo chù 。
en: Companies can do more or less good to their businesses if they care about their clients and meet their needs.

zh: 手機廠商時常邀請明星替他們的產品宣傳。
py: shǒu jī chǎng shāng shí cháng yāo qǐng míng xīng tì tā men de chǎn pǐn xuān chuán 。
en: The mobile phone manufacturers often invite stars to promote their products.

zh: 擁有一架小飛機並親自在天空上駕駛，一直是孫小姐的夢想。
py: yōng yǒu yī jià xiǎo fēi jī bìng qīn zì zài tiān kōng shàng jià shǐ ， yì zhí shì sūn xiǎo jiě de mèng xiǎng 。
en: It's always been Miss Sun's dream to own a small plane and fly it in the sky.

zh: 我們特地到當地的滑雪用品工廠參觀，並進行技術交流。
py: wǒ men tè dì dào dāng dì de huá xuě yòng pǐn gōng chǎng cān guān ， bìng jìn xíng jì shù jiāo liú 。
en: We went to the local skiing factory and had a technical exchange.

zh: 我習慣把每一筆支出都記錄起來，提醒自己少花點兒錢。
py: wǒ xí guàn bǎ měi yī bǐ zhī chū dōu jì lù qǐ lái ， tí xǐng zì jǐ shǎo huā diǎn ér qián 。
en: I'm used to recording every expense, reminding myself to spend less.

zh: 你的才能符合我們公司的條件，是我們需要的人才。
py: nǐ de cái néng fú hé wǒ men gōng sī de tiáo jiàn ， shì wǒ men xū yào de rén cái 。
en: Your talent fits the requirements of our company. It's the talent we need.

zh: 水和冰基本上是相同的，只是因溫度而產生不同的變化。
py: shuǐ hé bīng jī běn shàng shì xiāng tóng de ， zhǐ shì yīn wēn dù ér chǎn shēng bù tóng de biàn huà 。
en: Water and ice are essentially the same, but vary according to temperature.

zh: 對人民來說，最大的不幸就是國家機構腐敗。
py: duì rén mín lái shuō ， zuì dà de bù xìng jiù shì guó jiā jī gòu fǔ bài 。
en: For the people, the greatest misfortune is the corruption of State institutions.

zh: 企業為了錄用合適的人才，而採用各式各樣的方式。
py: qǐ yè wèi le lù yòng hé shì de rén cái ， ér cǎi yòng gè shì gè yàng de fāng shì 。
en: Businesses use a variety of ways to recruit the right talent.

zh: 在機構、組織擔任的職位越高，代表個人所負擔的責任越重。
py: zài jī gòu 、 zǔ zhī dān rèn de zhí wèi yuè gāo ， dài biǎo gè rén suǒ fù dān de zé rèn yuè zhòng 。
en: The higher the number of posts in institutions and organizations, the greater the responsibility of the individual on behalf of the individual.

zh: 就算擁有高收入，也不見得能讓你過著幸福美好的生活。
py: jiù suàn yōng yǒu gāo shōu rù ， yě bù jiàn dé néng ràng nǐ guò zhù xìng fú měi hǎo de shēng huó 。
en: Even if you have a high income, you will not be able to live happily ever after.

zh: 開車時不闖紅燈，是為了自己和別人的生命安全。
py: kāi chē shí bù chuǎng hóng dēng ， shì wèi le zì jǐ hé bié rén de shēng mìng ān quán 。
en: It's for the safety of yourself and other people's lives that they don't run through red lights.

zh: 中國的古書雖然難懂，慢慢讀的話，我倒是多少能理解一些。
py: zhōng guó de gǔ shū suī rán nán dǒng ， màn màn dú de huà ， wǒ dǎo shì duō shǎo néng lǐ jiě yī xiē 。
en: China's ancient books, though hard to understand, I'd rather understand them slowly.

zh: 購買任何商品時都應考慮功能以及價格。
py: gòu mǎi rèn hé shāng pǐn shí dōu yīng kǎo lǜ gōng néng yǐ jí jià gé 。
en: When buying any commodity, the function and price should be taken into account.

zh: 一項計畫假如目標不明確，往往就得不到想要的結果。
py: yī xiàng jì huà jiǎ rú mù biāo bù míng què ， wǎng wǎng jiù dé bú dào xiǎng yào de jié guǒ 。
en: If a project is not well targeted, it often does not get what it wants.

zh: 想當節目主持人，具有好口才是最基本的條件。
py: xiǎng dāng jié mù zhǔ chí rén ， jù yǒu hǎo kǒu cái shì zuì jī běn de tiáo jiàn 。
en: If you want to be a show host, having a good mouth is the most basic condition.

zh: 接待客戶是有技巧的，弄不好可能會丟了生意。
py: jiē dài kè hù shì yǒu jì qiǎo de ， nòng bù hǎo kě néng huì diū le shēng yì 。
en: Clients are skilled and they may lose their business.

zh: 有些學校將教育當成商品來買賣，但也有人不支持。
py: yǒu xiē xué xiào jiāng jiào yù dāng chéng shāng pǐn lái mǎi mài ， dàn yě yǒu rén bù zhī chí 。
en: Some schools use education as a commodity for sale, but others do not support it.

zh: 在法律及法院之前，每個人都是平等的。
py: zài fǎ lǜ jí fǎ yuàn zhī qián ， měi gè rén dōu shì píng děng de 。
en: Everyone is equal before the law and the courts.

zh: 辦公時他常在桌上擺一杯熱咖啡，說是咖啡香能讓精神更好。
py: bàn gōng shí tā cháng zài zhuō shàng bǎi yī bēi rè kā fēi ， shuō shì kā fēi xiāng néng ràng jīng shén gèng hǎo 。
en: He used to make a hot cup of coffee on the table when he was on business, saying that coffee smells better.

zh: 動不動就發脾氣的人，往往無法接受別人的寶貴建議。
py: dòng bù dòng jiù fā pí qì de rén ， wǎng wǎng wú fǎ jiē shòu bié rén de bǎo guì jiàn yì 。
en: People who lose their temper are often unable to accept the valuable advice of others.

zh: 他對志工服務一向有興趣，哪怕做得又忙又累，他也願意。
py: tā duì zhì gōng fú wù yí xiàng yǒu xìng qù ， nǎ pà zuò dé yòu máng yòu lèi ， tā yě yuàn yì 。
en: He's always interested in volunteer services, even if he's busy and tired.

zh: 對企業來說，一個人的工作能力往往比學歷更加重要。
py: duì qǐ yè lái shuō ， yī gè rén de gōng zuò néng lì wǎng wǎng bǐ xué lì gèng jiā zhòng yào 。
en: For businesses, a person ' s ability to work is often more important than a degree.

zh: 說實話，文憑不是最重要的，重要的是個人的知識與才能。
py: shuō shí huà ， wén píng bú shì zuì zhòng yào de ， zhòng yào de shì gè rén de zhī shí yǔ cái néng 。
en: To be honest, documentation is not the most important, it is personal knowledge and talent.

zh: 有些事情光是勤勞沒有用，得用對方法才行。
py: yǒu xiē shì qíng guāng shì qín láo méi yǒu yòng ， dé yòng duì fāng fǎ cái xíng 。
en: Some things just don't work. We have to do the right thing.

zh: 這部電腦的鍵盤有幾個鍵壞了，我得找人修理它。
py: zhè bù diàn nǎo de jiàn pán yǒu jǐ gè jiàn huài le ， wǒ dé zhǎo rén xiū lǐ tā 。
en: There's a few keys to this computer. I've got to get somebody to fix it.

zh: 等一會兒開會時麻煩你負責打字，把開會的內容記錄下來。
py: děng yī huì ér kāi huì shí má fán nǐ fù zé dǎ zì ， bǎ kāi huì de nèi róng jì lù xià lái 。
en: Please type in the meeting later to record the content of the meeting.

zh: 學校安排我們到鄉下當「一日農民」，體驗農夫的辛苦。
py: xué xiào ān pái wǒ men dào xiāng xià dāng 「 yī rì nóng mín 」， tǐ yàn nóng fū de xīn kǔ 。
en: The school arranges for us to go to the country as "farmers of one day" and to experience the difficulties of farmers.

zh: 這位郵差的聲音很大，每次他來送信，整條街全都聽見了。
py: zhè wèi yóu chà de shēng yīn hěn dà ， měi cì tā lái sòng xìn ， zhěng tiáo jiē quán dōu tīng jiàn le 。
en: The postman was loud. Every time he came to deliver the letter, he heard it all over the street.

zh: 紀念郵票一般都是以歷史上的大事或重要人物當作主題。
py: jì niàn yóu piào yì bān dōu shì yǐ lì shǐ shàng de dà shì huò zhòng yào rén wù dāng zuò zhǔ tí 。
en: Monument stamps are usually the subject of historical events or important personalities.

zh: 工會代表跟老闆討論工資問題，認為公司給的工錢仍然太低。
py: gōng huì dài biǎo gēn lǎo bǎn tǎo lùn gōng zī wèn tí ， rèn wèi gōng sī gěi de gōng qián réng rán tài dī 。
en: The union representatives discussed the issue of wages with their employers, arguing that the company still pays too little.

zh: 自動化工廠不僅使生產速度更快，同時也能保證產品品質。
py: zì dòng huà gōng chǎng bù jǐn shǐ shēng chǎn sù dù gèng kuài ， tóng shí yě néng bǎo zhèng chǎn pǐn pǐn zhì 。
en: Automatic chemical plants not only make production faster, they also guarantee the quality of the product.

zh: 有朋友與家人的鼓勵，使他在面對任何困難時都十分自信。
py: yǒu péng yǒu yǔ jiā rén de gǔ lì ， shǐ tā zài miàn duì rèn hé kùn nán shí dōu shí fēn zì xìn 。
en: The encouragement of a friend and family gave him confidence in any difficulty he faced.

zh: 遇人少比較，遇事放得下，日子就能過得更輕鬆自在。
py: yù rén shǎo bǐ jiào ， yù shì fàng dé xià ， rì zi jiù néng guò dé gèng qīng sōng zì zài 。
en: It's less common to meet people, and it's easier to live with.

zh: 到機場時看見一群戲迷正追著電影明星照相，真有意思。
py: dào jī chǎng shí kàn jiàn yī qún xì mí zhèng zhuī zhù diàn yǐng míng xīng zhào xiàng ， zhēn yǒu yì si 。
en: It's interesting to see a bunch of fans at the airport after a movie star.

zh: 他的計畫使公司賠了一大筆錢，因此他以辭職表示負責。
py: tā de jì huà shǐ gōng sī péi le yī dà bǐ qián ， yīn cǐ tā yǐ cí zhí biǎo shì fù zé 。
en: His plan cost the company a lot of money and he was therefore responsible for his resignation.

zh: 這次畢業典禮，學校打算採用空拍的方式來拍紀念影片。
py: zhè cì bì yè diǎn lǐ ， xué xiào dǎ suàn cǎi yòng kōng pāi de fāng shì lái pāi jì niàn yǐng piàn 。
en: In this graduation ceremony, the school intends to make a commemorative film by air.

zh: 他對亞洲文化相當有興趣，計畫將來走遍全亞洲。
py: tā duì yà zhōu wén huà xiāng dāng yǒu xìng qù ， jì huà jiāng lái zǒu biàn quán yà zhōu 。
en: He is very interested in Asian culture and is planning to travel all over Asia.

zh: 想導演一部以蟲子當作主角的電影，真不是件容易的事。
py: xiǎng dǎo yǎn yī bù yǐ chóng zi dāng zuò zhǔ jué de diàn yǐng ， zhēn bú shì jiàn róng yì de shì 。
en: It's not easy to lead a movie with bugs.

zh: 就算沒有很高的學位，只要用心一樣能對國家社會有貢獻。
py: jiù suàn méi yǒu hěn gāo de xué wèi ， zhǐ yào yòng xīn yī yàng néng duì guó jiā shè huì yǒu gòng xiàn 。
en: Even without a high degree, you can contribute as much as you want to to the national society.

zh: 他用很珍貴的茶具來泡品質很普通的茶葉，真浪費。
py: tā yòng hěn zhēn guì de chá jù lái pào pǐn zhì hěn pǔ tōng de chá yè ， zhēn làng fèi 。
en: He used precious teaware to make tea of normal quality. It was a waste.

zh: 都市人口如果過度成長，容易引發環保及交通問題。
py: dū shì rén kǒu rú guǒ guò dù chéng zhǎng ， róng yì yǐn fā huán bǎo jí jiāo tōng wèn tí 。
en: Urban populations, if they grow too much, are prone to environmental and transport problems.

zh: 從我辦公室隔著玻璃往外看，可以看見開滿鮮花的花園。
py: cóng wǒ bàn gōng shì gé zhù bō lí wǎng wài kàn ， kě yǐ kàn jiàn kāi mǎn xiān huā de huā yuán 。
en: Looking out through the glass from my office, you can see a garden full of flowers.

zh: 為了發展工業而不斷開發，這樣下去森林早晚會被破壞光的。
py: wèi le fā zhǎn gōng yè ér bù duàn kāi fā ， zhè yàng xià qù sēn lín zǎo wǎn huì bèi pò huài guāng de 。
en: In order to develop the industry, the forest will be destroyed sooner or later.

zh: 用人類的角度去看大自然， 就看不出大自然的本來價值。
py: yòng rén lèi de jiǎo dù qù kàn dà zì rán ，  jiù kàn bù chū dà zì rán de běn lái jià zhí 。
en: When you look at nature from a human perspective, you don't see the value of nature.

zh: 這種化妝品是針對東方人的皮膚設計的，在臺灣賣得很好。
py: zhè zhǒng huà zhuāng pǐn shì zhēn duì dōng fāng rén de pí fū shè jì de ， zài tái wān mài dé hěn hǎo 。
en: This make-up is designed for the skin of the Easters and is well sold in Taiwan.

zh: 我與高中同學已十多年沒見了，想找個適當時間邀請大家聚聚。
py: wǒ yǔ gāo zhōng tóng xué yǐ shí duō nián méi jiàn le ， xiǎng zhǎo gè shì dāng shí jiān yāo qǐng dà jiā jù jù 。
en: I haven't seen you in high school for over a decade, and I'm looking for an appropriate time to invite you all.

zh: 他利用石頭、木頭在山上建了一間美麗的小屋。
py: tā lì yòng shí tóu 、 mù tóu zài shān shàng jiàn le yī jiān měi lì de xiǎo wū 。
en: He built a beautiful cabin on the hill using stones and wood.

zh: 從事電視新聞工作的人有義務傳播正確的消息。
py: cóng shì diàn shì xīn wén gōng zuò de rén yǒu yì wù chuán bō zhèng què de xiāo xī 。
en: Those working on TV news have an obligation to spread the right message.

zh: 對他來說，這趟旅行的唯一目的僅是為了尋找畫畫的題材。
py: duì tā lái shuō ， zhè tàng lǚ xíng de wéi yī mù dì jǐn shì wèi le xún zhǎo huà huà de tí cái 。
en: For him, the only purpose of the trip was to look for drawings.

zh: 這對情侶找了幾位朋友商量，一起安排結婚典禮。
py: zhè duì qíng lǚ zhǎo le jǐ wèi péng yǒu shāng liáng ， yì qǐ ān pái jié hūn diǎn lǐ 。
en: The couple talked to a couple of friends to arrange a wedding ceremony.

zh: 當你願意開放自己的心時， 你所見的世界也會更加地美妙。
py: dāng nǐ yuàn yì kāi fàng zì jǐ de xīn shí ，  nǐ suǒ jiàn de shì jiè yě huì gèng jiā dì měi miào 。
en: When you open your heart, the world you see will be even better.

zh: 他想成為網路作家，不過擔心將來的收入可能不穩定。
py: tā xiǎng chéng wèi wǎng lù zuò jiā ， bù guò dān xīn jiāng lái de shōu rù kě néng bù wěn dìng 。
en: He wanted to be an Internet writer, but he was worried that future revenues might not be stable.

zh: 人的性格主要是受成長環境的影響，跟性別沒有太大的關係。
py: rén de xìng gé zhǔ yào shì shòu chéng zhǎng huán jìng de yǐng xiǎng ， gēn xìng bié méi yǒu tài dà de guān xì 。
en: The human personality is largely influenced by the conditions of growth and has nothing to do with gender.

zh: 他放下工作回家鄉的理由，是因為家裡的農場無人照顧。
py: tā fàng xià gōng zuò huí jiā xiāng de lǐ yóu ， shì yīn wèi jiā lǐ de nóng chǎng wú rén zhào gù 。
en: The reason why he left his job home was because the farm was unattended.

zh: 每個人都有不小心發生錯誤的時候，不需要取笑別人。
py: měi gè rén dōu yǒu bù xiǎo xīn fā shēng cuò wù de shí hòu ， bù xū yào qǔ xiào bié rén 。
en: Everyone has to make fun of people when they accidentally make mistakes.

zh: 小孩都希望擁有一臺能幫他寫功課的機器人。
py: xiǎo hái dōu xī wàng yōng yǒu yī tái néng bāng tā xiě gōng kè de jī qì rén 。
en: The kids want to have a robot who can help them with their homework.

zh: 這家工廠使用的大型機械全都是淺綠色的，看起來很有特色。
py: zhè jiā gōng chǎng shǐ yòng de dà xíng jī xiè quán dōu shì qiǎn lǜ sè de ， kàn qǐ lái hěn yǒu tè sè 。
en: The large machines used in this factory are all light green and look special.

zh: 那家博物館平日展覽的物品很多，中多半與古代科技有關。
py: nà jiā bó wù guǎn píng rì zhǎn lǎn de wù pǐn hěn duō ， zhōng duō bàn yǔ gǔ dài kē jì yǒu guān 。
en: The museum shows a lot of things on a day-to-day basis, most of which are related to ancient technology.

zh: 他因為生活條件的限制，而放棄了出國留學的機會。
py: tā yīn wèi shēng huó tiáo jiàn de xiàn zhì ， ér fàng qì le chū guó liú xué de jī huì 。
en: He gave up the opportunity to study abroad because of the limitations of his living conditions.

zh: 他對人很不客氣，因此大家都懶得理他。
py: tā duì rén hěn bù kè qì ， yīn cǐ dà jiā dōu lǎn dé lǐ tā 。
en: He's very nice to people, so everybody's not listening to him.

zh: 小張出車禍雖然賠了很多錢，不過好在人沒事。
py: xiǎo zhāng chū chē huò suī rán péi le hěn duō qián ， bù guò hǎo zài rén méi shì 。
en: Little Zhang's car accident cost a lot of money, but it's good that people are okay.

zh: 對顧客來說，品牌代表了對公司服務的印象以及商品的品質。
py: duì gù kè lái shuō ， pǐn pái dài biǎo le duì gōng sī fú wù de yìn xiàng yǐ jí shāng pǐn de pǐn zhì 。
en: For customers, brands represent an impression of corporate services and the quality of goods.

zh: 李伯伯對做家事有很多妙主意，因此附近的鄰居常向他請教。
py: lǐ bó bo duì zuò jiā shì yǒu hěn duō miào zhǔ yì ， yīn cǐ fù jìn de lín jū cháng xiàng tā qǐng jiào 。
en: Uncle Li has a lot of good ideas about family work, so the neighbors around him often ask him for advice.

zh: 她在電子工廠上班，難怪拆機器的技術非常熟練。
py: tā zài diàn zi gōng chǎng shàng bān ， nán guài chāi jī qì de jì shù fēi cháng shú liàn 。
en: She works at the electronics factory, so it's no wonder the machine's very sophisticated.

zh: 你去書房把地板拖乾淨，好放我新買的地毯。
py: nǐ qù shū fáng bǎ dì bǎn tuō qián jìng ， hǎo fàng wǒ xīn mǎi de dì tǎn 。
en: You go to the library and mop up the floor so I can get my new carpet.

zh: 很多人購物不在乎商品的品牌，只要耐用就好。
py: hěn duō rén gòu wù bù zài hū shāng pǐn de pǐn pái ， zhǐ yào nài yòng jiù hǎo 。
en: A lot of people don't care about the brand of goods, just to be durable.

zh: 小王剛買了一臺電腦，有些功能還不太會操作。
py: xiǎo wáng gāng mǎi le yī tái diàn nǎo ， yǒu xiē gōng néng hái bù tài huì cāo zuò 。
en: Wang just bought a computer, some of which is not very functional.

zh: 我新學的舞蹈很複雜，常忘了什麼時候前進或後退。
py: wǒ xīn xué de wǔ dǎo hěn fù zá ， cháng wàng le shén me shí hòu qián jìn huò hòu tuì 。
en: My new dances are complicated, and I often forget when to move in or back.

zh: 這兩臺機器樣子相同，但在構造與功能上是有差別的。
py: zhè liǎng tái jī qì yàng zi xiāng tóng ， dàn zài gòu zào yǔ gōng néng shàng shì yǒu chà bié de 。
en: These two machines look the same, but there is a difference in structure and function.

zh: 她在嬰兒車上安裝了一排不同顏色的小燈，看起來很特別。
py: tā zài yīng ér chē shàng ān zhuāng le yī pái bù tóng yán sè de xiǎo dēng ， kàn qǐ lái hěn tè bié 。
en: She installed a row of small lights of different colours on the baby car, which looked special.

zh: 這輛車雖然是從美國進口，但零件卻是在越南生產的。
py: zhè liàng chē suī rán shì cóng měi guó jìn kǒu ， dàn líng jiàn què shì zài yuè nán shēng chǎn de 。
en: The car was imported from the United States, but the parts were produced in Viet Nam.

zh: 別看張老闆平日吃的、用的都很省，其實他是某家大型電子企業的老闆。
py: bié kàn zhāng lǎo bǎn píng rì chī de 、 yòng de dōu hěn shěng ， qí shí tā shì mǒu jiā dà xíng diàn zi qǐ yè de lǎo bǎn 。
en: Don't look at Mr. Zhang's daily food. He's the owner of one of the big electronics companies.

zh: 今天王醫師門診，沒有護理師協助，什麼事都得自己動手。
py: jīn tiān wáng yī shī mén zhěn ， méi yǒu hù lǐ shī xié zhù ， shén me shì dōu dé zì jǐ dòng shǒu 。
en: Dr. Wang's clinic today, without the help of a nurse, has to do everything himself.

zh: 她最近失眠了，連吃了三天的藥也沒改善。
py: tā zuì jìn shī mián le ， lián chī le sān tiān de yào yě méi gǎi shàn 。
en: She's been insomnia lately, and she hasn't improved since she took three days of medication.

zh: 要是病人頭很暈又有發燒症狀時，就必須立刻送醫院檢查。
py: yào shì bìng rén tóu hěn yūn yòu yǒu fā shāo zhèng zhuàng shí ， jiù bì xū lì kè sòng yī yuàn jiǎn chá 。
en: If the patient is dizzy and has a fever, he must be taken to the hospital for immediate examination.

zh: 運動後吃根香蕉可以補充體力。
py: yùn dòng hòu chī gēn xiāng jiāo kě yǐ bǔ chōng tǐ lì 。
en: After the exercise, eating a banana can fill up the strength.

zh: 表情豐富、能模仿不同人物，是演員應有的基本條件。
py: biǎo qíng fēng fù 、 néng mó fǎng bù tóng rén wù ， shì yǎn yuán yīng yǒu de jī běn tiáo jiàn 。
en: It's a basic condition for actors to have a rich expression that mimics different characters.

zh: 別看超人那麼受歡迎就羨慕他，其實能力越強，身上的責任也越重。
py: bié kàn chāo rén nà me shòu huān yíng jiù xiàn mù tā ， qí shí néng lì yuè qiáng ， shēn shàng de zé rèn yě yuè zhòng 。
en: Don't envy Superman for being so popular, but the more capable he is, the more responsible he is.

zh: 環保署規定禁止使用塑膠袋後，使用購物袋的人就漸漸增加了。
py: huán bǎo shǔ guī dìng jìn zhǐ shǐ yòng sù jiāo dài hòu ， shǐ yòng gòu wù dài de rén jiù jiàn jiàn zēng jiā le 。
en: The use of plastic bags is increasing as a result of EPA regulations prohibiting the use of plastic bags.

zh: 接觸陌生的事情及環境時，往往令人有點兒不安，這樣的感覺是很自然的。
py: jiē chù mò shēng de shì qíng jí huán jìng shí ， wǎng wǎng lìng rén yǒu diǎn ér bù ān ， zhè yàng de gǎn jué shì hěn zì rán de 。
en: It is natural to feel a bit uneasy when it comes to strange things and circumstances.

zh: 千萬別帶著笨重的行李去旅行，那會給你帶來很多麻煩。
py: qiān wàn bié dài zhù bèn zhòng de xíng lǐ qù lǚ xíng ， nà huì gěi nǐ dài lái hěn duō má fán 。
en: Don't go on a trip with your stupid luggage. It'll be a lot of trouble for you.

zh: 根據氣象資料，這個颱風未來兩天會往西移動，週五起對台灣產生影響。
py: gēn jù qì xiàng zī liào ， zhè gè tái fēng wèi lái liǎng tiān huì wǎng xī yí dòng ， zhōu wǔ qǐ duì tái wān chǎn shēng yǐng xiǎng 。
en: According to the weather, the hurricane will move west in the next two days, affecting Taiwan from Friday.

zh: 我想在床旁邊擺個書桌，不過空間不太夠，你可以幫我把床移到牆邊嗎？
py: wǒ xiǎng zài chuáng páng biān bǎi gè shū zhuō ， bù guò kōng jiān bù tài gòu ， nǐ kě yǐ bāng wǒ bǎ chuáng yí dào qiáng biān ma ？
en: I'd like to put a desk next to the bed, but there's not enough room. Can you help me move the bed to the wall?

zh: 那家公司的鍵盤常出問題，我再傻也不會跟他們購買。
py: nà jiā gōng sī de jiàn pán cháng chū wèn tí ， wǒ zài shǎ yě bù huì gēn tā men gòu mǎi 。
en: The company's keyboards are always wrong, and I'm not stupid enough to buy them.

zh: 今天搭捷運參加演唱會的民眾很多，車上擠得都不能轉身。
py: jīn tiān dā jié yùn cān jiā yǎn chàng huì de mín zhòng hěn duō ， chē shàng jǐ dé dōu bù néng zhuǎn shēn 。
en: There's a lot of people riding to the concert today and it's too crowded to turn around.

zh: 祕書趁老闆不在把商品計畫偷走，這事已經交給法院處理了。
py: mì shū chèn lǎo bǎn bù zài bǎ shāng pǐn jì huà tōu zǒu ， zhè shì yǐ jīng jiāo gěi fǎ yuàn chù lǐ le 。
en: The book has been referred to the court while the owner is not stealing the merchandise project.

zh: 經過這次手術，得了重病的嬰兒終於順利地保住了生命。
py: jīng guò zhè cì shǒu shù ， dé le zhòng bìng de yīng ér zhōng yú shùn lì dì bǎo zhù le shēng mìng 。
en: After this operation, the seriously ill baby finally managed to save his life.

zh: 如果不與別人競爭，你就無法進步。
py: rú guǒ bù yǔ bié rén jìng zhēng ， nǐ jiù wú fǎ jìn bù 。
en: If you don't compete with others, you won't be able to make progress.

zh: 臺灣企業到發展中國家設立工廠，是因為當地的人工便宜。
py: tái wān qǐ yè dào fā zhǎn zhōng guó jiā shè lì gōng chǎng ， shì yīn wèi dāng dì de rén gōng pián yi 。
en: Taiwan Enterprises set up factories in developing countries because of the cheap labour in the area.

zh: 這本小說的內容重複性太高，一點新鮮感都沒有。
py: zhè běn xiǎo shuō de nèi róng zhòng fù xìng tài gāo ， yī diǎn xīn xiān gǎn dōu méi yǒu 。
en: This novel is too repetitive to be new.

zh: 這個字不好念，我重複了好幾次，同學都說不對，害我好想放棄。
py: zhè gè zì bù hǎo niàn ， wǒ zhòng fù le hǎo jǐ cì ， tóng xué dōu shuō bù duì ， hài wǒ hǎo xiǎng fàng qì 。
en: It's hard to read. I've repeated it a number of times, and my classmates are wrong, and I wanted to give it up.

zh: 人們為了節省勞力，發明了許多實用的機械。
py: rén men wèi le jié shěng láo lì ， fā míng liǎo xǔ duō shí yòng de jī xiè 。
en: In order to save a lot of effort, a lot of practical machinery has been invented.

zh: 這項化學實驗在過程中出了問題，我分析了很久才找出原因。
py: zhè xiàng huà xué shí yàn zài guò chéng zhōng chū le wèn tí ， wǒ fēn xī le hěn jiǔ cái zhǎo chū yuán yīn 。
en: The chemical experiment had a problem with the process, and I analysed it for a long time to find out why.

zh: 我討厭搬家，因為大型的家具不好搬運。
py: wǒ tǎo yàn bān jiā ， yīn wèi dà xíng de jiā jù bù hǎo bān yùn 。
en: I hate moving because big furniture isn't working.

zh: 她沒有針對此事發表看法，所以不知道她贊不贊成。
py: tā méi yǒu zhēn duì cǐ shì fā biǎo kàn fǎ ， suǒ yǐ bù zhī dào tā zàn bù zàn chéng 。
en: She did not comment on the matter, so she did not know whether she agreed with it or not.

zh: 隨著科技進步，醫學也不斷前進，當醫師的人得多充實自己。
py: suí zhù kē jì jìn bù ， yī xué yě bù duàn qián jìn ， dāng yī shī de rén dé duō chōng shí zì jǐ 。
en: As technology advances, medicine continues to progress, and people who are doctors are more comfortable with themselves.

zh: 對學生來說，經常失眠可能降低學習效率。
py: duì xué shēng lái shuō ， jīng cháng shī mián kě néng jiàng dī xué xí xiào lǜ 。
en: For students, frequent insomnia may reduce learning efficiency.

zh: 這家造船公司製造的船因成本高，價錢稍微貴了一點兒。
py: zhè jiā zào chuán gōng sī zhì zào de chuán yīn chéng běn gāo ， jià qián shāo wēi guì le yī diǎn ér 。
en: The ship made by this shipbuilding company is a little more expensive because of its high cost.

zh: 一般來說，手工做的麵包比機器做的好吃。
py: yì bān lái shuō ， shǒu gōng zuò de miàn bāo bǐ jī qì zuò de hǎo chī 。
en: In general, handmade bread is better than a machine.

zh: A:你要不要跟我一起去茶館喝杯茶？ B:與其去喝茶，我倒想去外面走走，看看花草樹木。
py: A: nǐ yào bù yào gēn wǒ yì qǐ qù chá guǎn hē bēi chá ？ B: yǔ qí qù hē chá ， wǒ dào xiǎng qù wài miàn zǒu zǒu ， kàn kàn huā cǎo shù mù 。
en: A: Would you like to come with me to the teahouse for a cup of tea?

zh: 你在外面花錢吃不健康的食物，還不如自己在家煮。
py: nǐ zài wài miàn huā qián chī bù jiàn kāng de shí wù ， hái bù rú zì jǐ zài jiā zhǔ 。
en: You spend money out there eating unhealthy food and you're better off cooking at home.

zh: 她最近臉色都不好，我們是否該關心她一下？
py: tā zuì jìn liǎn sè dōu bù hǎo ， wǒ men shì fǒu gāi guān xīn tā yī xià ？
en: She's not looking well these days. Should we care about her?

zh: 在歷史上，每次革命都對社會造成非常大的影響。
py: zài lì shǐ shàng ， měi cì gé mìng dōu duì shè huì zào chéng fēi cháng dà de yǐng xiǎng 。
en: Historically, every revolution has had a very significant impact on society.

zh: 無論發生什麼事，她都會跟父母商量，並參考他們的意見。
py: wú lùn fā shēng shén me shì ， tā dōu huì gēn fù mǔ shāng liáng ， bìng cān kǎo tā men de yì jiàn 。
en: Whatever happens, she consults her parents and consults them.

zh: 跑步比賽的起點跟終點之間都有人協助，避免參加比賽的人發生狀況。
py: pǎo bù bǐ sài de qǐ diǎn gēn zhōng diǎn zhī jiān dōu yǒu rén xié zhù ， bì miǎn cān jiā bǐ sài de rén fā shēng zhuàng kuàng 。
en: There is support between the start and the end of the race to avoid situations for those who take part in the race.

zh: 隨著電子產業發展，人們的生活習慣也受到很深的影響。
py: suí zhù diàn zi chǎn yè fā zhǎn ， rén men de shēng huó xí guàn yě shòu dào hěn shēn de yǐng xiǎng 。
en: As the electronics industry develops, people ' s habits are also deeply affected.

zh: 從事新工作時往往經驗不足，因此向別人請教是必需的。
py: cóng shì xīn gōng zuò shí wǎng wǎng jīng yàn bù zú ， yīn cǐ xiàng bié rén qǐng jiào shì bì xū de 。
en: As new jobs are often inexperienced, it is necessary to consult with others.

zh: 我的電腦系統無法升級，所以很多功能都不能使用。
py: wǒ de diàn nǎo xì tǒng wú fǎ shēng jí ， suǒ yǐ hěn duō gōng néng dōu bù néng shǐ yòng 。
en: My computer system can't be upgraded, so many functions cannot be used.

zh: 這條道路限制車速五十公里，你不能再加速了。
py: zhè tiáo dào lù xiàn zhì chē sù wǔ shí gōng lǐ ， nǐ bù néng zài jiā sù le 。
en: This road limits the speed of 50 km. You can't speed up any more.

zh: 自從採用專家提供的方法後，茶葉的產量已增加百分之五十。
py: zì cóng cǎi yòng zhuān jiā tí gōng de fāng fǎ hòu ， chá yè de chǎn liàng yǐ zēng jiā bǎi fēn zhī wǔ shí 。
en: Tea production has increased by 50 per cent since the introduction of methods provided by specialists.

zh: 化裝舞會上他打扮成一具機器人，連說話走路都模仿機器人。
py: huà zhuāng wǔ huì shàng tā dǎ bàn chéng yī jù jī qì rén ， lián shuō huà zǒu lù dōu mó fǎng jī qì rén 。
en: He was dressed as a droid at the costume ball, and he even tried to imitate robots when he spoke and walked.

zh: 為了保住勞工的福利，她到處去演講。
py: wèi le bǎo zhù láo gōng de fú lì ， tā dào chù qù yǎn jiǎng 。
en: In order to preserve the well-being of the workers, she spoke everywhere.

zh: 路上安裝紅綠燈，是要保障民眾的交通安全。
py: lù shàng ān zhuāng hóng lǜ dēng ， shì yào bǎo zhàng mín zhòng de jiāo tōng ān quán 。
en: The installation of red green lights on the roads is intended to ensure the safety of traffic for the population.

zh: 父母反對她從事電影行業，哪怕收入很高，還是不贊成。
py: fù mǔ fǎn duì tā cóng shì diàn yǐng xíng yè ， nǎ pà shōu rù hěn gāo ， hái shì bù zàn chéng 。
en: Parents who oppose her work in the film industry do not agree with her even if she has a high income.

zh: 在自由國家，只要人民覺得不合理，都能跟相關部門抗議。
py: zài zì yóu guó jiā ， zhǐ yào rén mín jué dé bù hé lǐ ， dōu néng gēn xiāng guān bù mén kàng yì 。
en: In a free country, people can protest with the relevant ministries whenever they feel unreasonable.

zh: 老師提醒學生有疑問要馬上解決，免得越到後面越不了解。
py: lǎo shī tí xǐng xué shēng yǒu yí wèn yào mǎ shàng jiě jué ， miǎn de yuè dào hòu miàn yuè bù liǎo jiě 。
en: The teachers reminded the students of the need to resolve their doubts immediately, so that they did not know more and less.

zh: 她的專業是人工智慧，這個領域的問題可以請教她。
py: tā de zhuān yè shì rén gōng zhì huì ， zhè gè lǐng yù de wèn tí kě yǐ qǐng jiào tā 。
en: Her profession is artificial intelligence, and she can be asked about this field.

zh: 當森林漸漸從地球上消失時，可能使全球氣候產生重大的變化。
py: dāng sēn lín jiàn jiàn cóng dì qiú shàng xiāo shī shí ， kě néng shǐ quán qiú qì hòu chǎn shēng zhòng dà de biàn huà 。
en: When forests are disappearing from the face of the Earth, there is a potential for a major change in global climate.

zh: 現在已經沒有所謂的鐵飯碗了，有專業技術才有保障。
py: xiàn zài yǐ jīng méi yǒu suǒ wèi de tiě fàn wǎn le ， yǒu zhuān yè jì shù cái yǒu bǎo zhàng 。
en: There's no more so-called iron jobs. There's only professional skills.

zh: 這件事我根本不了解，所以沒辦法給你適當的建議。
py: zhè jiàn shì wǒ gēn běn bù liǎo jiě ， suǒ yǐ méi bàn fǎ gěi nǐ shì dāng de jiàn yì 。
en: I don't know anything about this, so I can't give you the right advice.

zh: 她到印尼買了一些木頭做的禮品，加工後再到網路上售出。
py: tā dào yìn ní mǎi le yī xiē mù tóu zuò de lǐ pǐn ， jiā gōng hòu zài dào wǎng lù shàng shòu chū 。
en: She went to Indonesia to buy some wood-made gifts and then processed them and sold them on the Internet.

zh: 除了他以外，我們都會駕駛汽車。 (Prep)我買了一雙除臭的襪子送給他。 (V)一百除二的答案是五十。 (Vst)
py: chú le tā yǐ wài ， wǒ men dōu huì jià shǐ qì chē 。 (Prep)  wǒ mǎi le yī shuāng chú chòu de wà zi sòng gěi tā 。 (V)  yì bǎi chú èr de dá àn shì wǔ shí 。 (Vst)
en: Except for him, we're all driving a car. (Prep  ) I bought him a pair of deodorant socks. (V) 100 divided by 50. (Vst) The answer is 50.

zh: 無論做錯事或出差錯，任何人都應主動負起責任。
py: wú lùn zuò cuò shì huò chū chāi cuò ， rèn hé rén dōu yīng zhǔ dòng fù qǐ zé rèn 。
en: No matter what is wrong or what is wrong, anyone should take responsibility for it.

zh: 腦部血管很複雜，做腦部手術時不能有任何的差錯。
py: nǎo bù xuè guǎn hěn fù zá ， zuò nǎo bù shǒu shù shí bù néng yǒu rèn hé de chà cuò 。
en: Brain veins are complicated and there can be no error in brain surgery.

zh: 使用高度技術製造出來的工業生產機器，操作起來往往更有效率。
py: shǐ yòng gāo dù jì shù zhì zào chū lái de gōng yè shēng chǎn jī qì ， cāo zuò qǐ lái wǎng wǎng gèng yǒu xiào lǜ 。
en: Industrial production machines made from high-tech techniques tend to operate more efficiently.

zh: 他在山裡迷路了，只好順著河流往山下走。
py: tā zài shān lǐ mí lù le ， zhǐ hǎo shùn zhù hé liú wǎng shān xià zǒu 。
en: And he was lost in the mountains, so he went down with the rivers.

zh: 教育是國家的根本，能改變國家的未來。
py: jiào yù shì guó jiā de gēn běn ， néng gǎi biàn guó jiā de wèi lái 。
en: Education is the foundation of the country and can change its future.

zh: 他想等中文程度達到高級以後，就來臺灣念大學。
py: tā xiǎng děng zhōng wén chéng dù dá dào gāo jí yǐ hòu ， jiù lái tái wān niàn dà xué 。
en: He wants to come to Taiwan and go to college when he reaches a high level of Chinese.

zh: 他很聰明，成績又非常好，因此完成初級班的課程後，學校讓他跳過中級，到高級班學習，一連跳了兩級。
py: tā hěn cōng míng ， chéng jī yòu fēi cháng hǎo ， yīn cǐ wán chéng chū jí bān de kè chéng hòu ， xué xiào ràng tā tiào guò zhōng jí ， dào gāo jí bān xué xí ， yī lián tiào le liǎng jí 。
en: He was smart and very good at grades, so after completing the first class, the school got him to skip the middle class, to study at the senior level, and then two in a row.

zh: 他初到臺灣時，十分不適應當地的氣候。
py: tā chū dào tái wān shí ， shí fēn bù shì yīng dāng dì de qì hòu 。
en: When he first arrived in Taiwan, he was very unsuited to the local climate.

zh: 他是華僑，說中文時常帶點兒當地的口音。
py: tā shì huá qiáo ， shuō zhōng wén shí cháng dài diǎn ér dāng dì de kǒu yīn 。
en: He speaks Chinese with a local accent.

zh: 網路商店時常在過節時舉辦降價活動來吸引顧客。
py: wǎng lù shāng diàn shí cháng zài guò jié shí jǔ bàn jiàng jià huó dòng lái xī yǐn gù kè 。
en: Internet shops often organize price-cutting events during holidays to attract customers.

zh: 我吃得少，每天早上也運動，但是我的體重仍然超重。
py: wǒ chī dé shǎo ， měi tiān zǎo shàng yě yùn dòng ， dàn shì wǒ de tǐ zhòng réng rán chāo zhòng 。
en: I eat less, I exercise every morning, but I'm still overweight.

zh: 冰箱裡的牛奶早就過期了，你還不扔掉嗎？
py: bīng xiāng lǐ de niú nǎi zǎo jiù guò qī le ， nǐ hái bù rēng diào ma ？
en: The milk in the fridge is long overdue. Why don't you throw it away?

zh: 想有效解決身材肥胖的問題，就應避免吃太肥的肉、太油的菜，同時還得多運動。
py: xiǎng yǒu xiào jiě jué shēn cái féi pàng de wèn tí ， jiù yīng bì miǎn chī tài féi de ròu 、 tài yóu de cài ， tóng shí hái dé duō yùn dòng 。
en: If you want to deal effectively with obesity, you should avoid eating too fat, too oily, and more exercise at the same time.

zh: 那個網站在拍賣手工肥皂，買一送一，蠻划算的。
py: nà gè wǎng zhàn zài pāi mài shǒu gōng féi zào ， mǎi yī sòng yī ， mán huá suàn de 。
en: That website is auctioning hand soap, buying one for one. It's a good deal.

zh: 火腿裡放了很多鹽巴，醫師不建議爺爺多吃。
py: huǒ tuǐ lǐ fàng le hěn duō yán bā ， yī shī bù jiàn yì yé yé duō chī 。
en: There's a lot of salt in the ham, and the doctor doesn't advise Grandpa to eat more.

zh: 奶奶在後院不只種了綠豆及黃豆，還種了許多蔬菜。
py: nǎi nǎi zài hòu yuàn bù zhǐ zhǒng le lǜ dòu jí huáng dòu ， hái zhǒng le xǔ duō shū cài 。
en: Grandma grew more than green beans and soybeans in the backyard and many vegetables.

zh: 弟弟不喜歡吃肉包子裡的餡，他覺得很油膩。
py: dì di bù xǐ huān chī ròu bāo zi lǐ de xiàn ， tā jué dé hěn yóu nì 。
en: My brother didn't like the pebbles in the meat buns, and he felt so greasy.

zh: 奶油不但種類多，並且是做甜點時不能少的材料。
py: nǎi yóu bù dàn zhǒng lèi duō ， bìng qiě shì zuò tián diǎn shí bù néng shǎo de cái liào 。
en: Creams are not only a variety of types, but also materials that can be made of dessert.

zh: 這家廠商針對老年人的需求生產了一種新奶粉。
py: zhè jiā chǎng shāng zhēn duì lǎo nián rén de xū qiú shēng chǎn le yī zhǒng xīn nǎi fěn 。
en: The manufacturer produced a new milk powder for the needs of the elderly.

zh: 算起來我們已經好久沒吃餃子了，買點兒麵粉、青菜和肉，回家包餃子吧。
py: suàn qǐ lái wǒ men yǐ jīng hǎo jiǔ méi chī jiǎo zi le ， mǎi diǎn ér miàn fěn 、 qīng cài hé ròu ， huí jiā bāo jiǎo zi ba 。
en: It's been a long time since we've had a dumpling. Buy some flour, cabbage and meat. Go home.

zh: 能得到觀眾熱情掌聲的表演，才算是有魅力的表演。
py: néng dé dào guān zhòng rè qíng zhǎng shēng de biǎo yǎn ， cái suàn shì yǒu mèi lì de biǎo yǎn 。
en: It's attractive to be able to get a lively ovation from the audience.

zh: 爸爸為了迎接伯父回臺灣過節，把客房打掃得很乾淨。
py: bà bà wèi le yíng jiē bó fù huí tái wān guò jié ， bǎ kè fáng dǎ sǎo dé hěn qián jìng 。
en: Dad cleaned up the guest room to welcome Uncle back to Taiwan.

zh: 我話先說在前頭，要是你不照他所說的去做，等後頭出了問題，情況可就更複雜了。
py: wǒ huà xiān shuō zài qián tóu ， yào shì nǐ bù zhào tā suǒ shuō de qù zuò ， děng hòu tóu chū le wèn tí ， qíng kuàng kě jiù gèng fù zá le 。
en: If you don't do what he says, it's more complicated when something goes wrong.

zh: 夏天運動過後，喝杯冰冰涼涼的冷飲，感覺很痛快。
py: xià tiān yùn dòng guò hòu ， hē bēi bīng bīng liáng liáng de lěng yǐn ， gǎn jué hěn tòng kuài 。
en: After summer's exercise, a cold cold and cold drink was felt so good.

zh: 工作有壓力時，應適當地分配你的工作及娛樂時間。
py: gōng zuò yǒu yā lì shí ， yīng shì dāng dì fēn pèi nǐ de gōng zuò jí yú lè shí jiān 。
en: When there is pressure on your work, you should be properly allocated time for work and entertainment.

zh: 老方住院開刀時，同事們都輪流到醫院慰問並照顧他。
py: lǎo fāng zhù yuàn kāi dāo shí ， tóng shì men dōu lún liú dào yī yuàn wèi wèn bìng zhào gù tā 。
en: When the old people were hospitalized, their colleagues moved to the hospital to interview him and take care of him.

zh: 妹妹個子比較高，手也長， 買衣服時都得注意袖子的長度。
py: mèi mèi gè zi bǐ jiào gāo ， shǒu yě zhǎng ，  mǎi yī fú shí dōu dé zhù yì xiù zi de zhǎng dù 。
en: She's taller and she's got long hands, and she's got to pay attention to the length of her sleeves when she buys her clothes.

zh: 他把朋友送他的畫先捲起來，等有空時再找地方掛上。
py: tā bǎ péng yǒu sòng tā de huà xiān juǎn qǐ lái ， děng yǒu kòng shí zài zhǎo dì fāng guà shàng 。
en: He rolls his friend's drawings and hangs them when he's free.

zh: 我們到小張家時，他端了一盤切好的水果來招待我們。
py: wǒ men dào xiǎo zhāng jiā shí ， tā duān le yī pán qiè hǎo de shuǐ guǒ lái zhāo dài wǒ men 。
en: When we got to Zhang's house, he brought us a slice of cut fruit.

zh: 小孩子剛學習用筷子吃麵條時，常需要媽媽先替他把麵拌一拌。
py: xiǎo hái zi gāng xué xí yòng kuài zi chī miàn tiáo shí ， cháng xū yào mā mā xiān tì tā bǎ miàn bàn yī bàn 。
en: When a child learns to eat noodles with chopsticks, she often needs her mother to pour her noodles for him first.

zh: 明天一大早要動身出國旅遊，所以我在睡前先把鬧鐘調好。
py: míng tiān yī dà zǎo yào dòng shēn chū guó lǚ yóu ， suǒ yǐ wǒ zài shuì qián xiān bǎ nào zhōng diào hǎo 。
en: I'm leaving for a trip early in the morning, so I'll set the alarm before I go to bed.

zh: 自從開始掉頭髮以後，醫師就建議他每天吃半顆維他命。
py: zì cóng kāi shǐ diào tóu fà yǐ hòu ， yī shī jiù jiàn yì tā měi tiān chī bàn kē wéi tā mìng 。
en: Since the beginning of his hair, he has been advised to eat half of his vitamins every day.

zh: 蛋黃月餅的營養豐富，可是不能多吃，不然很容易發胖。
py: dàn huáng yuè bǐng de yíng yǎng fēng fù ， kě shì bù néng duō chī ， bù rán hěn róng yì fā pàng 。
en: Eggs and yellow mooncakes are rich, but they can't eat more, or they're easy to fatten.

zh: 她把蛋白拌進麵粉裡，加點兒花生烤一烤，又香又好吃。
py: tā bǎ dàn bái bàn jìn miàn fěn lǐ ， jiā diǎn ér huā shēng kǎo yī kǎo ， yòu xiāng yòu hǎo chī 。
en: She mixes the protein into the flour with peanuts to roast and smells good.

zh: 我在喝粥時習慣加一些芝麻進去，喝起來很香。
py: wǒ zài hē zhōu shí xí guàn jiā yī xiē zhī má jìn qù ， hē qǐ lái hěn xiāng 。
en: I'm used to having sesame when I'm having porridge. It smells good.

zh: 有人喜歡在枕頭上抹一點兒自己喜歡的香水，聽說可以紓壓。
py: yǒu rén xǐ huān zài zhěn tóu shàng mǒ yī diǎn ér zì jǐ xǐ huān de xiāng shuǐ ， tīng shuō kě yǐ shū yā 。
en: Some people like to put a little perfume on their pillows, and they say they can crush it.

zh: 包著紅豆餡，裹著花生粉的麻糬，是臺灣著名的傳統甜點。
py: bāo zhù hóng dòu xiàn ， guǒ zhù huā shēng fěn de má shǔ ， shì tái wān zhù míng de chuán tǒng tián diǎn 。
en: The peas wrapped in red bean peas and peanut powder are famous traditional desserts in Taiwan.

zh: 在吃湯麵之前淋上點兒芝麻油，吃起來味道更好。
py: zài chī tāng miàn zhī qián lín shàng diǎn ér zhī má yóu ， chī qǐ lái wèi dào gèng hǎo 。
en: A little sesame oil before the soup. It tastes better.

zh: 從過去到現在，尊敬長輩一直是華人最重視的傳統觀念之一。
py: cóng guò qù dào xiàn zài ， zūn jìng zhǎng bèi yì zhí shì huá rén zuì zhòng shì de chuán tǒng guān niàn zhī yī 。
en: From the past to the present, respect for elders has been one of China's most valued traditions.

zh: 許多世紀以來，受壓迫的民族都渴望擁有平等的待遇。
py: xǔ duō shì jì yǐ lái ， shòu yā pò de mín zú dōu kě wàng yōng yǒu píng děng de dài yù 。
en: For many centuries, oppressed peoples have longed for equal treatment.

zh: 這家旅行社有宣傳活動，所以裡頭、外頭都站滿了人。
py: zhè jiā lǚ xíng shè yǒu xuān chuán huó dòng ， suǒ yǐ lǐ tóu 、 wài tóu dōu zhàn mǎn le rén 。
en: This travel agency has publicity activities, so it's full of people inside and outside.

zh: 華人過春節時有個風俗，就是每戶人家都會在門口貼春聯。
py: huá rén guò chūn jié shí yǒu gè fēng sú ， jiù shì měi hù rén jiā dōu huì zài mén kǒu tiē chūn lián 。
en: There is a custom among the Chinese during the Spring Festival, that every family will be in contact with each other at the door.

zh: 那位模特兒曾多次參與連續劇演出，相當受歡迎。
py: nà wèi mó tè ér céng duō cì cān yǔ lián xù jù yǎn chū ， xiāng dāng shòu huān yíng 。
en: The model was very popular when she took part in the series on a number of occasions.

zh: 不知道是什麼緣故，每次當我見到你時，總是覺得很歡喜。
py: bù zhī dào shì shén me yuán gù ， měi cì dāng wǒ jiàn dào nǐ shí ， zǒng shì jué dé hěn huān xǐ 。
en: I don't know what it is, but every time I see you, I'm always happy.

zh: 自從政府宣布石油、電費雙漲的作法以來，反對的民眾人數已近七成。
py: zì cóng zhèng fǔ xuān bù shí yóu 、 diàn fèi shuāng zhǎng de zuò fǎ yǐ lái ， fǎn duì de mín zhòng rén shù yǐ jìn qī chéng 。
en: Since the announcement by the government of double oil and electricity prices, nearly 70 per cent of the population has been opposed.

zh: 我媽媽退休後，就在家幫忙照顧孫子和孫女。
py: wǒ mā mā tuì xiū hòu ， jiù zài jiā bāng máng zhào gù sūn zi hé sūn nǚ 。
en: When my mother retired, she took care of her grandson and granddaughter at home.

zh: 我們週末常去鄉下走走，享受農村生活，黃昏時才回市區。
py: wǒ men zhōu mò cháng qù xiāng xià zǒu zǒu ， xiǎng shòu nóng cūn shēng huó ， huáng hūn shí cái huí shì qū 。
en: We used to go out to the country on weekends, enjoy the farm life, and then go back to the city at dusk.

zh: 下午颱風就要來了，看樣子得趕快去超市買點兒食物。
py: xià wǔ tái fēng jiù yào lái le ， kàn yàng zi dé gǎn kuài qù chāo shì mǎi diǎn ér shí wù 。
en: The hurricane's coming in this afternoon. Looks like we've got to get some food at the supermarket.

zh: 世界各地的神話雖然不見得都真實，卻能讓人們多少了解一些古代的風俗習慣。
py: shì jiè gè dì de shén huà suī rán bù jiàn dé dōu zhēn shí ， què néng ràng rén men duō shǎo liǎo jiě yī xiē gǔ dài de fēng sú xí guàn 。
en: The myths around the world, while not as true as they may seem, give people some insight into ancient customs and habits.

zh: 在華人社會中，農曆七月是拜祖先的月份。
py: zài huá rén shè huì zhōng ， nóng lì qī yuè shì bài zǔ xiān de yuè fèn 。
en: In Chinese society, the month of July is the month of the ancestors.

zh: 大學畢業後，同學們就奔向自己的人生目標，五年後才聚在一起。
py: dà xué bì yè hòu ， tóng xué men jiù bēn xiàng zì jǐ de rén shēng mù biāo ， wǔ nián hòu cái jù zài yì qǐ 。
en: After college, the students went to their own goals, and only five years later they came together.

zh: 傳說月亮上住著一隻兔子，這個神話留給孩子們許多想像空間。
py: chuán shuō yuè liàng shàng zhù zhù yī zhī tù zi ， zhè gè shén huà liú gěi hái zi men xǔ duō xiǎng xiàng kōng jiān 。
en: The legend that a rabbit lives on the moon leaves many imaginary spaces for children.

zh: 小寒特別喜愛射氣球遊戲，每次去逛夜市時總要完五、六回。
py: xiǎo hán tè bié xǐ ài shè qì qiú yóu xì ， měi cì qù guàng yè shì shí zǒng yào wán wǔ 、 liù huí 。
en: The chills have a special interest in ballooning games, which always lasts five or six times every time they go to the night market.

zh: 老師問的題目太難，大家只好望著老師，看老師怎麼回答。
py: lǎo shī wèn de tí mù tài nán ， dà jiā zhǐ hǎo wàng zhù lǎo shī ， kàn lǎo shī zěn me huí dá 。
en: The questions asked by the teachers were too difficult for everyone to look at them and see how they answered them.

zh: 這次申請獎學金，達到標準的學生總共不超過十人。
py: zhè cì shēn qǐng jiǎng xué jīn ， dá dào biāo zhǔn de xué shēng zǒng gòng bù chāo guò shí rén 。
en: There are no more than 10 students who have reached the standard.

zh: 中國古代的人們相信，當好人碰到危險或困難時，會有神仙到人間來幫助他們。
py: zhōng guó gǔ dài de rén men xiāng xìn ， dāng hǎo rén pèng dào wēi xiǎn huò kùn nán shí ， huì yǒu shén xiān dào rén jiān lái bāng zhù tā men 。
en: The ancient Chinese believe that when good people are in danger or in difficulty, there will be gods to help them.

zh: 古代人非常尊敬大自然，認為土地、山與河都有神。
py: gǔ dài rén fēi cháng zūn jìng dà zì rán ， rèn wèi tǔ dì 、 shān yǔ hé dōu yǒu shén 。
en: The ancients had great respect for nature and believed that there were gods in the land, mountains and rivers.

zh: 他勸我別太在意別人的眼光，把自己負責的事完成就好。
py: tā quàn wǒ bié tài zài yì bié rén de yǎn guāng ， bǎ zì jǐ fù zé de shì wán chéng jiù hǎo 。
en: He persuaded me not to give too much attention to the eyes of others and to finish what I was responsible for.

zh: 迷信的人老是相信一些不真實的迷信，例如：黑貓會帶來不好的運氣、送傘給情人就會分手什麼的。
py: mí xìn de rén lǎo shì xiāng xìn yī xiē bù zhēn shí de mí xìn ， lì rú ： hēi māo huì dài lái bù hǎo de yùn qì 、 sòng sǎn gěi qíng rén jiù huì fēn shǒu shén me de 。
en: The superstitious always believe in unreal superstitions, such as black cats that bring bad luck and umbrellas to lovers that break up or something.

zh: 射箭看來容易，但想把箭射好，就得辛苦地練習。
py: shè jiàn kàn lái róng yì ， dàn xiǎng bǎ jiàn shè hǎo ， jiù dé xīn kǔ dì liàn xí 。
en: It seems easy to shoot arrows, but if you want to shoot arrows well, you have to practice hard.

zh: 我們公司在這次電子展共發表了九項新產品，並吸引不少國外客戶來參觀。
py: wǒ men gōng sī zài zhè cì diàn zi zhǎn gòng fā biǎo le jiǔ xiàng xīn chǎn pǐn ， bìng xī yǐn bù shǎo guó wài kè hù lái cān guān 。
en: Our company published nine new products at this electronic exhibition and attracted a number of foreign clients to visit.

zh: 這次的說話比賽要求參加的學生說一個神奇的外國故事。
py: zhè cì de shuō huà bǐ sài yāo qiú cān jiā de xué shēng shuō yī gè shén qí de wài guó gù shì 。
en: This talk contest requires students to tell an amazing foreign story.

zh: 這次會議的效率真差，有人竟然沒看資料就來了，真是誇張。
py: zhè cì huì yì de xiào lǜ zhēn chà ， yǒu rén jìng rán méi kàn zī liào jiù lái le ， zhēn shì kuā zhāng 。
en: The meeting was very inefficient, and some people came without reading the data. It's an exaggeration.

zh: 小戴在這場籃球比賽中表現相當優秀，投中了三十多分，因此被教練選中，代表學校參加全國比賽。
py: xiǎo dài zài zhè chǎng lán qiú bǐ sài zhōng biǎo xiàn xiāng dāng yōu xiù ， tóu zhōng le sān shí duō fēn ， yīn cǐ bèi jiào liàn xuǎn zhōng ， dài biǎo xué xiào cān jiā quán guó bǐ sài 。
en: Xiao Dai performed well in this basketball game, winning more than 30 points, and was elected by the coaches to represent the school in the national competition.

zh: 這家餐廳我去過一次，對他們的菜很失望，從此就不去了。
py: zhè jiā cān tīng wǒ qù guò yī cì ， duì tā men de cài hěn shī wàng ， cóng cǐ jiù bù qù le 。
en: I've been to this restaurant once, and I've been disappointed with their food, and I've never been there.

zh: 學校的畢業典禮辦得很精彩，讓我們度過了愉快的一天。
py: xué xiào de bì yè diǎn lǐ bàn dé hěn jīng cǎi ， ràng wǒ men dù guò le yú kuài de yī tiān 。
en: The school graduation ceremony was a great one, and we had a good day.

zh: 春假時我打算到泰國小島上的鄉村去度個假。
py: chūn jià shí wǒ dǎ suàn dào tài guó xiǎo dǎo shàng de xiāng cūn qù dù gè jiǎ 。
en: During the spring break, I decided to go to the country on the Thai island for a vacation.

zh: 朋友認為生日晚會不喝酒就沒有歡樂的氣氛。
py: péng yǒu rèn wèi shēng rì wǎn huì bù hē jiǔ jiù méi yǒu huān lè de qì fēn 。
en: Friends think there's no joy in having a party without drinking.

zh: 他與妻子雖然已結婚多年，感情仍維持得很好，真令人羨慕。
py: tā yǔ qī zǐ suī rán yǐ jié hūn duō nián ， gǎn qíng réng wéi chí dé hěn hǎo ， zhēn lìng rén xiàn mù 。
en: Although he had been married to his wife for many years, he was still in a very good relationship, which was admirable.

zh: 他失業了，但妻子三人卻仍在一旁支持著他，讓他安心了不少。
py: tā shī yè le ， dàn qī zǐ sān rén què réng zài yī páng zhī chí zhù tā ， ràng tā ān xīn le bù shǎo 。
en: He was unemployed, but the three wives were still there to support him and reassured him.

zh: 根據華人民間的說法，過年時如果收到紅包，整年就會有好運氣。
py: gēn jù huá rén mín jiān de shuō fǎ ， guò nián shí rú guǒ shōu dào hóng bāo ， zhěng nián jiù huì yǒu hǎo yùn qì 。
en: According to the Chinese people, if a red bag is received in the past year, there will be good luck throughout the year.

zh: 在戶外的夜景中攝影，以月光當作背景可增加神秘的感覺。
py: zài hù wài de yè jǐng zhōng shè yǐng ， yǐ yuè guāng dāng zuò bèi jǐng kě zēng jiā shén mì de gǎn jué 。
en: Photographing in outdoor night visions, using moonlight as a background can add to mystique.

zh: 今天的自然科學課程所介紹的主題是月球的構造。
py: jīn tiān de zì rán kē xué kè chéng suǒ jiè shào de zhǔ tí shì yuè qiú de gòu zào 。
en: Today's natural science curriculum presents the theme of the construction of the Moon.

zh: 要保持古文物原來的樣子不容易，需要好好照顧。
py: yào bǎo chí gǔ wén wù yuán lái de yàng zi bù róng yì ， xū yào hǎo hǎo zhào gù 。
en: It's not easy to keep an antiquity as it is, but it needs to be taken care of.

zh: 在人生地不熟的地方旅行時，如有當地人帶路，就可以節省不少時間。
py: zài rén shēng dì bù shú de dì fāng lǚ xíng shí ， rú yǒu dāng dì rén dài lù ， jiù kě yǐ jié shěng bù shǎo shí jiān 。
en: When travelling in a place not known to life, locals can save time if they lead the way.

zh: 按照我國官方規定，民間辦理環保活動可向官方申請經費。
py: àn zhào wǒ guó guān fāng guī dìng ， mín jiān bàn lǐ huán bǎo huó dòng kě xiàng guān fāng shēn qǐng jīng fèi 。
en: According to our official regulations, the private sector can apply for an official fee for environmental activities.

zh: 對我來說，閱讀醫學系列的小說是一個很好的休閒活動。
py: duì wǒ lái shuō ， yuè dú yī xué xì liè de xiǎo shuō shì yī gè hěn hǎo de xiū xián huó dòng 。
en: For me, reading medical novels is a good leisure activity.

zh: 這位著名畫家的作品，目前正在美術館展出。
py: zhè wèi zhù míng huà jiā de zuò pǐn ， mù qián zhèng zài měi shù guǎn zhǎn chū 。
en: The work of this famous painter is currently on display at the Gallery.

zh: 設計師利用上電視的機會，展示他今年設計的服裝。
py: shè jì shī lì yòng shàng diàn shì de jī huì ， zhǎn shì tā jīn nián shè jì de fú zhuāng 。
en: The designer took advantage of the opportunity to be on TV to show the costumes he designed this year.

zh: 他希望能在海邊舉辦婚禮，可是一直找不到理想的場地。
py: tā xī wàng néng zài hǎi biān jǔ bàn hūn lǐ ， kě shì yì zhí zhǎo bú dào lǐ xiǎng de chǎng dì 。
en: He wanted to have a wedding by the sea, but he couldn't find the perfect place.

zh: 妳身高一百七十公分，體重六十公斤，還不到減肥的程度。
py: nǐ shēn gāo yì bǎi qī shí gōng fēn ， tǐ zhòng liù shí gōng jīn ， hái bú dào jiǎn féi de chéng dù 。
en: You're 170 cm tall and weighs 60 kilos, not much to lose.

zh: 當室內與戶外溫度的差別很大時，我就容易感冒。
py: dāng shì nèi yǔ hù wài wēn dù de chà bié hěn dà shí ， wǒ jiù róng yì gǎn mào 。
en: I get colds when there's a big difference between the temperature in the room and the temperature in the room.

zh: 臺灣的小學教導孩子從平常生活中學習遵守規定。
py: tái wān de xiǎo xué jiào dǎo hái zi cóng píng cháng shēng huó zhōng xué xí zūn shǒu guī dìng 。
en: In Taiwan, children are taught to follow the rules in their normal lives.

zh: 孩子們好不容易才安靜，別去鬧他們，不然又要開始吵鬧了。
py: hái zi men hǎo bù róng yì cái ān jìng ， bié qù nào tā men ， bù rán yòu yào kāi shǐ chǎo nào le 。
en: It's hard for the kids to be quiet. Don't mess with them, or they'll start yelling again.

zh: 這項研究計畫只針對少部分區域實驗，參考價值不高。
py: zhè xiàng yán jiū jì huà zhǐ zhēn duì shǎo bù fèn qū yù shí yàn ， cān kǎo jià zhí bù gāo 。
en: The research project is limited to a few regional experiments and is of low value.

zh: 由於網路發達，現代人大都習慣上網購物。
py: yóu yú wǎng lù fā dá ， xiàn dài rén dà dōu xí guàn shàng wǎng gòu wù 。
en: As a result of the Internet, most modern people are used to shopping online.

zh: 他決定搬到國外去，所以打算出售臺灣的房屋。
py: tā jué dìng bān dào guó wài qù ， suǒ yǐ dǎ suàn chū shòu tái wān de fáng wū 。
en: He decided to move abroad, so he wanted to sell his house in Taiwan.

zh: 在觀光景點銷售紀念品，價格通常比一般商店高一些。
py: zài guān guāng jǐng diǎn xiāo shòu jì niàn pǐn ， jià gé tōng cháng bǐ yì bān shāng diàn gāo yī xiē 。
en: Monuments are sold at tourist attractions at prices that are usually higher than those of general stores.

zh: 假如擔心弄丟重要的資料，可複製一份存在電腦裡。
py: jiǎ rú dān xīn nòng diū zhòng yào de zī liào ， kě fù zhì yī fèn cún zài diàn nǎo lǐ 。
en: If you are worried about losing important data, you can copy a copy of it in the computer.

zh: 難得出國旅行，一定要多照幾張相片留念。
py: nán dé chū guó lǚ xíng ， yí dìng yào duō zhào jǐ zhāng xiàng piān liú niàn 。
en: It's hard to travel abroad, but it's important to take more photos.

zh: 這套陶瓷茶具是專家以手工方式做的，因此價格也不便宜。
py: zhè tào táo cí chá jù shì zhuān jiā yǐ shǒu gōng fāng shì zuò de ， yīn cǐ jià gé yě bù biàn yí 。
en: The ceramic tea set was made manually by specialists and was therefore not cheap.

zh: 網路購物辦理退貨時，必須保持商品原來的外觀才行。
py: wǎng lù gòu wù bàn lǐ tuì huò shí ， bì xū bǎo chí shāng pǐn yuán lái de wài guān cái xíng 。
en: When an Internet shopping office handles the return, it must maintain the physical appearance of the goods.

zh: 申請簽證的表格請填完整資料，以免無法順利申請。
py: shēn qǐng qiān zhèng de biǎo gé qǐng tián wán zhěng zī liào ， yǐ miǎn wú fǎ shùn lì shēn qǐng 。
en: The form for applying for a visa should be completed so that it does not go smoothly.

zh: 保存食物的方式會影響食物的新鮮程度。
py: bǎo cún shí wù de fāng shì huì yǐng xiǎng shí wù de xīn xiān chéng dù 。
en: The way food is preserved affects the freshness of food.

zh: 雖然受到了重大的挫折，可是他並沒有放棄自己的夢想。
py: suī rán shòu dào le zhòng dà de cuò zhé ， kě shì tā bìng méi yǒu fàng qì zì jǐ de mèng xiǎng 。
en: Despite a major setback, he had not given up his dreams.

zh: 這棟房子空間小，位置離市區又遠，所以價值三百萬而已。
py: zhè dòng fáng zi kōng jiān xiǎo ， wèi zhì lí shì qū yòu yuǎn ， suǒ yǐ jià zhí sān bǎi wàn ér yǐ 。
en: The house is small and far from the city, so it's worth only $3 million.

zh: 根據本大樓的管理規定，私人物品不可堆在公共區域。
py: gēn jù běn dà lóu de guǎn lǐ guī dìng ， sī rén wù pǐn bù kě duī zài gōng gòng qū yù 。
en: According to the regulations governing this building, private goods cannot be stored in public areas.

zh: 如果想捐頭髮，長度至少要十五公分以上才能捐。
py: rú guǒ xiǎng juān tóu fà ， zhǎng dù zhì shǎo yào shí wǔ gōng fēn yǐ shàng cái néng juān 。
en: It takes at least 15 centimetres to be able to donate hair if you wish to do so.

zh: 父母總是捨得給孩子最好的，卻捨不得對自己好一點兒。
py: fù mǔ zǒng shì shě dé gěi hái zi zuì hǎo de ， què shě bù dé duì zì jǐ hǎo yī diǎn ér 。
en: Parents always give their children the best, but they do not want to be better to themselves.

zh: 這塊玉的品質不錯，如果做成玉器應該可以賣出好價錢。
py: zhè kuài yù de pǐn zhì bù cuò ， rú guǒ zuò chéng yù qì yīng gāi kě yǐ mài chū hǎo jià qián 。
en: This piece of jade is of good quality, and if it's made, it should be worth a good price.

zh: 雕刻玉器的技術很複雜，目前多半還是只能靠人工處理。
py: diāo kè yù qì de jì shù hěn fù zá ， mù qián duō bàn hái shì zhǐ néng kào rén gōng chù lǐ 。
en: The techniques of the carvings are complicated and are still mostly handled manually.

zh: 你別怪他老是抱怨你的開車方式，他也是怕你撞著了人。
py: nǐ bié guài tā lǎo shì bào yuàn nǐ de kāi chē fāng shì ， tā yě shì pà nǐ zhuàng zhù le rén 。
en: Don't blame him for complaining about the way you drive. He's afraid you'll run into someone.

zh: 我習慣在家裡放一盆花，讓室內有鮮花的香味。
py: wǒ xí guàn zài jiā lǐ fàng yī pén huā ， ràng shì nèi yǒu xiān huā de xiāng wèi 。
en: I'm used to putting flowers in my house, making it smell like flowers in my room.

zh: 我旅行的方式很隨意，出發前從不先規劃行程。
py: wǒ lǚ xíng de fāng shì hěn suí yì ， chū fā qián cóng bù xiān guī huà xíng chéng 。
en: I travel in a casual manner, and I don't schedule it before I leave.

zh: 手機鬧鐘的音量及音樂聲，都可按照個人的使用習慣來調整。
py: shǒu jī nào zhōng de yīn liàng jí yīn lè shēng ， dōu kě àn zhào gè rén de shǐ yòng xí guàn lái diào zhěng 。
en: The volume of cellular alarms and the sound of music can be adjusted according to personal usage.

zh: 這幅設計圖畫得很仔細，畫圖的人應該相當細心。
py: zhè fú shè jì tú huà dé hěn zǎi xì ， huà tú de rén yīng gāi xiāng dāng xì xīn 。
en: The design is very elaborate, and the person who drew it should be very careful.

zh: 處理老房屋的問題，有時比重新建築一棟房子還要困難。
py: chù lǐ lǎo fáng wū de wèn tí ， yǒu shí bǐ zhòng xīn jiàn zhù yī dòng fáng zi hái yào kùn nán 。
en: There are times when it is difficult to build a new house to deal with the problem of old houses.

zh: 有時改變原來旅行的安排，可能會帶來不同的樂趣。
py: yǒu shí gǎi biàn yuán lái lǚ xíng de ān pái ， kě néng huì dài lái bù tóng de lè qù 。
en: Sometimes changes in the original travel arrangements may bring different pleasures.

zh: 我奶奶八十歲了，走起路來腳步仍像年輕人一樣。
py: wǒ nǎi nǎi bā shí suì le ， zǒu qǐ lù lái jiǎo bù réng xiàng nián qīng rén yī yàng 。
en: My grandmother is 80 years old and still walks like a young man.

zh: 史小姐到花蓮來觀光時不小心迷了路，幸虧遇到了熱心的阿姨送她回旅館。
py: shǐ xiǎo jiě dào huā lián lái guān guāng shí bù xiǎo xīn mí le lù ， xìng kuī yù dào le rè xīn de ā yí sòng tā huí lǚ guǎn 。
en: Miss Strozzi got lost when she came to the florists, thanks to a lovely aunt who took her back to the hotel.

zh: 公司來了位新同事，老闆要我向他一一介紹公司的規定。
py: gōng sī lái le wèi xīn tóng shì ， lǎo bǎn yào wǒ xiàng tā yī yī jiè shào gōng sī de guī dìng 。
en: The company has a new colleague, and the boss wants me to introduce him to the rules of the company.

zh: 這件事大家都堅持自己的觀點，討論不出結果，還是找個說話有分量的人來決定吧。
py: zhè jiàn shì dà jiā dōu jiān chí zì jǐ de guān diǎn ， tǎo lùn bù chū jié guǒ ， hái shì zhǎo gè shuō huà yǒu fèn liàng de rén lái jué dìng ba 。
en: We all stick to our point of view, we can't talk about it, we're going to have to find someone who can talk.

zh: 這道菜味道獨特，香味及顏色也很迷人，讓人忍不住流口水。
py: zhè dào cài wèi dào dú tè ， xiāng wèi jí yán sè yě hěn mí rén ， ràng rén rěn bú zhù liú kǒu shuǐ 。
en: This dish smells uniquely, and its scents and colours are fascinating, making it hard to drool.

zh: 國立博物館正在展覽公元三百年左右的古文物。
py: guó lì bó wù guǎn zhèng zài zhǎn lǎn gōng yuán sān bǎi nián zuǒ yòu de gǔ wén wù 。
en: The National Museum is exhibiting antiquities from around 300 A.D.

zh: 解決環境受汙染的問題需要長久的計畫。
py: jiě jué huán jìng shòu wū rǎn de wèn tí xū yào zhǎng jiǔ de jì huà 。
en: A long-term plan is needed to deal with environmental problems.

zh: 他透過古典文學來討論古代與現代的文化差異。
py: tā tòu guò gǔ diǎn wén xué lái tǎo lùn gǔ dài yǔ xiàn dài de wén huà chà yì 。
en: He discusses the cultural differences between ancient and modern cultures through classical literature.

zh: 這家博物館曾因戰爭而被破壞，如今總算重新開放參觀。
py: zhè jiā bó wù guǎn céng yīn zhàn zhēng ér bèi pò huài ， rú jīn zǒng suàn chóng xīn kāi fàng cān guān 。
en: The museum, which had been destroyed by the war, is now finally reopened.

zh: 雖然他已經親自說了對不起，但還是很後悔做出那樣沒禮貌的行為，於是再度向各位道歉。
py: suī rán tā yǐ jīng qīn zì shuō le duì bù qǐ ， dàn hái shì hěn hòu huǐ zuò chū nà yàng méi lǐ mào de xíng wèi ， yú shì zài dù xiàng gè wèi dào qiàn 。
en: Although he had said that he was sorry, he regretted that he had acted in such a rude manner and apologized to you again.

zh: 學校餐廳提供各式各樣的營養食品，供學生挑選。
py: xué xiào cān tīng tí gōng gè shì gè yàng de yíng yǎng shí pǐn ， gōng xué shēng tiāo xuǎn 。
en: School canteens provide a variety of nutritious foods for students to choose.

zh: 政府建公立學校的目的，主要是提高人民接受教育的機會。
py: zhèng fǔ jiàn gōng lì xué xiào de mù dì ， zhǔ yào shì tí gāo rén mín jiē shòu jiào yù de jī huì 。
en: The Government has established public schools for the main purpose of improving access to education.

zh: 這所國立大學獨特的教育風格吸引了不少國外學生。
py: zhè suǒ guó lì dà xué dú tè de jiào yù fēng gé xī yǐn le bù shǎo guó wài xué shēng 。
en: The unique educational style of the country's universities attracts a lot of students from abroad.

zh: 本市的市立圖書館的書籍豐富，來借書的民眾也不少。
py: běn shì de shì lì tú shū guǎn de shū jí fēng fù ， lái jiè shū de mín zhòng yě bù shǎo 。
en: The city's city library is rich in books and many people come to borrow them.

zh: 傳統私立高中有許多規定，在管理學生方面相當嚴格。
py: chuán tǒng sī lì gāo zhōng yǒu xǔ duō guī dìng ， zài guǎn lǐ xué shēng fāng miàn xiàng dāng yán gé 。
en: There are a number of regulations in the traditional private high schools, which are quite strict in managing students.

zh: 黃小姐為家人買了定期健康保險，萬一有需要時就可以減輕負擔。
py: huáng xiǎo jiě wèi jiā rén mǎi le dìng qī jiàn kāng bǎo xiǎn ， wàn yī yǒu xū yào shí jiù kě yǐ jiǎn qīng fù dān 。
en: Miss Wong buys regular health insurance for her family, which can be reduced in case of need.

zh: 華人社會中有很多重要的節日，比方(說)中秋節、農曆新年等等。
py: huá rén shè huì zhōng yǒu hěn duō zhòng yào de jié rì ， bǐ fāng ( shuō ) zhōng qiū jié 、 nóng lì xīn nián děng děng 。
en: There are many important festivals in Chinese society, such as Mid-Autumn, New Year's calendar, and so on.

zh: 我小時候最棒的休閒活動是到爺爺的菜園挖地種菜。
py: wǒ xiǎo shí hòu zuì bàng de xiū xián huó dòng shì dào yé yé de cài yuán wā dì zhǒng cài 。
en: The best leisure activity I ever had when I was a kid was to dig up the ground in Grandpa's garden.

zh: 這幅名畫每日吸引了上千位遊客前來博物館欣賞。
py: zhè fú míng huà měi rì xī yǐn le shàng qiān wèi yóu kè qián lái bó wù guǎn xīn shǎng 。
en: The painting attracted thousands of tourists to come to the museum every day to enjoy it.
