zh: 學習不應該只在校園裡，也包括課外學習。
py: xué xí bù yīng gāi zhǐ zài xiào yuán lǐ ， yě bāo kuò kè wài xué xí 。
en: Learning should not be confined to the campus, but should also include extracurricular studies.

zh: 當我們爬上那座高山，看見美麗的日出時，大家都驚訝地張大了嘴巴。
py: dāng wǒ men pá shàng nà zuò gāo shān ， kàn jiàn měi lì de rì chū shí ， dà jiā dōu jīng yà dì zhāng dà le zuǐ bā 。
en: When we climbed up the mountain and saw the beautiful sunrise, everyone opened their mouths with surprise.

zh: 每到重大節日，城市裡就到處充滿了歡樂的氣氛。
py: měi dào zhòng dà jié rì ， chéng shì lǐ jiù dào chù chōng mǎn le huān lè de qì fēn 。
en: Every big holiday, the city is filled with joy.

zh: 只有勇敢面對挑戰、克服困難的人，才能深深體會到成就感帶來的快樂。
py: zhǐ yǒu yǒng gǎn miàn duì tiāo zhàn 、 kè fú kùn nán de rén ， cái néng shēn shēn tǐ huì dào chéng jiù gǎn dài lái de kuài lè 。
en: Only those who have the courage to face the challenges and overcome the difficulties can deeply appreciate the joy of a sense of achievement.

zh: 潮溼的居住環境不僅使家具不容易保養，並且更可能傷害人體健康。
py: cháo shī de jū zhù huán jìng bù jǐn shǐ jiā jù bù róng yì bǎo yǎng ， bìng qiě gèng kě néng shāng hài rén tǐ jiàn kāng 。
en: The tidal environment makes furniture not only difficult to maintain, but also more likely to harm human health.

zh: 仔細地思考是為了防止做出錯誤的決定。
py: zǎi xì dì sī kǎo shì wèi le fáng zhǐ zuò chū cuò wù de jué dìng 。
en: The idea is to avoid making the wrong decisions.

zh: 公寓的電梯修復中，請大家改走樓梯。
py: gōng yù de diàn tī xiū fù zhōng ， qǐng dà jiā gǎi zǒu lóu tī 。
en: The elevators in the apartment are being repaired, so please change the stairs.

zh: 在臺灣，有人說夏天開冷氣不如開除溼機，不過有專家表示，它們的功能無法互相取代。
py: zài tái wān ， yǒu rén shuō xià tiān kāi lěng qì bù rú kāi chú shī jī ， bù guò yǒu zhuān jiā biǎo shì ， tā men de gōng néng wú fǎ hù xiāng qǔ dài 。
en: In Taiwan, it has been said that summer coolers are worse than disassembly machines, but some experts say that their functions cannot be replaced by one another.

zh: 電腦工程師除了維護電腦，還要處理各種與電腦相關的問題。
py: diàn nǎo gōng chéng shī chú le wéi hù diàn nǎo ， hái yào chù lǐ gè zhǒng yǔ diàn nǎo xiāng guān de wèn tí 。
en: In addition to maintaining computers, computer engineers deal with various computer-related problems.

zh: 現代人生活忙碌，就算是好友也偶然才碰面聊聊。
py: xiàn dài rén shēng huó máng lù ， jiù suàn shì hǎo yǒu yě ǒu rán cái pèng miàn liáo liáo 。
en: The modern generation is busy, and even friends meet and talk by chance.

zh: 康小姐的工作能力很強，能一面掌握會議的重點，一面把會議內容翻譯成外文。
py: kāng xiǎo jiě de gōng zuò néng lì hěn qiáng ， néng yí miàn zhǎng wò huì yì de zhòng diǎn ， yí miàn bǎ huì yì nèi róng fān yì chéng wài wén 。
en: Ms. Kang is very capable of working and is able to get to the point of the meeting and translate its contents into foreign languages.

zh: 這家公司成立不到兩年，現在的規模已發展得十分完整。
py: zhè jiā gōng sī chéng lì bú dào liǎng nián ， xiàn zài de guī mó yǐ fā zhǎn dé shí fēn wán zhěng 。
en: Less than two years after its establishment, the company is now well developed.

zh: 要前往國外旅行，得先確認當地現在的氣候，好收拾行李。
py: yào qián wǎng guó wài lǚ xíng ， dé xiān què rèn dāng dì xiàn zài de qì hòu ， hǎo shōu shí xíng lǐ 。
en: To travel abroad, it is necessary to confirm the current climate in the area so as to pack.

zh: 這套書分上下兩冊，買書時不可分開購買。
py: zhè tào shū fēn shàng xià liǎng cè ， mǎi shū shí bù kě fēn kāi gòu mǎi 。
en: This set of books is divided up and down and cannot be bought separately.

zh: 根據醫院規定，進入病房後禁止大聲說話。
py: gēn jù yī yuàn guī dìng ， jìn rù bìng fáng hòu jìn zhǐ dà shēng shuō huà 。
en: According to hospital regulations, when entering the ward, it is forbidden to speak out loud.

zh: 華語書籍陳列在書架的左邊，如有興趣可隨意翻翻。
py: huá yǔ shū jí chén liè zài shū jià de zuǒ biān ， rú yǒu xìng qù kě suí yì fān fān 。
en: Books in Chinese are on the left side of the shelf and can be flipped if interested.

zh: 那棟沒有主人的房屋充滿恐怖的傳說，一般人都不願意靠近。
py: nà dòng méi yǒu zhǔ rén de fáng wū chōng mǎn kǒng bù de chuán shuō ， yì bān rén dōu bù yuàn yì kào jìn 。
en: The house without its owner was full of horror legends and ordinary people did not want to come near it.

zh: 如果您對學校課程有任何問題，歡迎至辦公室談談。
py: rú guǒ nín duì xué xiào kè chéng yǒu rèn hé wèn tí ， huān yíng zhì bàn gōng shì tán tán 。
en: If you have any problems with the school curriculum, you are welcome to talk to the office.

zh: 這位記者專門報導社會新聞，他報新聞的方式相當專業。
py: zhè wèi jì zhě zhuān mén bào dǎo shè huì xīn wén ， tā bào xīn wén de fāng shì xiāng dāng zhuān yè 。
en: The journalist is specializing in social news, and he is very professional in the way news is reported.

zh: 運動選手在參加比賽前，補充營養的飲食很重要。
py: yùn dòng xuǎn shǒu zài cān jiā bǐ sài qián ， bǔ chōng yíng yǎng de yǐn shí hěn zhòng yào 。
en: In the run-up to the contest, sportsmen are very important to feed themselves.

zh: 我們打算用擲銅錢的方式，來決定讓誰處理這件事。
py: wǒ men dǎ suàn yòng zhì tóng qián de fāng shì ， lái jué dìng ràng shuí chù lǐ zhè jiàn shì 。
en: We're going to use the money to decide who's going to take care of this.

zh: 擲標槍、射箭、開槍(to shoot)需要的技巧都不同，想熟練就得多連練習。
py: zhì biāo qiāng 、 shè jiàn 、 kāi qiāng (to shoot) xū yào de jì qiǎo dōu bù tóng ， xiǎng shú liàn jiù dé duō lián liàn xí 。
en: Guns, arrows and to shoots require different techniques and much more practice.

zh: 這次文學比賽，我參加的項目是作文。
py: zhè cì wén xué bǐ sài ， wǒ cān jiā de xiàng mù shì zuò wén 。
en: In this literary competition, I'm in the essay project.

zh: 出國旅行最好辦個保險，發生意外時才能獲得保障。
py: chū guó lǚ xíng zuì hǎo bàn gè bǎo xiǎn ， fā shēng yì wài shí cái néng huò dé bǎo zhàng 。
en: Travel abroad is best insured in case of an accident.

zh: 她參加這場比賽的唯一目的，就是為了贏得第一名。
py: tā cān jiā zhè chǎng bǐ sài de wéi yī mù dì ， jiù shì wèi le yíng dé dì yì míng 。
en: The only reason she's in this game is to win first place.

zh: 經過多次訓練，他總算贏得這場球賽的冠軍。
py: jīng guò duō cì xùn liàn ， tā zǒng suàn yíng dé zhè chǎng qiú sài de guān jūn 。
en: After many trainings, he finally won the championship.

zh: 每面國旗都代表一個國家，而且設計上都具有獨特的意義。
py: měi miàn guó qí dōu dài biǎo yī gè guó jiā ， ér qiě shè jì shàng dōu jù yǒu dú tè de yì yì 。
en: Each flag represents a country and is designed for a unique purpose.

zh: 這座圓形廣場是為了紀念自由而建的。
py: zhè zuò yuán xíng guǎng chǎng shì wèi le jì niàn zì yóu ér jiàn de 。
en: The square was built to remember freedom.

zh: 她的物品上都有個小小的蝴蝶標誌，避免別人拿錯。
py: tā de wù pǐn shàng dōu yǒu gè xiǎo xiǎo de hú dié biāo zhì ， bì miǎn bié rén ná cuò 。
en: There's a little butterfly sign on her stuff to avoid anyone getting it wrong.

zh: 這本書是這位作家的代表作品，研究他的人都很熟悉。
py: zhè běn shū shì zhè wèi zuò jiā de dài biǎo zuò pǐn ， yán jiū tā de rén dōu hěn shú xī 。
en: The book is a representative of the author, and all the people who studied him are familiar with it.

zh: 訓練出著名跳高選手的教練認為，要跳得高，技巧很重要。
py: xùn liàn chū zhù míng tiào gāo xuǎn shǒu de jiào liàn rèn wèi ， yào tiào dé gāo ， jì qiǎo hěn zhòng yào 。
en: The coaches who train the famous jumpers think it's important to jump high.

zh: 我不太會跳高，跳遠倒是跳得還不錯。
py: wǒ bù tài huì tiào gāo ， tiào yuǎn dǎo shì tiào dé hái bù cuò 。
en: I'm not very good at jumping. I'm pretty good at jumping.

zh: 孫小姐最近談成了幾筆大生意，表現出色，於是公司決定提高她的薪水。
py: sūn xiǎo jiě zuì jìn tán chéng le jǐ bǐ dà shēng yì ， biǎo xiàn chū sè ， yú shì gōng sī jué dìng tí gāo tā de xīn shuǐ 。
en: Ms. Sun recently made a number of big deals and performed well, so the company decided to raise her salary.

zh: 她的外語能力不錯，因此公司經常派她到國外出差。
py: tā de wài yǔ néng lì bù cuò ， yīn cǐ gōng sī jīng cháng pài tā dào guó wài chū chāi 。
en: Her foreign language skills were good, so the company sent her abroad often.

zh: 他對發展新科技向來保守，不願接受人工智慧產品。
py: tā duì fā zhǎn xīn kē jì xiàng lái bǎo shǒu ， bù yuàn jiē shòu rén gōng zhì huì chǎn pǐn 。
en: He's always conservative about the development of new technologies and he doesn't want to accept artificial intelligence products.

zh: 李博士在國際上相當有名，他的研究總能引發學者討論。
py: lǐ bó shì zài guó jì shàng xiàng dāng yǒu míng ， tā de yán jiū zǒng néng yǐn fā xué zhě tǎo lùn 。
en: Dr. Lee is quite well known internationally, and his research always leads to discussion among the developers.

zh: 他告訴孩子不需要事事追求第一，但做任何事都必須盡力。
py: tā gào sù hái zi bù xū yào shì shì zhuī qiú dì yī ， dàn zuò rèn hé shì dōu bì xū jǐn lì 。
en: He told the child that nothing needed to be done first, but that everything had to be done.

zh: 她是一個很實際的人，對愛情從來不抱著美好的想像。
py: tā shì yī gè hěn shí jì de rén ， duì ài qíng cóng lái bù bào zhù měi hǎo de xiǎng xiàng 。
en: She's a very practical person who never had a good idea of love.

zh: 戰爭雖然勝利了，這個國家卻也失去了許多寶貴的生命。
py: zhàn zhēng suī rán shèng lì le ， zhè gè guó jiā què yě shī qù le xǔ duō bǎo guì de shēng mìng 。
en: Although war has won, this country has lost many precious lives.

zh: 樂觀的人會積極挑戰困難，就算無法成功也不會感到失望。
py: lè guān de rén huì jī jí tiāo zhàn kùn nán ， jiù suàn wú fǎ chéng gōng yě bù huì gǎn dào shī wàng 。
en: The optimistic will actively challenge the difficulties and will not be disappointed if they do not succeed.

zh: 每個宗教都有屬於自己的獨特儀式。
py: měi gè zōng jiào dōu yǒu shǔ yú zì jǐ de dú tè yí shì 。
en: Every religion has its own sui generis ritual.

zh: 這次活動是公司主辦的，目的是為了增加同事之間的感情。
py: zhè cì huó dòng shì gōng sī zhǔ bàn de ， mù dì shì wèi le zēng jiā tóng shì zhī jiān de gǎn qíng 。
en: The event was organized by the company to increase feelings among colleagues.

zh: 做生意與其花大錢廣告，不如提高品質，讓顧客替你宣傳。
py: zuò shēng yì yǔ qí huā dà qián guǎng gào ， bù rú tí gāo pǐn zhì ， ràng gù kè tì nǐ xuān chuán 。
en: Doing business is more expensive than advertising, so customers can promote it for you.

zh: 總統在廣場點燃煙火，跟民眾一起慶祝新年。
py: zǒng tǒng zài guǎng chǎng diǎn rán yān huǒ ， gēn mín zhòng yì qǐ qìng zhù xīn nián 。
en: The President set fire to the square to celebrate the New Year with the people.

zh: 人人都崇拜明星，但有多少人了解成功背後所付出的一切？
py: rén rén dōu chóng bài míng xīng ， dàn yǒu duō shǎo rén liǎo jiě chéng gōng bèi hòu suǒ fù chū de yī qiè ？
en: Everyone worships stars, but how many know what has been done behind success?

zh: 他看了歷史電影後，就非常崇拜戰爭中的革命英雄。
py: tā kàn le lì shǐ diàn yǐng hòu ， jiù fēi cháng chóng bài zhàn zhēng zhōng de gé mìng yīng xióng 。
en: After watching the historical film, he became a great admirer of the revolutionary heroes of war.

zh: 難得今天有空，我們不如一口氣解決工作上所有的問題吧。
py: nán dé jīn tiān yǒu kòng ， wǒ men bù rú yī kǒu qì jiě jué gōng zuò shàng suǒ yǒu de wèn tí ba 。
en: It's not like we're free today. Let's try to solve all the problems at work.

zh: 他熱愛路跑活動，只要是相關比賽，一定少不了他。
py: tā rè ài lù pǎo huó dòng ， zhǐ yào shì xiāng guān bǐ sài ， yí dìng shào bù liǎo tā 。
en: He loves to run the road, and he's got a lot to do with it.

zh: 看到自己國家的國旗進入奧運會場，民眾也不斷揮著手上的小旗子，替自己的國家加油。
py: kàn dào zì jǐ guó jiā de guó qí jìn rù ào yùn huì chǎng ， mín zhòng yě bù duàn huī zhù shǒu shàng de xiǎo qí zi ， tì zì jǐ de guó jiā jiā yóu 。
en: When you see your own country's flag entering the Olympics, people continue to use their little flag to refuel their country.

zh: 參加廚師比賽，只要味道部分的分數很高，就有機會得獎。
py: cān jiā chú shī bǐ sài ， zhǐ yào wèi dào bù fèn de fēn shù hěn gāo ， jiù yǒu jī huì dé jiǎng 。
en: In a chef's contest, there's a chance to win a prize if the taste section has a high score.

zh: 巴德在華語能力測驗中得了86分，還拿到了華語高級證書，讓她開心了半天。
py: bā dé zài huá yǔ néng lì cè yàn zhōng dé le 86 fēn ， hái ná dào le huá yǔ gāo jí zhèng shū ， ràng tā kāi xīn le bàn tiān 。
en: Bud scored 86 points in the Chinese language proficiency test and got a Chinese-language certificate, which made her happy for half a day.

zh: 為了吸引人才，廣告企業提供獎金給優秀的設計師。
py: wèi le xī yǐn rén cái ， guǎng gào qǐ yè tí gōng jiǎng jīn gěi yōu xiù de shè jì shī 。
en: In order to attract talent, advertising companies offer prizes to outstanding designers.

zh: 學校書法比賽的獎品是一臺平板電腦，希望能鼓勵大家參加。
py: xué xiào shū fǎ bǐ sài de jiǎng pǐn shì yī tái píng bǎn diàn nǎo ， xī wàng néng gǔ lì dà jiā cān jiā 。
en: The school law competition will be won by a tablet computer, and it is hoped that you will be encouraged to attend.

zh: 在抗議新建工廠的活動中，當地的環保團體聯合起來表達他們的需求。
py: zài kàng yì xīn jiàn gōng chǎng de huó dòng zhōng ， dāng dì de huán bǎo tuán tǐ lián hé qǐ lái biǎo dá tā men de xū qiú 。
en: In a protest against the construction of a new factory, local environmental groups came together to express their needs.

zh: 在全球環境會議中，聯合國邀請了一些環保團體共同參與。
py: zài quán qiú huán jìng huì yì zhōng ， lián hé guó yāo qǐng le yī xiē huán bǎo tuán tǐ gòng tóng cān yǔ 。
en: At the Global Environment Conference, the United Nations invited a number of environmental groups to participate.

zh: 我跟幾個愛好歷史的朋友一起組了社團，專門研究古文物。
py: wǒ gēn jǐ gè ài hǎo lì shǐ de péng yǒu yì qǐ zǔ le shè tuán ， zhuān mén yán jiū gǔ wén wù 。
en: I've organized a group with a few historical friends to study antiquities.

zh: 國際棒球比賽快開始了，那一群剛入棒球場、穿藍色運動服的就是臺灣隊。
py: guó jì bàng qiú bǐ sài kuài kāi shǐ le ， nà yī qún gāng rù bàng qiú chǎng 、 chuān lán sè yùn dòng fú de jiù shì tái wān duì 。
en: The international baseball game is about to begin, and the first people to enter the baseball field in blue are the Taiwan team.

zh: 賽跑前要先做點兒運動，免得受傷。
py: sài pǎo qián yào xiān zuò diǎn ér yùn dòng ， miǎn de shòu shāng 。
en: You have to do some exercise before you run, so you don't get hurt.

zh: 我剛拖了地，地上還是溼的，你最好繞過去比較安全。
py: wǒ gāng tuō le dì ， dì shàng hái shì shī de ， nǐ zuì hǎo rào guò qù bǐ jiào ān quán 。
en: I've just dragged the ground. It's still steep. You'd better go around.

zh: 為了找件漂亮又划算的衣服，她可是能逛百貨公司好幾圈的。
py: wèi le zhǎo jiàn piào liàng yòu huá suàn de yī fú ， tā kě shì néng guàng bǎi huò gōng sī hǎo jǐ quān de 。
en: In order to find a beautiful and cost-effective dress, she'd be able to go around the department store for a few laps.

zh: 職業棒球隊在比賽時，會請專業啦啦隊來製造熱鬧氣氛。
py: zhí yè bàng qiú duì zài bǐ sài shí ， huì qǐng zhuān yè la la duì lái zhì zào rè nào qì fēn 。
en: Professional baseball teams, when they're in the game, hire professional cheerleaders to make the mood.

zh: 夏天到了，我們去海邊走走，順便去打個海灘排球。
py: xià tiān dào le ， wǒ men qù hǎi biān zǒu zǒu ， shùn biàn qù dǎ gè hǎi tān pái qiú 。
en: When summer comes, we go for a walk by the beach and play a beach volleyball.

zh: 這項語法不太重要，我賭考試一定不會考。
py: zhè xiàng yǔ fǎ bù tài zhòng yào ， wǒ dǔ kǎo shì yí dìng bù huì kǎo 。
en: It's not important. I'll bet they won't.

zh: 這場棒球比賽已打到最後一局，可是仍無法看出誰輸誰贏。
py: zhè chǎng bàng qiú bǐ sài yǐ dǎ dào zuì hòu yī jú ， kě shì réng wú fǎ kàn chū shuí shū shuí yíng 。
en: This baseball game has reached its last game, but it still doesn't show who loses and who wins.

zh: 那支軍隊受的是特殊訓練，只在發生重大戰爭時才派出。
py: nà zhī jūn duì shòu de shì tè shū xùn liàn ， zhǐ zài fā shēng zhòng dà zhàn zhēng shí cái pài chū 。
en: The army was specially trained and sent only in the event of a major war.

zh: 我的球隊因為練習不夠，這一季的表現也不太理想。
py: wǒ de qiú duì yīn wèi liàn xí bù gòu ， zhè yī jì de biǎo xiàn yě bù tài lǐ xiǎng 。
en: My team's not doing well this season because it's not practiced enough.

zh: 我們學校的啦啦隊隊員個子都很高，舞蹈的技巧也很出色。
py: wǒ men xué xiào de la la duì duì yuán gè zi dōu hěn gāo ， wǔ dǎo de jì qiǎo yě hěn chū sè 。
en: The cheerleaders at our school are very tall, and they're very good at dancing.

zh: 這面金牌是完全用金子做的，外觀也相當獨特。
py: zhè miàn jīn pái shì wán quán yòng jīn zi zuò de ， wài guān yě xiāng dāng dú tè 。
en: This gold medal is made entirely of gold, and it's quite unique in appearance.

zh: 她推動學習革命，讓學生主動參與規劃課程。
py: tā tuī dòng xué xí gé mìng ， ràng xué shēng zhǔ dòng cān yǔ guī huà kè chéng 。
en: She started the learning revolution by involving students in the planning of the course.

zh: 主管的責任之一是幫員工爭取更好的福利。
py: zhǔ guǎn de zé rèn zhī yī shì bāng yuán gōng zhēng qǔ gèng hǎo de fú lì 。
en: One of the responsibilities of the director is to help workers get better benefits.

zh: 這家工廠奪下了著名品牌產品的製造機會。
py: zhè jiā gōng chǎng duó xià le zhù míng pǐn pái chǎn pǐn de zhì zào jī huì 。
en: The factory took the opportunity to produce a famous branded product.

zh: 這一屆的學生絕大部分都在畢業以前找到了工作。
py: zhè yī jiè de xué shēng jué dà bù fèn dōu zài bì yè yǐ qián zhǎo dào le gōng zuò 。
en: Most of the students in this class found a job before graduation.

zh: 這臺食品加工設備的構造相當複雜，其中約三分之一的零件還是由國外進口。
py: zhè tái shí pǐn jiā gōng shè bèi de gòu zào xiāng dāng fù zá ， qí zhōng yuē sān fēn zhī yī de líng jiàn hái shì yóu guó wài jìn kǒu 。
en: The fabric of this food processing facility is quite complex, and about one third of the parts are imported from abroad.

zh: 期中測驗的結果明天就會公布，大家都很緊張。
py: qī zhōng cè yàn de jié guǒ míng tiān jiù huì gōng bù ， dà jiā dōu hěn jǐn zhāng 。
en: The results of the midterm test will be published tomorrow. Everyone's nervous.

zh: 這項新發明解決了許多環保問題，發明的人還受國家表揚。
py: zhè xiàng xīn fā míng jiě jué le xǔ duō huán bǎo wèn tí ， fā míng de rén hái shòu guó jiā biǎo yáng 。
en: This new invention solves many environmental problems, and the inventors are also praised by the state.

zh: 生命中每一刻都很珍貴，隨時多用點心、多付出，就能令人生更美好。
py: shēng mìng zhòng měi yī kè dōu hěn zhēn guì ， suí shí duō yòng diǎn xīn 、 duō fù chū ， jiù néng lìng rén shēng gèng měi hǎo 。
en: Every moment of life is precious, and it is better to give and give at any time.

zh: 關於生命的意義，每個人的想法都不同。
py: guān yú shēng mìng de yì yì ， měi gè rén de xiǎng fǎ dōu bù tóng 。
en: Everyone thinks differently about the meaning of life.

zh: 別怕失敗，因為失敗的經驗比成功更珍貴。
py: bié pà shī bài ， yīn wèi shī bài de jīng yàn bǐ chéng gōng gèng zhēn guì 。
en: Don't be afraid of failure, because failure is more valuable than success.

zh: 一開始奧運僅安排男子比賽項目，後來才有女子項目的比賽。
py: yī kāi shǐ ào yùn jǐn ān pái nán zi bǐ sài xiàng mù ， hòu lái cái yǒu nǚ zǐ xiàng mù dì bǐ sài 。
en: The Olympics started with only men's competitions, then women's competitions.

zh: 錯誤通常來自粗心，因此無論事情大小都該用心處理。
py: cuò wù tōng cháng lái zì cū xīn ， yīn cǐ wú lùn shì qíng dà xiǎo dōu gāi yòng xīn chù lǐ 。
en: Mistakes usually come from carelessness and should therefore be handled with care whatever the size of the matter.

zh: 他不小心摔壞了新買的手機，因此難過得要命。
py: tā bù xiǎo xīn shuāi huài le xīn mǎi de shǒu jī ， yīn cǐ nán guò dé yào mìng 。
en: He accidentally broke the newly purchased cell phone, which is killing him.

zh: 這家國際企業因商品銷售情況不理想，決定退出亞洲市場。
py: zhè jiā guó jì qǐ yè yīn shāng pǐn xiāo shòu qíng kuàng bù lǐ xiǎng ， jué dìng tuì chū yà zhōu shì chǎng 。
en: The international company decided to withdraw from the Asian market because of the suboptimal sales of goods.

zh: 情侶之間如果無法相信彼此，很容易就分手了。
py: qíng lǚ zhī jiān rú guǒ wú fǎ xiàng xìn bǐ cǐ ， hěn róng yì jiù fēn shǒu le 。
en: It's easy for couples to break up if they can't trust each other.

zh: 重道德的人，即使在沒人看見的地方也會注意自己的行為。
py: zhòng dào dé de rén ， jí shǐ zài méi rén kàn jiàn de dì fāng yě huì zhù yì zì jǐ de xíng wèi 。
en: Moral people, even where no one sees them, are aware of their actions.

zh: 公司全體都支持昨天公告的那條規定。
py: gōng sī quán tǐ dōu zhī chí zuó tiān gōng gào de nà tiáo guī dìng 。
en: The company as a whole supports the rule of yesterday's announcement.

zh: 這項規定是由大會成員一起討論後決定的，必須嚴格遵守。
py: zhè xiàng guī dìng shì yóu dà huì chéng yuán yì qǐ tǎo lùn hòu jué dìng de ， bì xū yán gé zūn shǒu 。
en: This rule, which was decided by the members of the Congress together, must be strictly observed.

zh: 通常第一名只有一位，但有時也會出現例外的情況。
py: tōng cháng dì yì míng zhǐ yǒu yī wèi ， dàn yǒu shí yě huì chū xiàn lì wài de qíng kuàng 。
en: Usually there is only one person in the first place, but sometimes there are exceptions.

zh: 對我來說，擁有和平的日子其實是最單純的幸福。
py: duì wǒ lái shuō ， yōng yǒu hé píng de rì zi qí shí shì zuì dān chún de xìng fú 。
en: For me, a day of peace is indeed the purest happiness.

zh: 與鄰居建立友好的關係，能為你帶來很多好處。
py: yǔ lín jū jiàn lì yǒu hǎo de guān xì ， néng wèi nǐ dài lái hěn duō hǎo chù 。
en: A friendly relationship with your neighbours can bring you a lot of benefits.

zh: 團體活動中，不團結就失去了合作的意義。
py: tuán tǐ huó dòng zhōng ， bù tuán jié jiù shī qù le hé zuò de yì yì 。
en: In group activities, the sense of cooperation is lost without solidarity.

zh: 公司的待遇不公平，於是他決定辭職。
py: gōng sī de dài yù bù gōng píng ， yú shì tā jué dìng cí zhí 。
en: The company was treated unfairly and he decided to resign.

zh: 裁判的工作是確定每位選手都遵守規定，讓比賽順利進行。
py: cái pàn de gōng zuò shì què dìng měi wèi xuǎn shǒu dōu zūn shǒu guī dìng ， ràng bǐ sài shùn lì jìn xíng 。
en: The task of the referee is to make sure that every contestant follows the rules so that the race can proceed smoothly.

zh: 解決種族之間因文化差異產生的問題，最好的辦法就是互相尊重。
py: jiě jué zhǒng zú zhī jiān yīn wén huà chà yì chǎn shēng de wèn tí ， zuì hǎo de bàn fǎ jiù shì hù xiāng zūn zhòng 。
en: The best way to solve the problems arising from cultural differences between races was to respect each other.

zh: 對任何人的態度，不該因種族、國籍或性別而不同。
py: duì rèn hé rén de tài dù ， bù gāi yīn zhǒng zú 、 guó jí huò xìng bié ér bù tóng 。
en: No one should be treated differently on the basis of race, nationality or gender.

zh: 假如人人都發揮人性美好的一面，就能給社會帶來和平。
py: jiǎ rú rén rén dōu fā huī rén xìng měi hǎo de yí miàn ， jiù néng gěi shè huì dài lái hé píng 。
en: If everyone had a good human face, they could bring peace to society.
